Position: Bioinformatics Engineer

Location: Foster City, CA 94404

Duration: 12 Months

Job Type: Temporary Assignment

Work Type: Onsite

Pay Rate: $70.00-$78.00/HR

Overview:

TekWissen is a global workforce management provider headquartered in Ann Arbor, Michigan that offers strategic talent solutions to our clients world-wide.

Bioinformatics Engineer — T2T Genome Assembly (Non model Organisms)

This is a 12 month contract Bioinformatics Engineer role to deliver telomere to telomere (T2T) reference genomes for non model organisms by building and operating long read assembly and curation pipelines using PacBio HiFi and/or Oxford Nanopore, with complementary data (Hi C/Omni C, Strand seq, optical maps, short reads) as needed.
You will partner with wet lab and computational teams to troubleshoot complex genomes (polyploidy, high heterozygosity, repeats) and package results for internal and external release.

Key Responsibilities

Plan assembly approaches for non model organisms (data QC, genome profiling, contamination screening, coverage targets) and advise sequencing strategy.
Run and iterate long read assemblies and consensus refinement (e.g., hifiasm/Verkko/Flye/Canu; polishing as appropriate) toward chromosome scale, T2T quality results.
Resolve haplotypes and complex ploidy/heterozygosity (e.g., trio binning; Hi C/Strand seq assisted phasing) and deliver haplotype resolved assemblies when required.
Scaffold and curate assemblies with long range data (e.g., Hi C/Omni C, Strand seq, optical maps): detect/resolve mis joins, close gaps where feasible, and document curation decisions.
Benchmark quality and completeness (e.g., k mer spectra/Merqury, BUSCO, QUAST, read mapping), including repeat/centromere/telomere assessments to guide iterative improvements.
Productionize workflows (Nextflow/Snakemake/WDL) with containers (Docker/Singularity) across on prem HPC and AWS; produce clear reports, docs, and release packages.

Required Qualifications

PhD in bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, or related field.
Proven de novo assembly experience on long reads (PacBio HiFi and/or ONT), including tuning and iterative improvement.
Assembly QC/validation expertise and ability to diagnose common failure modes in complex genomes.
Strong scripting/programming skills (Python and/or Bash) in Linux; solid software engineering practices (Git, testing, documentation).
Workflow + compute operations experience: Nextflow/Snakemake/WDL; running large genomics workloads on on prem HPC (e.g., Slurm/LSF) and AWS (e.g., Batch/HealthOmics), with cost aware scaling.

Preferred Qualifications

Deep genome assembly and/or annotation experience in non model organisms (repeat annotation and evidence driven gene annotation is a plus).
Demonstrated progress toward T2T completeness (telomeres/centromeres/segmental duplications) and chromosome scale scaffolding.
Evidence of impact (reference releases, preprints/publications, community datasets) is a plus.

Additional Skills (Nice to Have)

Annotation evidence integration by RNA-Seq and delivery of genome browser enabled tracks.
AWS pipeline operations (S3 data transfer, Batch or HealthOmics) and strong cross functional communication (clear status updates, documentation, handoffs).

**Work Arrangement:** This position is onsite, working at the Stanford main campus.

**Budgeted Salary:** The budgeted base salary range for this position is **$32.87** to **$40.52** per hour.

**The School of Engineering**

Stanford Engineering has been at the forefront of innovation for over a century, creating pivotal technologies that have transformed the worlds of information technology, communications, health care, energy, business and beyond. Our faculty and students are creative risk-takers who pursue excellence across a breadth of disciplines. Our alumni include some of the world's most successful leaders in technology and business. Our staff are critical to enabling Stanford Engineering to accomplish its mission: seeking solutions to some of the world's most urgent challenges and educating leaders who will make the world a better place through the power of engineering principles, techniques and systems.

The Electrical Engineering department in the School of Engineering seeks a **Lab Assistant** (Life Science Research Professional 1) to provide direct support for a faculty member’s lab. This is a highly interdisciplinary project at the intersection of device engineering, materials science, and molecular biology; and involves multiple collaborations. The role will involve device fabrication, in vitro testing, and pre-clinical testing in animals. In addition, the person will be expected to maintain accurate laboratory records, and stock laboratory supplies. This is a great opportunity for engineers interested in gaining research experience in an interdisciplinary area combining engineering with translational research before applying for graduate/medical school.

**In this role you will:**

* Perform fabrication and testing of devices (under direction) using a variety of laboratory protocols and equipment. Record results accurately and troubleshoots procedures.
* Maintain mammalian cell lines, and perform biomolecular assays (ELISA, qPCR, western blots, immunohistology staining, and others).
* Perform work that includes microfabrication, engineering, and electrical/electronic testing of device platforms.
* Performs animal work that involves surgery, regular bleeds, blood glucose measurements, etc.
* Keeps accurate logs of all experiments performed and communicates findings to supervisor.
* Attend courses in safety procedures for handling, storage and disposal of biohazardous, flammable, corrosive and toxic materials. Carries out all laboratory activities in compliance with applicable regulations and protocols.
* Conduct literature searches and reviews, compiling information for journals and suggesting uses for new techniques to the P.I. Attend courses, lectures and conferences to further own knowledge of research and laboratory techniques, consulting with other researchers and technicians to exchange information.
Contribute to the teamwork within and between departments and organizations.  

**Preferred Requirements:**  
Previous experience with some of the following techniques would be advantageous;

* Microfabrication and/or microfluidics
* Device assembly and prototyping
* Mammalian cell culture
* Histology staining
* Biomolecular assays (ELISA, Western Blot, RNA extraction, qPCR, confocal microscopy)
* Animal work (surgery, bleeding, blood glucose measurements, necropsy)

  

**Core Duties** :

* Plan approach to experiments in support of research projects in lab and/or field based on knowledge of scientific theory.
* Independently conduct experiments; maintain detailed records of experiments and outcomes.
* Apply the theories and methods of a life science discipline to interpret and perform analyses of experiment results; offer suggestions regarding modifications to procedures and protocols in collaboration with senior researcher.
* Review literature on an ongoing basis to remain current with new procedures and apply learnings to related research.
* Contribute to publication of findings as needed. Participate in the preparation of written documents, including procedures, presentations, and proposals.
* Help with general lab maintenance as needed; maintain lab stock, manage chemical inventory and safety records, and provide general lab support as needed.
* Assist with orientation and training of new staff or students on lab procedures or techniques.

Bachelor's degree in related scientific field.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** :

* General understanding of scientific principles. Demonstrated performance to use knowledge and skills when needed.
* Demonstrated ability to apply theoretical knowledge of science principals to problem solve work.
* Ability to maintain detailed records of experiments and outcomes.
* General computer skills and ability to quickly learn and master computer programs, databases, and scientific applications.

A Senior Research Associate position is available in the lab of Dr. Charleston Chiang at USC. The Chiang lab (opens in new window) utilizes cutting-edge analytic tools to address questions at the intersection of human medical and population genetics. In particular, we have a strong interest in using genomic data to understand the evolution and architecture of complex traits and the history of diverse human populations. These insights will be critical for future medical genetics studies and in practicing personalized medicine.

The successful candidate will have substantial input in the nature and the direction of the ongoing research projects within the lab and will be encouraged to explore projects that broadly fit within the lab’s research interests and funded R35 and R01 grants. These goals include learning about demographic history or natural selection from genetic variation data, or understanding genetic architecture and evolutionary history of complex traits in diverse populations. Opportunities are available for both method development as well as analysis of large-scale genotyping, next-generation sequencing, and multi-omic data in humans from diverse populations.

in conducting human genetics or population genetics research in Unix-based computing environment, 18 months of post-doctoral experience, and proficient in one or more programming languages (e.g. python, C++, R, etc.). The position expects a longer-term (> 2 yr) commitment

jobs.title: Data Analyst II
jobs.description:
About The Role

Good AI and good systems both come down to good data. We're hiring a Data Analyst II to do the hands-on data work that makes our engagements succeed: mapping and reconciling data across systems, validating what comes out, and building the datasets we measure our agents against. It is detailed, high-judgment work, and it is the difference between an agent that demos well and one a firm can actually trust.

What you'll do

Map, normalize, reconcile, and validate data from source systems into the target schema, partnering with our data team in Hyderabad, India to deliver at scale.
Profile and clean messy, real-world data from documents, spreadsheets, and exports, and surface the quality issues that matter.
Build and maintain the ground-truth datasets we measure our agents against, and review agent and extraction outputs for accuracy.
Turn the results into clear analysis and reporting the team and the client can act on.

What we're looking for

2+ years in a data analyst role, with strong SQL and spreadsheet skills.
A sharp eye for data quality: you catch the nulls, mismatches, and logical errors others miss.
Comfort working with messy data from many sources and getting it into a clean, structured shape.
Clear communication: you can turn data findings into something a non-technical stakeholder understands.
Bonus: Python or pandas, a BI tool such as Power BI or Tableau, or familiarity with private-markets or financial data.

Why Dealstitch

We're a senior team with 40+ years of combined private-market technology experience. You'll work on problems that matter, with direct access to decision-makers, and see the impact of your work in weeks, not quarters.

jobs.title: Sr. / Staff. Engineer, Device Statistics & Model Correlation
jobs.description:
Location: San Jose, CA (on-site)

Ayar Labs is solving the I/O bandwidth bottlenecks inherent in modern AI compute architectures. As pioneers of co-packaged optics (CPO), we develop silicon photonics solutions that deliver unprecedented bandwidth density and reach, at a fraction of the power consumption required to scale next-generation AI models.

Backed by industry giants like NVIDIA, AMD, Mediatek and Intel and manufactured in partnership with the world's leading semiconductor ecosystem, Ayar Labs' co-packaged optics solution is key to unleashing next-generation AI scale-up architectures.

Joining our Link Design and Architecture team, you will own the statistics that connect our measurements to our models. Our photonic devices are measured at wafer, package and system level, on our own test floor and by our foundry and vendor partners. You will turn that data into the statistical description of each device (distributions, variance across lots, wafers and dies, parameter correlations), prepare it for the statistical models behind our compact models and link simulations, and track how well full simulation models follow full-system measurements so discrepancies are caught early.

The team is responsible for the robustness and performance of the optical links that power our technology, from component-level modeling through architecture definition, link analysis, specification development, and yield prediction, and drives the exploration of next-generation link architectures that shape our long-term roadmap.

Essential Functions

Work with our data infrastructure team to bring internal test data (wafer, package and system level) and foundry and vendor deliveries into a form ready for analysis, with a traceable record of where every number came from.
Build the statistical description of each photonic device: fit distributions, separate lot-to-lot, wafer-to-wafer, die-to-die and within-die variance, estimate parameter correlations and covariance, and decide which of that structure the model needs to carry.
Work with photonic device engineers to choose the measured parameters that best characterize each device, and with link modeling engineers to express the resulting statistics in the form the compact and link models consume (Monte Carlo and corner inputs, covariance-aware tolerancing).
Maintain the correlation between full simulation models and full-system measurements across tapeouts and lots, track model-to-measurement residuals, and raise discrepancies with a diagnosis of whether the model or the test is at fault.
Contribute to the device specification-setting methodology: parametric yield estimates and specification limits derived from measured distributions.
Document methods, assumptions and data lineage so results are reproducible and reviewable by engineering teams and executive stakeholders alike.

Required Qualifications

MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Optics/Photonics, Statistics, or a related field.
4+ years of experience analyzing measurement data for semiconductor or photonic devices.
Strong applied statistics: distribution fitting, variance decomposition, correlation and covariance estimation, regression, hypothesis testing, design of experiments, Monte Carlo methods.
Strong Python skills for scientific computing and data analysis (NumPy, SciPy, pandas, statsmodels or similar) and comfort working with large tabular datasets.
Working knowledge of photonic device physics sufficient to interpret what a parameter shift means (modulators, photodetectors, grating couplers, waveguides).
Excellent communication skills and a collaborative working style across device, modeling and test teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience with silicon photonics or with foundry process-control data (WAT/PCM, JMP).
Experience with statistical parameterization of compact models
Experience validating measurement systems and test methods (gauge R&R, repeatability versus device variation).
Experience with data pipelines and versioned datasets (Git, SQL or Parquet, dashboards).
Familiarity with Bayesian or hierarchical models for lot, wafer and die structure.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

About The Role

The Data team at SpaceXSI is a small team that works across the company to inform business and product decisions, and we’re hiring the first member of our team to focus fully on marketing. Performance Marketing at SpaceXSI drives scaled acquisition across 10+ channels for Grok, Grok Bot, and our full portfolio of AI products, across consumer, SMB, startup, and enterprise audiences.

This role will sit in the central Data team and partner directly with Marketing leadership to own the measurement and analysis of performance marketing, growth marketing programs, and overall marketing measurement. You'll use your expertise to inform where the next dollar goes as we scale paid acquisition, while building the foundations of a world class marketing data team. Your job is to help us understand the impact of our activities and what we should do next.

What You'll Do

Build and own the measurement layer for performance marketing: economics and performance by channel, campaign, audience, geo, and creative, across both PLG and Sales-Led revenue lines
Design incrementality tests (geo, audience, and conversion lift) with channel owners, and use the results to move budget and calibrate attribution, not just to fill a slide
Stand up and maintain our media-mix model, and pair it with test results to answer the big allocation questions: which channels to scale, which to cut, and where we're hitting saturation
Own the quality of the predictive LTV signal we send to Meta, Google, and the other networks: validate it against realized revenue, catch drift and breakage early, and partner with Data and Engineering to improve it

jobs.description:
About The Company

Futrend Technology, Inc. is a forward-thinking provider of high-value IT solutions dedicated to supporting mission-critical federal programs. With a focus on innovation and excellence, Futrend specializes in Healthcare IT, Federal Financial Management, and Grants Management, establishing a strong track record in enterprise modernization and real-time system integration. The company prides itself on its core values of integrity, collaboration, and continuous improvement, investing significantly in its team’s professional growth and technical advancement. Futrend offers competitive compensation packages coupled with comprehensive benefits to attract and retain top talent in the industry.

About The Role

Futrend Technology, Inc. is seeking a skilled Full Stack Python/DevOps Developer to join our dynamic team supporting the National Library of Medicine (NLM). This role involves developing, modernizing, and securing enterprise web applications that serve critical federal functions. The successful candidate will possess strong expertise in full-stack development across multiple programming languages, including Python, Java, and Node.js, along with robust DevOps skills to support automated, secure, AWS-based cloud environments. You will be instrumental in designing scalable, interoperable systems that facilitate seamless data exchange and integration across NIH stakeholders. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work on impactful projects within a collaborative environment that values innovation, technical excellence, and professional growth.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, along with a minimum of three years of professional software engineering experience. Candidates should have over five years of full-stack development experience, demonstrating proficiency in backend and frontend technologies. Strong programming skills in Python, Java, and Node.js are essential, complemented by experience in modern front-end frameworks such as React or Angular, including TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows is required, as well as a solid understanding of RESTful API design and systems integration.

Hands-on experience with AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS/Aurora, Lambda, CloudFront, and IAM is critical. Candidates should have expertise in MongoDB, including schema design, indexing, and performance tuning, along with experience with relational databases like PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MySQL. Test automation skills using Selenium/WebDriver are necessary, along with strong DevOps experience involving CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation tools like Terraform or CloudFormation. A good understanding of secure authentication protocols, Zero Trust security principles, and NIH security requirements is also required. Eligibility for a Public Trust clearance and successful completion of federal background screening are mandatory.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain backend services utilizing Python frameworks such as Django and FastAPI, Java with Spring Boot or Quarkus, and Node.js with Express or NestJS.
Create secure REST and GraphQL APIs to support interoperability across NIH and NLM systems.
Develop modern, responsive front-end applications using React or Angular, adhering to USWDS and Section 508 accessibility standards.
Implement comprehensive automated testing strategies using Selenium/WebDriver to ensure cross-browser compatibility and regression testing.
Operate and enhance AWS cloud environments including EC2, S3, RDS/Aurora, IAM, CloudFront, and Lambda functions.
Build, monitor, and optimize CI/CD pipelines employing GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins to streamline deployment processes.
Manage and optimize MongoDB clusters, focusing on schema design, indexing, performance tuning, backup strategies, and replication.
Support and maintain relational databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MySQL, ensuring data integrity and performance.
Develop Infrastructure-as-Code solutions using Terraform or AWS CloudFormation for consistent, repeatable deployments.
Monitor system performance, troubleshoot application issues, and utilize observability tools like CloudWatch, ELK, or OpenSearch for system health monitoring.
Create detailed technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, runbooks, SOPs, and configuration standards to support ongoing maintenance and knowledge transfer.
Mentor junior developers, contribute to engineering standards, governance, and best practices to foster a high-performing development team.

Benefits

Futrend Technology, Inc. offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional development of its employees. Benefits include competitive salary packages, health insurance, dental and vision coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, and professional development opportunities. The company promotes a collaborative work environment that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and career growth. Employees also have access to flexible work arrangements and resources to support work-life balance, ensuring a rewarding and sustainable career path within a supportive organizational culture.

Equal Opportunity

Futrend Technology, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to creating a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances our ability to innovate and serve our clients effectively.

jobs.description:

As a trusted and respected partner to the pharmaceutical industry, we uphold the highest standards in safety, quality and sustainability, while fostering a culture that empowers you to thrive. Here, you'll find a workplace that values both collective success and your individual contributions—offering long-term opportunities to grow and make an impact.

Your Role

Microbiology Lab Technician - 3rd Shift (10:00 PM - 6:30 AM Sunday night through Friday morning)

The Micro Lab Technician II supports microbiological testing and laboratory operations in a cGMP-regulated pharmaceutical and medical device manufacturing environment. This position performs routine microbiological testing, environmental monitoring activities, laboratory maintenance, data collection, and documentation while ensuring compliance with company procedures, regulatory requirements, and quality standards.

Responsibilities

Your Profile:

Perform routine microbiological testing in accordance with approved SOPs and cGMP requirements.

Conduct Environmental Monitoring (EM) activities, including:Viable air sampling

Surface monitoring

Personnel monitoring

Non-viable particulate monitoring

Collect and process water samples for microbiological analysis.

Support sample preparation, incubation, and documentation activities.

Perform media preparation, sterilization, and autoclaving of laboratory materials and supplies.

Conduct precut and support activities required for environmental monitoring programs.

Maintain laboratory cleanliness, organization, and housekeeping in accordance with GMP standards.

Retrieve samples, supplies, and testing materials from the warehouse to support laboratory operations.

Operate and monitor autoclave equipment for sterilization of media, glassware, and laboratory materials.

Accurately document laboratory activities, observations, and test results in notebooks, worksheets, and electronic systems.

Review laboratory records for completeness and compliance with Good Documentation Practices (GDP).

Trend environmental monitoring data and communicate potential adverse trends to supervision.

Verify equipment calibration status prior to use and ensure equipment is operating properly.

Communicate equipment issues or maintenance needs to management promptly.

Collaborate with Quality, Manufacturing, and other departments to support production schedules and project timelines.

Participate in laboratory investigations, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives as assigned.

Perform additional duties as assigned by management.

Education

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

High School Diploma or equivalent required.

Associate degree or coursework in Microbiology, Biology, Chemistry, or a related scientific field strongly preferred.

Experience

1-3 years of experience in a microbiology laboratory environment.

Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, food, or contract testing laboratories preferred.

Experience performing environmental monitoring in controlled environments is a plus.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Basic knowledge of microbiological laboratory techniques and aseptic practices.

Understanding of cGMP, Good Documentation Practices (GDP), and laboratory SOPs.

Ability to follow written procedures accurately and consistently.

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Proficient with Microsoft Office applications, including Word and Excel.

Effective written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Ability to gown aseptically and work in cleanroom environments.

Flexibility to work overtime or adjusted schedules to support production and laboratory operations.

Knowledge of laboratory safety practices and procedures.

Target Pay Rate: $26 - 30/hour + 15% Differential working on 3rd Shift (10:00 PM - 6:30 AM Sunday night through Friday morning)

Individual compensation packages are based on various factors unique to each candidate, including skill set, experience, qualifications and other job-related reasons.

Medical, Dental, Vision

Flexible Spending & HSA Options

Life Insurance, Short & Long Term Disability

Pet Insurance

401K

jobs.description:
Description

WORK LOCATION: San Luis Obispo, CA

FLSA STATUS: Non-Exempt

SALARY RANGE: The anticipated salary range for this role is $25 to $42 per hour. This range reflects a good faith estimate based on the targeted level for the role and typical compensation benchmarks across U.S. locations. Actual compensation may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications, experience, geographical location, and internal alignment.

Summary

The Engineering Specialist, Electrical is a hands-on technical role responsible for executing electrical assembly, wiring, and test activities for unmanned aircraft systems (UAS). This role builds on foundational electrical skills and expands into more complex harness builds, subsystem integration, electrical troubleshooting, and execution of electrical test procedures with minimal supervision.

The Electrical Specialist II supports prototype development, test articles, and low-rate production hardware, identifies and resolves routine electrical issues, and partners with engineers to improve build quality, reliability, and electrical integration processes. This role represents a fully contributing technical specialist progressing toward senior-level electrical authority.

Responsibilities

The following job functions are a basic requirement but are not limited to and may be assigned other duties.

Build and install electrical assemblies, wire harnesses, and cable assemblies for UAS platforms.
Perform electrical integration activities, including routing, securing, and terminating wiring within airframes and subsystems.
Execute electrical test procedures independently, including continuity checks, insulation resistance tests, and power-on verification.
Troubleshoot and resolve routine electrical issues such as wiring errors, connector faults, grounding problems, or intermittent signals.
Support board-level bring-up activities under engineering guidance.
Read, interpret, and apply electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and engineering documentation.
Perform rework, modifications, and repairs on electrical assemblies in accordance with procedures.
Document build steps, test results, discrepancies, and corrective actions.
Maintain ESD compliance, tool control, and organized electrical workspaces.
Collaborate with electrical engineers, mechanical specialists, and production teams to improve electrical integration and build processes.
Assumes all other responsibilities as assigned.

Required Qualifications

As a member of the MiniMed’s – Continuous Glucose Monitoring Sensor R&D team the Senior Biomedical Engineer will contribute to the development of biosensing technologies and manufacturing with emphasis on glucose sensing. jobs.title: Principal Analog/Mixed Signal CAD Engineer - EMIR
jobs.description:
**About Marvell**

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

**Your Team, Your Impact**

We are seeking a Principal Analog/Mixed-Signal CAD Engineer to join our Central Engineering organization in Santa Clara, CA or Irvine, CA. In this role, you will help shape the next generation of design automation infrastructure that supports cutting-edge analog, mixed-signal, and silicon photonics IC development across the company.  
  
This is a highly visible technical leadership role where your work will directly impact how Marvell's global design teams build industry-leading semiconductor products.  
  
You will join Marvell's Central Engineering CAD team, a group responsible for building and supporting the advanced design infrastructure used by hundreds of engineers developing some of the industry's most sophisticated silicon. The team works at the intersection of EDA tools, semiconductor process technology, and circuit design, partnering closely with:  

* Analog and mixed-signal IC design teams
* Silicon photonics engineers
* Foundry partners
* EDA vendors
* Device modeling and TCAD specialists

  
This collaborative environment gives you a unique opportunity to influence the design methodology and automation frameworks used across the entire company.  
  
Technical Focus:  
This position focuses on electromigration and IR-drop (EMIR) analysis for advanced FinFET, BiCMOS, SiGe, and SiPho technologies.

**What You Can Expect**

As a Principal Analog/Mixed-Signal CAD Engineer, you will play a critical role in developing and evolving the automated design flows that enable Marvell's most advanced silicon programs. Key responsibilities include:

* Develop and support electromigration and IR-drop (EMIR) analysis flows, including flow setup, DSPF validation, current-density and voltage-drop analysis, debugging, and post-layout verification.
* Architect and support next-generation automated AMS design flows used across Marvell design teams.
* Build and maintain custom tools, PCells, Pycells, GUI utilities, and automation/productivity tools using scripting languages within the Cadence Virtuoso, Synopsys OptoCompiler, and Siemens Calibre environments.
* Install, validate, and support foundry PDKs.
* Set up and maintain physical verification flows, parasitic extraction and EMIR flows.
* Partner with analog designers and EDA vendors to troubleshoot and resolve complex design flow challenges.
* Help shape company-wide CAD infrastructure and best practices for analog, mixed-signal, and silicon photonics development.

Joining Marvell means working on technology that defines the future of computing and connectivity. In this role, you can expect:

* Cutting-edge semiconductor technology: Work on advanced FinFET, BiCMOS, SiGe, and SiPho nodes and next-generation mixed-signal architectures.
* High technical impact: Your methodologies will be used across multiple product lines and engineering teams worldwide.
* Deep collaboration: Partner with world-class designers, modeling experts, and EDA innovators.
* Leadership without limits: Influence CAD strategy and engineering infrastructure across a global semiconductor organization.
* A culture of innovation: Marvell engineers push the boundaries of performance, efficiency, and integration.

You'll also enjoy the energy of working in Silicon Valley's semiconductor innovation hub in Santa Clara alongside engineers building the next generation of AI, networking, and cloud infrastructure silicon.

Please note: This role is based in our Santa Clara or Irvine office and requires onsite presence five days per week. Remote or hybrid work is not available for this position.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong hands-on experience with Cadence Voltus-XFi
* BSEE with 10–15 years of professional experience, or MS/PhD in Electrical Engineering with 5–10 years of industry experience.
* Proven experience building and maintaining analog/mixed-signal design flows for advanced FinFET, BiCMOS, SiGe, and SiPho technologies.
* Strong hands-on experience with industry-standard AMS design tools, including Cadence Virtuoso Studio, Synopsys OptoCompiler, and Siemens Calibre.
* Solid understanding of analog/mixed-signal design flows, including schematic capture, simulation, parasitic extraction, post-layout verification, and EMIR.
* Programming or scripting experience in Python, TCL, Shell, and SKILL.
* Experience developing custom CAD automation or verification frameworks.
* Familiarity with silicon photonics design flows.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with electromagnetic (EM) simulation and extraction.

**Expected Base Pay Range (USD)**

150,680 - 225,700, $ per annum

The successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. The expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.

jobs.description:
The Medical Affairs team collaborates with the leaders of Sleep, Respiratory Care, SaaS, ResMed Healthcare, and Asia Growth Markets to ensure our work, especially our clinical research and market access projects, align with their strategic priorities. We also review key government policies, as part of the continuous evaluation and improvement process that helps us maintain global compliance across an ever-shifting landscape of legal and regulatory requirements. The two, research and compliance, work hand-in-hand, and when balanced properly allow us to generate important clinical, economic and market evidence, that improves the lives of patients in ways that are scientifically valid, clinically relevant and ethically sound.

The primary role of the Clinical Research Associate is to support the planning, coordination, and execution of clinical research projects, including single- and multi-site clinical studies. The role has broad responsibilities across study operations, site coordination, EDC monitoring and data review, study documentation, participant and recruitment support, and cross-functional study activities.

Let’s Talk About Responsibilities

Support the planning, start-up, execution, monitoring, and closeout of single- and multi-site clinical research studies.
Participate in cross-functional team meetings in the planning and execution of clinical trials.
Coordinate day-to-day study operations with internal teams, clinical sites, vendors, CROs, and contractors, including meeting support.
Contribute to the development of study documents, including protocols, amendments, informed consent forms, CRFs, source documents, training materials, and study reports.
Conduct site feasibility assessments and site selection activities.
Conduct assigned EDC monitoring and centralized data review activities, including CRF review, query management, missing data follow-up, data reconciliation, and documentation of findings.
Maintain study trackers, metrics, dashboards, screening and enrollment reports, query reports, timelines, and study summaries to support operational oversight and leadership updates.
Track enrollment, retention, visit completion, study supplies, device accountability, protocol deviations, adverse events, technical observations/device deficiencies, audit findings, and other study issues.
Collect, track, file, and reconcile electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) and site regulatory documents to support inspection readiness.
Support preparation, tracking, and submissions to IRB and regulatory documentation, as assigned.
Support approved recruitment activities, including recruitment campaigns coordination, prescreening activities, participant follow up, and scheduling appointments.
Support research participant visits as needed, including visit preparation, documentation, data entry, and follow-up in accordance with the protocol and study procedures.
Coordinate ordering, shipment, tracking, and reconciliation of study supplies and equipment, as applicable.
Support Resmed Clinical Research Registry campaigns and assist with registry and database updates, as required.
Develop study budgets and initiate clinical research agreements
Support audit and inspection readiness activities, including document review, tracking, and follow-up of assigned action items.
Contributes to the SOP review process and/or other Clinical Operations Initiatives
Perform other duties and responsibilities as required to support clinical research activities and business needs.

Let’s Talk About Qualifications And Experience

Required:

Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, health sciences, public health, or a related field.
Minimum of 2 years of experience in clinical research
Experience in conducting medical device and/or in-vitro diagnostics studies preferred. Pharmaceutical background will also be considered
Working knowledge of applicable clinical research regulations and standards, including ICH, GCP, FDA regulations, ISO standards, and HIPAA, as applicable.

Preferred:

Experience supporting medical device and/or in vitro diagnostic clinical studies; pharmaceutical clinical research experience will also be considered.
CRA or clinical research certification (e.g., CCRA, CCRC, or CCRP).
Current GCP certification.
Clinical research or healthcare experience related to sleep and respiratory medicine.

Computer Skills

Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (SharePoint, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook)
Experience with electronic data capture (EDC), clinical trial management, and other clinical research systems.
Ability to use approved digital and AI-enabled tools to support documentation and meeting summaries, in accordance with company policies and data privacy requirements.

Qualifications

Strong organizational, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
Strong attention to detail and documentation, with the ability to manage multiple studies, priorities, and deadlines.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within cross-functional teams.
Proactive, problem-solving mind set and self-motivated, with strong follow-through and accountability.
Demonstrates integrity, sound judgment, and a strong team orientation
Ability to work a flexible schedule as needed to support clinical study activities.
Ability to work effectively with global, cross-functional teams across multiple time zones, including flexibility to attend occasional meetings outside standard business hours.

Why join us

At Resmed, you’ll be part of a mission driven company focused on improving health and quality of life. This role offers high visibility, the chance to learn from senior brand leaders, and the opportunity to shape how Resmed shows up across global markets. You’ll grow your skills in brand strategy, cross functional collaboration, and brand governance at scale.

**Overview**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Mechanical Assembler (Hardware Lab Technician) to join our dynamic manufacturing and testing team. * Interpret engineering schematics and technical drawings accurately to guide assembly procedures and troubleshooting efforts.

* The ability to use hand and power tools.

jobs.description:
Multi-Specialty Dental Practice | Campbell, California

Job Type: Full-Time | On-SiteSalary: 90,000–115,000 annually, depending on experience

About the Position

A growing, technology-driven multi-specialty dental practice specializing in advanced dental surgery, implant dentistry, and All-on-X (AOX) full-arch rehabilitation is seeking an experienced Senior Digital Dental Lab Technician to join its in-house digital laboratory in Campbell, California.

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on technician proficient in digital dental design, CAD/CAM technology, 3D printing, surgical guide fabrication, and same-day full-arch conversion workflows.

The ideal candidate has advanced experience with Exocad, 3Shape, or comparable dental design software and can independently manage digital cases from initial records through design, fabrication, and finishing.

This position supports a broad range of surgical and restorative procedures, including single-tooth implants, full-arch implant restorations, digital diagnostic wax-ups, surgical guides, provisional prostheses, and other digitally fabricated dental appliances.

This is a dedicated, full-time, on-site position working directly with our surgeons and clinical team.

Key Responsibilities

Digital Design & CAD/CAM

* Design digital diagnostic wax-ups, smile designs, restorative mock-ups, and implant-supported prostheses.
* Utilize Exocad, 3Shape, or comparable dental CAD/CAM software for restorative and prosthetic design.
* Design implant-supported crowns, provisional restorations, and full-arch prostheses.
* Prepare and optimize digital designs for 3D printing and milling.
* Review and integrate intraoral scans, CBCT imaging, and digital restorative records.
* Troubleshoot digital design challenges and make modifications based on clinical feedback.

Same-Day AOX Digital Conversions

* Independently manage the digital workflow for same-day All-on-X conversions, from post-surgical implant position records through prosthetic design and preparation for fabrication.

* Coordinate directly with surgeons and clinical staff during time-sensitive conversion cases.

Implant Planning & Surgical Guide Design

* Design surgical guides for single-tooth, multiple-implant, and other implant cases.

* Integrate CBCT and intraoral scan data for accurate implant planning and guide fabrication.
* Collaborate with surgeons to ensure surgical guide designs align with approved treatment plans.

3D Printing & In-House Fabrication

* Manage digital production files and maintain efficient laboratory workflows.

Digital Implant Workflow & Clinical Collaboration

* Work with intraoral scans, CBCT imaging, photogrammetry, and digital restorative records.

* Advanced proficiency in Exocad, 3Shape Dental System, or comparable dental CAD/CAM design software.

* Experience with implant surgical guide design, including single-tooth implant cases.
* Proficiency in digital diagnostic wax-ups, restorative design, and implant-supported prosthetics.
* Hands-on experience with dental 3D printing, including file preparation, post-processing, and finishing.
* Strong understanding of dental anatomy, occlusion, implant prosthetics, and restorative principles.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with SprintRay or other dental 3D printing systems.

Your Role: Civil Engineer

The Substation is responsible for advanced engineering analysis and design of substation foundations, including equipment foundations, structure foundations, deep and shallow systems, and ground-supported structural elements. The engineer independently interprets geotechnical data, performs complex structural and foundation calculations, and develops complete foundation design packages. This role interfaces directly with clients, internal teams, and vendors and provides mentorship to junior engineers while supporting construction activities with moderate guidance.

What You’ll Do

Prepare scopes of work, estimates, and technical documentation for foundation engineering on substation projects
Identify appropriate foundation types based on geotechnical conditions, environmental factors, and loading requirements
Perform advanced foundation engineering calculations including bearing capacity, settlement, uplift resistance, lateral resistance, structural load combinations, and equipment loading
Conduct structural analysis for substation equipment foundations and support structures
Develop foundation plans, sections, reinforcement details, and calculation packages for IFR/IFA/IFC deliverables
Interpret and analyze soil boring logs, geotechnical reports, and site investigation data with minimal oversight
Interface with internal engineering teams, project managers, clients, and vendors to communicate technical solutions and coordinate design decisions
Apply governing codes and standards independently (ASCE, ACI, AISC, AASHTO)
Perform peer checks on lower-level engineering work and carry out formal QC reviews with minimal correction needed
Mentor junior engineers on foundation engineering principles, analysis techniques, and software tools
Provide moderate field support including review of foundation excavations, reinforcement placement, and troubleshooting construction issues
Support construction teams by answering technical questions and providing limited field analysis under senior guidance

What You Bring

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering from an ABET-accredited university
3+ years of foundation or structural engineering experience; 2 additional years accepted in lieu of FE certification.
Proficiency in foundation and structural analysis software (L‑Pile, RISA, Autodesk Inventor, etc.)
Strong understanding of geotechnical engineering principles and interpretation of soil boring data
Experience designing foundations for utility, industrial, or infrastructure projects
Knowledge of industry standards including ASCE, ACI, AISC, and AASHTO
Ability to develop detailed foundation plans and calculation packages with minimal oversight
Proficiency in AutoCAD or Civil 3D; Bentley MicroStation or Bentley Substation experience is a plus
Strong skills in Microsoft Office and PDF markup tools (e.g., Bluebeam)

Additional Skills

Engineer-in-Training (EIT / FE Certification) preferred
Engineer-in-Training (EIT / FE Certification) required, or additional 2 years of civil design experience in lieu of FE certification

Professional English — C1 or higher

Review genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, and other biological data analysis pipelines for scientific accuracy and reproducibility

Biostatistics and machine learning applied to biology

Professional written and spoken English proficiency at C1 level or higher
Deep expertise in at least one relevant biological or computational research area
Hands-on experience analyzing real biological datasets
Proficiency in Python and/or R for scientific analysis
Experience with relevant tools and libraries, such as BLAST, samtools, GATK, Bioconductor, or Biopython, depending on the candidate's specialization

jobs.title: Research Assistant | Laboratory of Chemical Immunology and Proteomics
jobs.description:
Organization Overview

The laboratory of Chemical Immunology and Proteomics applies synthetic chemistry, chemical biology, and proteomics methods toward the goals of discovering and characterizing (a) novel selective chemical probes that perturb the functions of key proteins regulating immunological and neuroimmunological processes; (b) new mechanisms for small molecule-induced protein degradation; and, more broadly, (c) the pharmacological landscape and signal transduction pathways in immune and neuroimmunological disorders. By developing and applying innovative chemical proteomic profiling technologies, we aim to enrich our understanding of the molecular differences between pathologic and physiologic states in immune cells and cells of the nervous system and to leverage them from a pharmacological perspective for the development of new therapies that not only target specific immune cell subtypes, but also the defined activation states of these cells. Please see www.vinogradovalab.com for more information.

Overview

The Research Assistant will support ongoing research projects investigating the molecular mechanisms regulating immune cell function, with a focus on T helper cell biology and neuroinflammation. The position will involve conducting experiments using primary immune cells, molecular and cellular biology techniques, and supporting studies using mouse models of neuroinflammation.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities include:

Conduct experiments investigating T helper cell activation, differentiation, and function.
Perform molecular and cellular assays, including flow cytometry, immunoblotting, and other biochemical techniques, to characterize immune cell responses.
Assist a postdoctoral researcher with animal studies investigating neuroinflammation.
Analyze experimental data, maintain accurate laboratory records, and participate in laboratory meetings and discussions of research findings.
Prepare reagents, maintain laboratory supplies and equipment, and support routine laboratory operations.

Qualifications

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor's degree in biology, biochemistry, immunology, molecular biology, or a related scientific discipline.
A minimum of 2 years of extensive laboratory research experience through undergraduate coursework, internships, or independent research projects.
Familiarity with basic molecular and cellular biology techniques.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to maintain accurate experimental records.
Excellent communication skills and ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a research environment.
Willingness to work with laboratory mice and complete required institutional training.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with some of the following cell and molecular biology techniques:
flow cytometry
PCR/RT-PCR
SDS-PAGE
Western blot
cloning
viral transduction
CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing
protein expression
biochemical assay development

Experience working with murine models is a plus

ABOUT AVALON BIOVENTURES:

Avalon BioVentures is a biotech venture capital firm that builds on Avalon’s 40-year success in pursuing disruptive ideas to improve life. From its established offices and labs on the Torrey Pines Mesa, in La Jolla, California, Avalon BioVentures leverages its Accelerator, which provides operational infrastructure and support, and the team’s extensive experience to identify promising science, build agile companies, and advance breakthrough therapeutics.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Research Associate
to join our team within the newest company in the Accelerator. This hands-on role is essential to the day-to-day operations of our laboratory. You will contribute directly to antibody production, biochemical and biophysical characterization. In addition to technical benchwork, you will play a key role in maintaining laboratory efficiency through consumables management, media preparation, and core laboratory support.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Molecular Biology and Protein Biochemistry

Develop and run Molecular biology processes, including PCR, cloning, purification, quantification etc.
Express, purify, and screen recombinant antibodies and proteins using standard platforms (e.g., mammalian cell culture, affinity chromatography).
Perform biochemical and biophysical characterization using techniques such as SDS-PAGE, Western Blotting, SEC-HPLC, and thermal stability assays.
Help troubleshoot purification protocols and routine analytical workflows to maintain high quality and yield.

Cell-Based Assays

Maintain mammalian cell lines and primary-cell preparation/culture systems with consistent quality.
Prepare reagents, controls and plates; support flow cytometry, ELISA/MSD/Luminex and other platform workflows as relevant.
Capture and QC data, maintain accurate ELN documentation, and flag assay deviations or cell/reagent issues quickly.

Laboratory Operations & Management

Manage laboratory inventory, including tracking, ordering, and restocking consumables, reagents, and media.
Prepare common laboratory reagents, stock solutions, and cell culture media.
Maintain, calibrate, and clean core laboratory equipment (e.g., biological safety cabinets, incubators, centrifuges).
Coordinate lab dishwashing, sterilization (autoclaving), and biohazardous waste disposal.
Ensure compliance with laboratory safety protocols, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and proper waste handling.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

•       B.S. or M.S. in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, or a related life sciences discipline.
•        1–3 years of hands-on experience in a research or industry laboratory setting (academic labs with strong hands-on scope included).

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Experience of standard Molecular Biology techniques.
Proficiency in mammalian cell culture and aseptic technique.
Hands-on experience with protein/antibody purification (e.g., Protein A/G, Ni-NTA) and standard biochemical assays (SDS-PAGE, Western Blot).
Experience with immunoassay platforms (MSD, ELISA) and/or flow cytometry
Immunology/immunoassays background experience is considered a "plus"

CORE COMPETENCIES

Strong organizational and multi-tasking skills in a fast-paced environment.
Rigorous record-keeping habits and familiarity with ELNs.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

WHAT WE OFFER

In addition to a competitive compensation package with stock options, the company also offers a comprehensive benefits package for our employees and their families, which includes medical, dental, vision, and supplemental disability insurance.

Position Description

POSITION SUMMARY

The Instructional Laboratory Technician I, (Automotive) reports to the Dean of Business & Workforce Development at Evergreen Valley College. The work schedule is 10 months per year; 16 hours per week; Monday – Thursday; 6:00 p.m. – 10:00 p.m. (A 2.5% evening shift differential will added to the salary).

This position is represented by CSEA (California School Employees Association), Chapter 363.

POSITION PURPOSE

Performs support services for instructional programs in automotive technology by providing materials, supplies, equipment and related logistical support to lecture, laboratory and other instructional activities; issues, stores, and maintains laboratory materials, equipment and related supplies. Supervision is provided by assigned supervisor or manager. Technical and functional work direction may also be provided by instructional or higher level classified staff.

DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS

This class is assigned a wide range of supply, storage, and maintenance duties within an instructional automotive laboratory and related facilities. Positions in this class are distinguished from those in the next higher level by performing services that are well-structured and for which incumbents are provided specific training, guidelines, and instructions in contrast to the next higher level which provides greater diversity of service and requires greater judgment because of the diversity. Incumbents in this class usually work independently without the supervisor being present and are expected to follow the procedures and guidelines that have been furnished. Work may involve preparation of materials such as mixing of solutions or simple changing of materials from the state in which they are purchased; such preparation is expected to follow guidelines using skills or methods that can be learned on the job.

Key Duties And Responsibilities

Maintain orderliness and security of the supply room and equipment storage area and assist with the general maintenance of assigned laboratory facilities.
Assemble materials for laboratory exercises and demonstrations.
Pick up and deliver supplies, materials and equipment to designated work area.
Dispense equipment, materials, and supplies which support laboratory or lecture activities; collect and account for supplies and equipment.
Inspect supplies and equipment for damage and proper operation; dispose of defective supplies or see that defective supplies and/or equipment are repaired.
Perform routine repair and maintenance work on various tools, electrical and mechanical equipment.
Assist with periodic inventory and maintaining accurate stock levels of materials and supplies.
Receive, stock, and maintain supplies, materials and equipment.
Prepare student kits from storeroom materials/supplies for class projects.
Assist students as necessary in the set up, and proper and safe use of equipment; answer routine questions regarding equipment operation.
Maintain simple records, logs, and reports.
Perform related duties as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

Tools, equipment, materials and supplies which are used in an automotive facility and their proper and safe handling.
Supply and inventory procedures for the effective maintenance of stock levels.
Modern office practices and procedures including filing and the operation of office equipment including computers.

Skills And Ability To

Observe safety precautions when using hazardous equipment, materials and supplies.
Apply language skills to read and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence, and memos.
Write simple correspondence; and effectively present information in one-on-one and small group situations to other employees or students.
Apply mathematical skills to calculate numbers, fractions, and decimals; perform mathematical operations using units of American money and weight measurement, volume, and distance.
Utilize reasoning skills to apply commonsense understanding to carry out detailed but uninvolved written or oral instructions and deal with problems involving a few concrete variables in standardized situations.
Effectively communicate and interact with persons of diverse backgrounds and abilities.
Establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with those contacted in the course of work.
Lift and move up to 50 pounds.

Required Qualifications

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

One-year certificate program from college or technical school; OR three to six months of related experience and/or training; OR equivalent combination of education and experience.

Licenses And Certificates

Possession of a valid Class C California Driver's License

Success integrating diversity as appropriate into the major duties outlined in the job description and in the duties listed in the District's hiring policy; or demonstrated equivalent transferable skills to do so.

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in software engineering, logical reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Ideal Background:

This role is ideal for engineers who have built production systems at companies like Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Meta, or similar high-scale engineering organizations. We especially welcome graduates from top computer science programs such as Stanford, MIT, Carnegie Mellon, UC Berkeley, Georgia Tech, and comparable institutions — though exceptional experience and skill always take precedence over pedigree.

Project Overview:

As a Software Engineering evaluator, you will create cutting-edge datasets for training, benchmarking, and advancing large language models, collaborating closely with researchers. This includes curating code examples, providing precise solutions, and making corrections — with a primary focus on Python across backend services, data pipelines, and ML infrastructure, alongside JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C++, Java, Rust, and Go. You will evaluate and refine AI-generated code for efficiency, scalability, and reliability, and work with cross-functional teams to enhance enterprise-level AI-driven coding solutions.

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

Work on AI model training initiatives by curating code examples, building solutions, and correcting code — primarily in Python, with additional work in JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C++, Java, Rust, and Go.
Evaluate and refine AI-generated code to ensure that it is efficient, scalable, and reliable.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance AI-driven coding solutions against industry performance benchmarks.
Build agents and automated verification tools in Python that can verify the quality of code and identify error patterns.
Hypothesize on steps in the software engineering cycle (prototyping, architecture design, API design, production implementation, launch, experiments, monitoring, operational maintenance) and evaluate model capabilities on them.
Design verification mechanisms that can automatically verify a solution to a software engineering task.

Required Skills:

Several years of software engineering experience (3 years or more)
Strong expertise in Python with deep knowledge of frameworks, tooling, and best practices for building production-grade software.
Experience building full-stack applications and deploying scalable software using modern languages and tools.
Deep understanding of software architecture, design, development, debugging, and code quality/review assessment.
Excellent oral and written communication skills for clear, structured evaluation rationales.

Engagement Details:

Commitment: flexible engagement, minimum 10 hrs/week, up to 40 hrs/week
Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave)
Duration: 1 month (potential extensions based on performance and fit)
Location: Candidates must be based in the United States

Evaluation Process:

The application process takes 15–30 minutes.
Completion of an AI video interview is required.

jobs.title: Sr. CAD PLM Support Engineer
jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

Tesla's Vehicle Engineering department is composed of thousands of the world's best vehicle, battery, and manufacturing engineers. These engineers are responsible for the mechanical and industrial design of all major programs, for example, batteries, Optimus, Robotaxi, and all new factories. Design Technology, which is part of Vehicle Engineering, is responsible for making the tools these engineers use every bit as intelligent and dynamic as the products themselves.

As a PLM Quality & Support Engineer on the Design Technology team, you will own the accuracy of the Engineering BOM in and outside our PLM systems. Teams across Tesla depend on that data every day, from the design engineers creating our next products to the factory line itself. When something looks wrong, you decide whether it's a system defect or user error, find the root cause, and make sure it doesn't happen again.

Joining our team means directly impacting Tesla's ability to communicate critical design data as the company scales to ship millions of products a year from factories around the world.

 **What You'll Do**

* Validate EBOM and file data against the design intent in our PLM systems of record. Catch errors before they reach suppliers and factory lines
* Run migration and release checks, and validate changes to customer-facing data before they ship
* Triage defects end to end. Tell system issues from user error, find the root cause, and hand engineering a defect report they can act on
* Be first-line support for engineers, buyers, and supplier-facing teams on access, missing files, and BOM mismatches
* Teach software engineers the PLM concepts behind the data: part revisions, primary and replica objects, maturity states, change actions, and configuration
* Automate the checks you run more than twice, with scripts and coding agents, so validation scales with release volume
* Write everything down so the work is visible: runbooks, known issues, and the reasoning behind each fix

  
**What You'll Bring**

* Hands-on experience with a PLM system (3DEXPERIENCE/Enovia, Teamcenter, Windchill, or equivalent) in an engineering or manufacturing setting
* Deep understanding of EBOM structure, part and drawing revisions, and engineering change processes
* A track record of root-causing data problems across multiple systems, not just reporting them
* SQL and at least one scripting language (Python preferred) to query data and automate checks
* Comfort reading API responses (REST or gRPC) and logs to see where data went wrong
* Clear written communication with both software engineers and non-technical users
* Daily use of AI tools or coding agents to speed up analysis and automation, preferred
* CATIA/3DX experience, preferred
* Experience with supplier or manufacturing data exchange, preferred

#### **Benefits**

Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:

* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program
* Earned Wage Access: Real-time pay access paid daily, subject to eligibility and schedule (applicable for below Sr. Managers levels)

  

#### **Expected Compensation**

$100,000 - $204,000/annual salary + cash and stock awards + benefits

Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

jobs.description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Office

**Job Description**

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.  
  
DESCRIPTION:  
The Senior Manager – Data Engineering & Applied Data Science is responsible for leading the strategy, design, and delivery of enterprise data products, applied data science, and AI solutions that enable business growth and digital transformation. This role leads a multidisciplinary team responsible for Data Engineering and Applied Data Science, transforming business challenges into scalable, production-ready data and AI products.

The successful candidate combines strong technical leadership with business acumen to design data products that address business needs, build AI-ready data foundations, develop advanced analytics and machine learning solutions, and continuously evolve capabilities through the adoption of emerging technologies and engineering best practices. This role is also accountable for ensuring enterprise data is AI-ready—standardized, contextualized, governed, and optimized for analytics, machine learning, and Generative AI use cases.

* **Lead Data & AI Solution Delivery** – Translate business priorities into scalable enterprise data products, advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.
* **Drive Data Engineering Excellence** – Lead the design and delivery of reliable, secure, and scalable data pipelines and products while establishing engineering standards across DataOps, CI/CD, automation, observability, and cloud-native development.
* **Advance Applied Data Science & AI** – Guide the development and production deployment of machine learning, Generative AI, and advanced analytics solutions, including reusable frameworks and scalable AI capabilities.
* **Build AI-Ready Data Foundations** – Ensure enterprise data products are trusted, governed, contextualized, and optimized for analytics and AI through strong data quality, metadata, lineage, semantic models, and accessibility.
* **Shape Technology Strategy & Innovation** – Develop technology roadmaps and evaluate emerging technologies and architectural patterns that accelerate AI adoption, improve engineering productivity, and strengthen enterprise data capabilities.
* **Lead Teams & Strategic Partnerships** – Build and develop high-performing Data Engineering and Applied Data Science teams while partnering across business, architecture, platform, security, and technology functions to align priorities, communicate outcomes, and drive execution.  
    
  REQUIREMENTS:  
  + Advanced Degree plus 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of experience in data science and analytics leadership roles
  + Preferred Fields of Study: Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Analytics, or related field
  + Advanced certifications in data science, machine learning, or AI technologies are valued
  + Strong expertise in machine learning, AI, and statistical modeling techniques
  + Advanced proficiency in programming languages including Python, R, and SQL
  + Experience with major AI/ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn)
  + Demonstrated success leading and mentoring data science teams
  + Expertise in data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI) and BI platforms
  + Proven track record of implementing large-scale data science solutions
  + Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and big data technologies
  + Strong knowledge of data governance and regulatory compliance
  + Excellent project management and cross-functional collaboration skills
  + Outstanding communication abilities to translate technical concepts for diverse audiences
  + Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies
  + Ability to travel up to 20% as needed
  + Proven ability to deliver business results through data-driven insights
  + Experience with automation tools and process optimization
  + Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking capabilities

**Compensation and Benefits**

The salary range estimated for this position based in California is $152,000.00–$227,900.00.

This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards

Overview:

At Montclair Hospital Medical Center, our dedicated team of professionals are committed to our core values of quality, compassion, and community. As a member of the Prime Healthcare Foundation, Montclair Hospital Medical Center is actively seeking new members to join its award-winning team!  
  
Founded in 1973, Montclair Hospital, a 106-bed acute care, not-for-profit community hospital, received the “100 Top Hospital” in the nation award from IBM Watson Health, the Patient Safety Excellence award from Healthgrades®, and the Women's Choice Award® for America's Best Emergency Care. The Certified Phlebotomy Technician I, under California Business and Professions Code section 1246, primarily perform skin puncture or venipuncture on patients of all ages for the purpose of obtaining a blood specimen for analysis in the clinical laboratory and is under the supervision of Laboratory Director / Manager / Supervisor.

This individual: 1) performs computer data entry, filing, telephone communication and other clerical duties, 2) possesses adequate knowledge of the terminology of tests ordered in the laboratory, 3) demonstrates good communication skills and telephone etiquette in greeting patients and other visitors in a polite and friendly manner, 4) demonstrates proper phlebotomy technique and the use of equipment in collecting specimens from newborns to geriatric patients, 5) processes microbiology, immunology, hematology, coagulation, urinalysis, chemistry and blood bank specimens, 6) processes specimens for referral to reference laboratories, 7) stocks routine supplies, 8) maintains the cleanliness of storage areas, trays, centrifuges, refrigerators, freezers and work areas, 9) processes or load specimens on automated laboratory instrumentation in accordance with established policy and procedures, 10) may be assist to Pick up samples at hospital/ OR, assist lab specialty in sorting out samples for analysis and put away samples, assist pathology, inventory, replenish supplies, order supplies, mail pick up/ delivery, faxing, answering phone, product deliveries, etc.. 11) other tasks or responsibilities may be assigned by the department manager/director.
