jobs.description:
**Position Summary**:

Blackburn Consulting (Blackburn) is seeking a full-time Senior Technician for our Construction Materials Testing Laboratory. The Senior Technician will manage day-to-day lab testing operations of Blackburn’s West Sacramento Construction Materials Testing Laboratory. The Senior Technician will be supervised by Blackburn’s Construction Services Laboratory Manager. This candidate shall have at least five years of experience performing construction materials laboratory tests in accordance with ASTM, AASHTO and Caltrans test methods, and at least three years of experience managing supervising laboratory technicians, entering data, and generating test result reports for soil, aggregates, concrete and hot mix asphalt., and running the day-to-day operations of a materials testing laboratory. This position may require some limited travel (<15%) to project sites or other testing laboratories to pick up and deliver samples.

**Blackburn Company Overview:**

Blackburn Consulting provides geotechnical, geo-environmental, construction, forensics and laboratory testing services throughout California with offices in Auburn, West Sacramento, Sausalito, Fresno, and Escondido. We have an extensive geotechnical and materials testing lab in West Sacramento, CA and additional lab capabilities in Sausalito, Fresno, and Escondido. We focus primarily on public works projects in the flood control and transportation market sectors.

Blackburn Consulting was founded in 1998, and is employee owned and operated. We have established an excellent reputation in California by being responsive to our clients while dedicating the time to provide the highest quality service. We pride ourselves in our family-like work environment and company culture. Our employees strive for constant improvement. The majority of our staff have built long-term careers at Blackburn. Everyone here has the opportunity to make a big impact!

**Position Duties:**

* Complete laboratory test schedules within deadlines and in accordance with appropriate testing methods.
* Work in coordination with the Construction Services Laboratory Manager and Geotechnical Laboratory Manager with overall laboratory management including equipment maintenance, certification renewals, equipment verifications and calibrations, space and sample management, and laboratory organization/cleaning.
* Communicate with Blackburn managers and field technicians to provide input on proper laboratory test selection, test interpretation, test results, and test schedules.
* Schedule lab tests.
* Supervise lab technicians.
* Provide training to new laboratory staff.
* Enter laboratory test data into the lab information management system, generate test reports, circulate test results for review and provide final copies to the Blackburn manager in charge of the project.

**Essential Abilities:**

* Perform typical calculations associated with laboratory tests.
* Communication skills internally and externally.
* Multi-task between projects.
* Ability to deliver a high-quality deliverable in a timely manner.
* People management skills.
* Excellent organizational skills.
* Flexible schedule.

**Technical Qualifications:**

* High school degree. Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* At least five years of relevant experience.
* Valid driver’s license and personal vehicle.
* Experience with standard computer operations (Windows based systems).
* Certification by ACI, Caltrans, or NICET highly encouraged.
* Caltrans certifications through JPCP is desired.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Read, write, and speak English
* Communicate clearly in person and over telephone
* Visual acuity to perform job duties
* Physical ability to bend, reach, stand, walk, sit, push and pull up to 40lbs amounts of weight

Blackburn Consulting provides an Equal Employment Opportunity for all applicants and employees, and does not discriminate on any basis protected by local, state, or federal laws, including, but not limited to, race, color, religion, sex, gender, origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, military status, or marital status.

jobs.description:
Caltech is a world-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community.

#### **Job Summary**

The Zwicky Transient Facility (ZTF) enables a wide range of time-domain astronomy through large-scale astronomical data processing and the distribution of more than half a million transient alerts each night. The next phase of this work will integrate ZTF and upcoming Rubin Observatory data streams and develop tools that allow scientists to build, test, and manage complex alert filters through accessible graph-based interfaces. The Associate Research Technician will contribute to the development and testing of these tools, including integration with SkyPortal and public alert brokers. This is a one-year term appointment expected to start in October 2026.

#### **Essential Job Duties**

* Develop and enhance JavaScript/React user-interface tools for building complex astronomical alert filters using graph-based and drag-and-drop components.
* Develop and test Python and/or JavaScript software that converts graph-based filters into MongoDB and SQL queries.
* Develop and maintain Python integrations that connect relational databases with astronomical data streams and alert brokers through APIs or Kafka.
* Work with scientists to define requirements, troubleshoot moderately complex technical issues, test solutions, and improve system capabilities and user experience.

#### **Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field and 2–4 years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. A relevant master’s degree may substitute for up to two years of experience.
* Experience using Git/GitHub and collaborative software-development workflows.
* Demonstrated programming experience in Python and JavaScript.
* Experience working with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, such as PostgreSQL or MongoDB.
* Experience developing and testing user-facing software, including UI/UX design principles.

jobs.title: Quality Control Technician
jobs.description:
**Location:** Mountain View, CA

**About Rune:**

Every solar and wind power plant is a latent data center. Rune connects wasted power to the compute that needs it. Solar plants generate electricity the grid can't take: clipped by inverters, curtailed by operators, gone before it ever reaches a meter. Meanwhile, AI needs more power than new construction can deliver in time.

Rune deploys hardware, software, and financial solutions to put this power to work. We build modular micro data centers that install directly at solar sites, bypassing the traditional grid entirely and turning stranded power into compute. We're backed by Spark Capital, Union Square Ventures, and Lowercarbon Capital.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Quality Control Technician to support product quality throughout the manufacturing and receiving processes. This role will be responsible for performing final inspection and testing, verifying the accuracy and completeness of product travelers and manufacturing documentation, conducting incoming and receiving inspections, and supporting inventory audits.

You’ll be the last line of defense on product quality, covering inspection and testing, documentation checks, and receiving. You’ll also own the reporting that shows how quality is trending. This is a growth role: the right person can move into Quality Engineering as we scale.

**Responsibilities**

**1. Final Inspection and Product Testing**

* Perform functional, dimensional, and visual inspections against specs, drawings, and acceptance criteria, and document the results
* Verify finished products meet requirements before release or shipment
* Keep measuring and test equipment calibrated and in good working condition

**2. Product Travelers and Manufacturing Documentation**

* Review travelers, work orders, and inspection records for completeness, accuracy, and proper sign-off sequence
* Resolve missing information or process deviations with the responsible teams before product release
* Keep quality records organized and easy to retrieve

**3. Incoming and Receiving Inspection**

* Inspect incoming materials and parts against POs, drawings, specs, and certifications (part numbers, revisions, quantities)
* Report discrepancies and damaged or nonconforming material, and work with Purchasing and the Warehouse on disposition
* Track recurring supplier issues and trends

**4. Inventory Audits and Traceability**

* Run periodic audits to verify part identification, quantities, condition, and lot/serial traceability
* Reconcile physical inventory to system records and investigate discrepancies
* Flag expired, damaged, or improperly identified material for resolution

**5. Quality Reporting, Excel, and KPI Tracking**

* Build and maintain Excel reports and dashboards covering pass/fail rates, nonconformance trends, incoming quality, and documentation completion
* Deliver routine status reports on inspections, open quality issues, and product readiness
* Analyze data to spot recurring issues and communicate findings to management

**6. Nonconformance and Continuous Improvement**

* Identify, document, and segregate nonconforming product, and support investigations, root cause analysis, and CAPA
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Engineering, and Supply Chain to resolve quality concerns
* Help improve inspection procedures, checklists, and work instructions

**Required Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; technical training, an associate degree, or relevant coursework in quality, manufacturing, engineering, or a related field is preferred.
* Previous experience in quality control, manufacturing inspection, receiving inspection, or a related technical role.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel including the ability to organize, analyze, and present data and generate status reports and KPI summaries.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify discrepancies in products, processes, and documentation.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, work instructions, and inspection criteria.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple inspection and documentation priorities.
* Ability to work collaboratively across Quality, Manufacturing, Engineering, Warehouse, and Supply Chain teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with dimensional inspection tools, measurement equipment, and functional test equipment.
* Familiarity with manufacturing documentation, product travelers, inspection plans, and product traceability.
* Experience with ERP, inventory management, or quality management systems.
* Familiarity with quality management standards such as ISO 9001 or other applicable industry standards.
* Exposure to nonconformance reporting, root cause analysis, corrective actions, or continuous improvement methodologies.
* Advanced Excel functions, pivot tables, lookup functions, charts, conditional formatting, and data visualization.
* Familiarity with statistical process control (SPC), failure analysis, or other quality engineering tools.

**Success in this role will be measured by:**  
Excelling in inspection, documentation, receiving, and reporting. As you prove out, take on root cause analysis, process improvement, and quality systems you can work on the path to Quality Engineer. This position is intended for someone who wants to build a long-term career in quality. We are looking for someone who can perform today's quality control responsibilities reliably while demonstrating the curiosity, analytical thinking, and initiative to help improve our quality processes for the future.

Pay: $50,000.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Referral program
* Vision insurance

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Job Description

Idaho National Laboratory (INL) is hiring a well-qualified Postdoctoral Research Associate in Instrumentation and Control Engineering for the Department of Plant Optimization. This postdoctoral researcher will support INL’s research and development (R&D) activities directed at introducing digital technologies (e.g., instrumentation, control, superintelligence, machine learning, and robotics) for use in the commercial nuclear power sector, facilitating the transformation from highly labor-intensive to a human-led, digital/automation-centric approach to plant operation and maintenance. Our team works a 9 x 80 schedule located out of Idaho Falls facility with every other Friday off.

This position requires a proactive and creative individual capable of contributing to our interdisciplinary R&D team, both independently and collaboratively. The candidate should be adept at efficiently completing tasks as directed by project managers, principal investigators, and other team members. An excellent postdoctoral researcher will bring fresh insights that help our team propose innovative ideas, overcome challenges, and enhance the impact of our work. The position also entails writing scientific manuscripts for journal publication and milestone reports and presenting research findings at conferences and meetings.

Required

PhD in Electrical, Mechanical, or Nuclear Engineering or comparable disciplines
PhD requirements must be completed by commencement of appointment and within the previous 5 years
Demonstrated oral and published written communication skills in English
Experience in one or more of the following areas:
Design, analysis, modification, or evaluation of digital I&C systems
Programmable logic controllers, distributed control systems, field-programmable gate arrays, embedded digital devices, and industrial communication network
Development of experimental testbeds, including integrating digital hardware and software
Digital system architectures, including redundancy, independence, separation, defense-in-depth, diversity, and failure-mode analysis
Proficiency in one or more programming or engineering-analysis languages and tools, such as Python, C/C++, MATLAB/Simulink, and LabVIEW.

The Ideal Candidate Will Possess

Experience in one or more of the following areas:
Software or system development life-cycle activities, including requirements development, design, implementation, integration, verification, validation, and testing
Evaluation of software, firmware, communication systems, and digital system reliability and cybersecurity
Safety-related or important-to-safety digital systems used in nuclear power plants, research reactors, or other safety-critical facilities
Superintelligence and machine learning, including large language models
Robotics and computer vision, including vision language models

Physical Requirements

While performing the duties of this classification, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, stoop, kneel, bend, and work in an office and field environment, which may include construction sites. The Data Analyst II oversees activities related to data integrity, security and enhancement of the value of data. Plan, organize, conduct, and communicate data-intensive analysis and research within the overall scope of cardiovascular disease prevention, economic evaluation, maternal health disparities, and health equity.

Engage in data management, regression-based data analysis, and manuscript writing
Guide and mentor research interns
Communicate and work with internal and external collaborators.

Ready to make a real-world impact with your skills? At Helix, we're transforming healthcare by making genomics a standard of care. You'll bridge the gap between genomic variants and the clinical answers that help patients act on their DNA. You'll serve as the scientific authority on automation and AI for gene and variant curation. Design and prototype automated approaches to annotation, evidence synthesis, and pre-classification of germline variants that can support clinical applications at scale.

Deep expertise in human molecular genetics, ACMG/AMP variant interpretation guidelines, and clinical databases such as ClinVar and gnomAD.

jobs.title: Research Associate, Cell Line Development Automation
jobs.description:
Prolific Machines is ushering in a new era of biotechnology with light. Our first-of-its-kind optogenetic platform delivers unprecedented control, precisely guiding cellular behavior when and where it matters most. Unlike existing tools used to control biology, our technology enables dynamic, tunable control over virtually any cellular function in any cell type. We're enabling partners to unlock robust efficiency, quality, and reproducibility advantages across the most complex pharmaceuticals and therapeutic proteins. Prolific is supported by leading investors, including Bill Gates’s Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Mayfield and SOSV.

We are seeking a motivated Research Associate II or Senior Research Associate to join our Automation/Cell Line Development (CLD) team, with a focus on laboratory automation and high-throughput workflows. In this role, you will develop and optimize automated workflows to support cell line development, contribute to pipeline projects, and conduct experiments to improve the performance of our optogenetic Chinese Hamster Ovary (CHO) cell lines. You will work at the intersection of laboratory automation, cell culture, and molecular biology, helping improve the efficiency, scalability, and reproducibility of our CLD processes. This role is based on-site at our headquarters in Emeryville, CA.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Conduct experiments independently, collect and analyze data in a timely manner, and maintain detailed documentation in electronic lab notebooks.
* Conduct experiments at the Automation/CLD interface and establish efficient automation workflows (Tecan or Hamilton) for CLD processes during seed train, production, or screening (Ambr or Beacon) processes.
* Communicate successfully with any team, demonstrating the ability to compile and present across different teams and forums within the company.
* Quickly analyze and provide critical data and figures to support presentations, patent applications, or publications.
* Collaborate closely with members of the CLD team as well as other teams within Prolific Machines. Contribute to lab maintenance and safety as a good lab citizen.
* Develop and optimize analytical methods, ensuring adherence to safety and operational standards, following established protocols, and providing data for regulatory submissions.
* This is a lab-based position, and onsite presence is required as dictated by Automation and Cell Line Development (CLD) responsibilities and experimental needs.

### **About You:**

**Qualifications:**

* **Education & Experience**: A Bachelor's degree with 2-5+ years of relevant industry experience or a Master's degree with 1-4+ years of relevant experience is expected for an RA II position. Additional experience and increased independence expected at the Sr. RA level.
* **Designing and Executing Experiments**: Developing and proposing experimental plans, conducting experiments, and troubleshooting analytical techniques and methodologies
* **Work Style**: The candidate is expected to precisely follow protocols, design and execute experiments independently, and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced setting.
* **Communication Skills**: Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential for documenting findings and effective collaboration. Familiarity with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) or Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) software and ability to perform independent data analysis and generating meaningful conclusions is required.

**Technical Experience:**

* Experience with cell line development workflows (pool generation, clonal isolation, stability testing).
* Experience with automation systems used during CLD processes (scripting experience on the Tecan or Hamilton would be an added plus).
* Exposure to high-throughput screening platforms (e.g., Beacon, Ambr, Octet, Cedex, and other regularly used Automation systems).
* Experience with molecular cloning and molecular biology techniques (PCR, protein quantification).
* Working knowledge of statistical analysis or design of experiments (DoE). Comfort working in a dynamic, fast-paced R&D environment.

jobs.description:
Research Assistant — Clinical Research

**Position Overview**  
The Research Assistant supports the daily operations of clinical research studies under the supervision of the Lead Clinical Research Coordinator and Principal Investigator. This position assists with participant recruitment, visit preparation, study documentation, data entry, and administrative tasks. The ideal candidate is organized, detail oriented, dependable, and committed to participant confidentiality and accurate work.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Assist with identifying and prescreening potential participants using approved materials and study-specific procedures.
* Schedule study visits, send appointment reminders, and coordinate participant follow-up.
* Prepare participant binders, visit packets, study supplies, and examination rooms.
* Assist research coordinators during study visits and perform assigned procedures within documented training, qualifications, and delegation.
* Enter study data into electronic systems and assist with resolving discrepancies under coordinator supervision.
* Maintain organized, accurate, and complete study files, logs, and regulatory documentation.
* Request, track, and organize medical records and other study-related documents.
* Assist with laboratory kit inventory, supply tracking, and specimen handling or shipping when appropriately trained.
* Support participant completion of study questionnaires and electronic diaries.
* Promptly communicate participant concerns, reported symptoms, and study-related issues to the research coordinator or investigator.
* Assist with preparation for monitoring visits, audits, and study closeout activities.
* Protect confidential participant and study information and follow site policies and study procedures.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent; coursework or a degree in health sciences, biology, psychology, or a related field preferred.
* Current phlebotomy and/or medical assistant certification

* Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and follow written instructions.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, email, and basic computer applications.
* Accurate data entry and recordkeeping skills.
* Ability to work independently on assigned tasks and collaboratively with the research team.
* Willingness to complete required study, privacy, and Good Clinical Practice training.

About the Role:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Master Parts List (MPL) / Change Management Engineer to support prototype and production build activities within an automotive/EV engineering environment. This role will be responsible for creating, maintaining, and validating Master Parts Lists, ensuring alignment between engineering Bills of Materials (BOMs), manufacturing requirements, and internal systems.
The ideal candidate will work closely with engineering, prototype development, supply chain, warehouse, production, and partner teams to resolve data discrepancies, manage engineering changes, track part availability, and provide accurate part status throughout the build lifecycle.

Master Parts List (MPL) Management & Validation
Create, maintain, and validate Master Parts Lists (MPLs) for various vehicle builds in collaboration with internal engineering teams and external partners.
Ensure MPL accuracy through regular Bill of Materials (BOM) to MPL alignment and reconciliation checks.
Collaborate with Prototype Engineering to incorporate process-related and build-specific data into the MPL.
Perform routine validations, including weekly data audits, to maintain MPL accuracy and completeness.
Identify and resolve discrepancies between engineering data, MPLs, BOMs, and other related systems.
Maintain accurate part information throughout the prototype and build lifecycle.

Change Management & System Alignment
Manage engineering and configuration changes by reviewing, approving, and executing Change Management (CM) tickets.
Analyze, debug, and correlate data transferred between multiple engineering, manufacturing, and enterprise systems.
Investigate data inconsistencies and coordinate with appropriate stakeholders to implement corrective actions.
Ensure changes are accurately reflected across applicable systems and documentation.
Partner with warehouse and material teams to regularly communicate and update part availability and status.

jobs.title: Biomedical Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Date Written: October 7, 2026
Location: Remote, Full-time
Department: Scientific/Research/Clinical
Reports to: Director Preclinical Initiatives
Wage Category: Exempt
The Children’s Tumor Foundation (CTF) is not a traditional research foundation. We operate as a patient-centered drug discovery engine for NF, a group of genetic conditions that cause tumors to grow on nerves affecting 1 in 2,000 individuals. We operate by accelerating the full continuum of scientific discovery, from basic research through translation to clinical trials and approved treatments — while empowering patients and building the financial infrastructure to support that journey. We catalyze progress by uniting academia, industry, regulators, and patient advocates around shared goals.
General Summary
The Biomedical Data Scientist will drive CTF’s efforts to turn neurofibromatosis (NF) data into actionable insights for drug discovery, positioning the Foundation as a leader in NF data. Working closely with CTF’s Science teams, this role integrates research, clinical and publicly available data to identify and prioritize therapeutic opportunities across NF1, NF2 -related schwannomatosis, and non NF2 -related schwannomatosis. The Biomedical Data Scientist will also work closely with vendors to steward CTF’s NF data ecosystem, lead CTF’s AI-enabled research resource for the NF community, and share data and findings with the broader research community. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with strong technical skills in bioinformatics, data integration, analysis, and visualization, strong writing skills, and a passion for advancing NF research.
Principal Duties and Responsibilities
NF Data Ecosystem Stewardship: Serve as CTF’s subject matter expert for the NF Data Portal and associated analysis platforms. Work with data vendors and external data partners to track data sharing plans and milestones, identify new data sources, and ensure the quality, integrity, accessibility, and reuse of NF datasets. Manage subscriptions to various platforms.
Data-Driven Target Discovery: Lead integrated analyses of genomic, molecular, clinical, imaging, and publicly available datasets to identify, prioritize, and validate therapeutic targets for NF. Work closely with CTF’s Drug Scout and Preclinical Initiatives teams and with NF researchers to translate findings into therapeutic hypotheses, target recommendations, and opportunities for preclinical validation. Create clear visualizations and summaries that inform CTF’s research recommendations.
AI-Enabled Research: Evaluate and apply emerging AI and computational approaches to accelerate NF data integration and hypothesis generation. Serve as administrator of CTF’s Anthropic (Claude) workspace for the NF community, leading its build-out by surfacing NF datasets, publications, and sample analyses, managing access, and gathering user feedback.
Community Engagement and Dissemination: Represent CTF and collaborate with Key Opinion Leaders to author peer-reviewed publications and present findings at conferences. Implement and manage data science workshops and platform sessions at the NF Conference, contribute to open-source tools and resources for the NF research community, and promote NF data sharing and reuse. Additional duties as required.

Minimum Qualifications
MS in Data Science, Ph.D. preferred – Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, or a related field.
1-3 years experience in working with public and/or private datasets and large-scale data repositories.
Strong expertise in data management, analysis, and visualization techniques.
Experience implementing Claude Science or comparable AI research platforms, including using AI agents for literature review, data analysis, and reproducible computational workflows.
Demonstrated understanding of, and adherence to, HIPAA regulations and data privacy standards.
Proven track record of scientific publications and presentations.
Familiarity with open-source tool development and collaborative research environments.
Ability to work both independently and within a multidisciplinary team.
Excellent communication skills.
Strong organizational skills are needed, which reflect the ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks seamlessly with precise attention to detail.
Creative and analytical thinker.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience integrating multi-omic and clinical datasets for therapeutic target identification and prioritization.
Experience applying machine learning, AI, or large language model (LLM) tools to biomedical research questions.
Experience analyzing clinical, real-world, or patient registry data, including patient-reported outcomes.
Familiarity with neurofibromatosis or rare disease research.

Preferred Skills:
Programming: R and/or Python, Linux command line, cloud computing
Omics Analysis: bulk and single-cell RNA-seq, WGS/WES, proteomics, and methylation
Therapeutic Target Discovery Resources: pathway and network analysis, multi-omic integration, and experience with public resources like GEO, TCGA, GTEx, DepMap, ChEMBL, and Open Targets
Machine Learning and AI: Claude Science or other LLM-based platforms, experience with agentic AI like Claude Code
Data Visualization and Reporting: ggplot2, matplotlib, Shiny
Reproducible Research: Git/GitHub, Docker, Nextflow or Snakemake
Data Platforms and Standards Domain Knowledge: Synapse, which the NF Data Portal is built on, plus FAIR principles, metadata standards, and ontologies.

Working Conditions, Equipment Used, and Special Information
 Must have unimpeachable integrity and trustworthiness and possess remarkable tact, discretion, and professionalism. Verbal and written communication skills will be used daily. Maintains effectiveness under pressure. Ability to lift 25 lbs. Flexible for overnight business travel. Flexible to work evenings and weekends as needed.
Equal Employment Opportunity
CTF and ADP provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants in all Foundation facilities without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, pregnancy, childbirth, (or related medical conditions, including, but not limited to lactation), physical disability, mental and/or intellectual disability, age, military status or status as a Vietnam-era or special disabled veteran, marital status, registered domestic partner or civil union status, gender (including sex stereotyping and gender identity or expression), medical condition (including, but not limited to, cancer related or HIV/AIDS related), genetic information, or sexual orientation in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.
DISCLAIMER
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by the person assigned to this position. They are not intended to be considered an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required.
Please send inquiries/resume to Jennifer Ching, VP Human Resources – Jching@ctf.org

jobs.title: Head of Data Science, Intelligence Ventures
jobs.description:
This role requires the ability to work lawfully in the U.S. without employment-based immigration sponsorship, now or in the future.

The Head of Data Science builds the models that turn a new AI-native behavioral intelligence platform into products customers buy, and proves to those customers that the products work. At the core of the platform, part of Spectrum Intelligence Ventures, is a proprietary transformer-based model that learns how households behave from network-scale signal and encodes that behavior as embeddings. Those embeddings are the foundation for audiences, insights, measurement, and data licenses sold to brands, agencies, and ad tech, media, and AI platforms. Over the next 18 to 24 months, this leader’s job is to get that portfolio to market and make it stand up to buyer scrutiny: build the predictive models and products on top of the embedding layer, set the evidence standard buyers will test them against, and work alongside product and sales to scope pilots, answer technical buyers, and convert evaluations into contracts. In parallel, this leader owns the direction of the embedding model itself, working with the Head of Technology and external development partners, and is accountable for showing that it delivers performance conventional approaches cannot. The Head of Data Science builds and leads the data science team, sits on the platform leadership team, and reports directly to the Head of Intelligence Ventures.

How The Head Of Data Science Makes An Impact

Build and run the predictive models behind the platform’s audience and data products, including in-market, life-stage, purchase propensity, category interest, lifestyle affinity, and behavioral velocity models scored daily at the household level across more than two dozen verticals. Own segment definitions, coverage, refresh cadence, and measured accuracy for every audience the platform sells, whether through Spectrum Reach, DSP data marketplaces, or partner platforms.
Own the platform’s Feature Store as a commercial product: named, typed, versioned, and documented features that serve audiences, insights, measurement, and partner models. Lead the outcome anchoring program that trains and calibrates models against licensed third-party outcome data (vehicle registrations, mortgage originations, card and SKU-level retail spend, travel bookings, and similar sources) so that propensity scores mean what they say, and automate feature creation as new signal sources come online.
Lead the modeling behind custom and partner-specific audiences, including seed-based lookalike expansion, profile-based audience construction, and site- or CRM-seeded models that identify households entering a brand’s purchase path before they reach the brand. Establish repeatable, clean-room-based workflows with transparent match rates, expansion multiples, and performance against the buyer’s own baseline.
Design and defend the platform’s measurement methodology, including exposed-versus-control campaign lift using matched behavioral controls, test-and-holdout incrementality, and closed-loop validation against real-world outcomes. Define the journey, demand, and category metrics that power insights subscriptions and aggregate demand indices, built to withstand scrutiny from brand marketing science teams, agency analytics groups, and measurement partners.
Lead the data science behind the platform’s identity and viewing products: the adjudication and confidence calibration methods that verify partner household graphs against network ground truth, and the household viewing-state, trajectory, and reachability models that underpin viewing intelligence for programmers, agencies, and measurement companies.
Direct the roadmap for the platform’s proprietary transformer-based behavioral embedding model, a multi-entity architecture that encodes both a stable household profile and short-term intent, working with the Head of Technology and external development partners on architecture, training, and refresh. Hold the embedding layer to a commercial standard: measured lift over attribute-only and engineered-feature baselines in the audiences, lookalikes, measurement, and partner models it feeds.
Establish the evaluation, MLOps, and responsible AI standards for every model the platform ships, including evaluation cards that state accuracy, calibration, and coverage in a form buyers can cite; automated release gates; monitoring and drift detection; bias and fairness testing; and privacy-preserving techniques such as audience floors, differential privacy, and adversarial testing, in partnership with Legal and Privacy.
Serve as the senior data science voice with customers and partners, including brand analytics and insights leaders, agency data science teams, and DSPs, identity providers, measurement companies, and AI platforms. Scope pilots and evaluations with product, sales, and solutions teams, and translate methodology into clear commercial proof points.
Build and lead a team of data scientists, ML engineers, and measurement scientists matched to the work ahead: strong in applied predictive modeling and measurement, with the deep learning depth to take greater ownership of the embedding layer over time. Set hiring priorities, operating cadence, and a culture of rigorous experimentation with a clear bias toward production deployment and revenue impact.

Required Qualifications

Proven record leading data science for data, audience, identity, targeting, or measurement products in the advertising, media, or marketing ecosystem, where models are packaged, priced, sold, and renewed by external buyers
Deep, hands-on expertise in predictive modeling on consumer-level data at scale, including propensity and response modeling, classification, gradient boosting, regression, calibration, segmentation and clustering, and lookalike modeling, with sound judgment about which method fits the commercial problem
Strong grounding in measurement and causal inference, including incrementality testing, matched and synthetic controls, test-and-holdout design, and the practical limits of attribution and media mix approaches
Working knowledge of identity and data collaboration: household and device graphs, onboarding and match rates, clean rooms (Snowflake, LiveRamp, AWS, or equivalent), identity namespaces such as RampID and UID2, and the use of licensed third-party data in modeling
Command of the full data science lifecycle in production, from feature engineering through training, validation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration, at large dataset scale (billions, even trillions of records); experience designing feature stores and scoring pipelines that serve audiences and partner deliveries
Hands-on proficiency with Python, SQL, and distributed data processing (Spark or equivalent); experience running ML workloads on Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, or equivalent cloud platforms
Solid working knowledge of deep learning and representation learning, including embeddings, sequence models, and transformers, sufficient to direct an embedding roadmap with external partners, set its evaluation standards, and put embeddings to work as features in downstream models
Familiarity with privacy-preserving analytics and consumer data regulation, including aggregation thresholds, differential privacy, and consent management; comfortable working alongside Legal and Privacy on product design
Ability to explain methodology clearly to executives, sellers, and buyers, and to defend it under scrutiny from sophisticated technical counterparts in external partner and customer conversations
Track record of building and growing high-performing data science teams, ideally from an early stage, and recruiting senior talent in competitive markets
Curiosity about the application of AI to consumer intelligence, including how foundation models and AI agents can draw on behavioral context to make better decisions

Required Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related quantitative field

Preferred Education

Master’s degree or PhD in Statistics, Machine Learning, Econometrics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative discipline; an advanced degree is valued but not required, and a record of applied commercial impact is weighted equally

Required Related Work Experience And Number Of Years

Experience leading applied data science or analytics teams that build data, audience, identity, or measurement products: 7 years
Hands-on predictive modeling, machine learning, or measurement science on consumer-level data at scale: 10 years

Preferred Related Work Experience And Number Of Years

Senior data science leadership at a data, identity, audience, or measurement company in the advertising and media ecosystem (e.g., LiveRamp, Merkle, Epsilon, Acxiom, Experian, TransUnion, Nielsen, Circana, Comscore, The Trade Desk, or specialty analytics and measurement firms): 10 years
Applied deep learning or representation learning (embeddings, sequence models) deployed in production on consumer behavioral data: 3 years
Work with TV and video viewership data, cross-screen measurement, or identity graph quality evaluation: 3 years

WORKING CONDITIONS

In-office position preferably based in New York City

Job#: 3056636

Job Description:

CAD Technician

Location:
New York, New York (On-site)

COMPENSATION: $36 - $46 HOURLY

Role Overview

This employer is seeking a skilled CAD Technician to design and lay out complex, multi-layer printed circuit boards (PCBs) ranging from 4 to over 16 layers. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with electrical and mechanical engineering teams to translate schematics into optimized board layouts while ensuring signal integrity, power integrity, and thermal performance. This role requires meticulous attention to detail to manage design revisions and maintain library components within a professional engineering environment.

Key Responsibilities

Design and lay out complex, multi-layer PCBs (4–16+ layers) using Altium Designer, from schematic capture through production release.
Collaborate with electrical engineers to translate schematics into optimized board layouts, ensuring signal integrity, power integrity, and thermal performance.
Perform component placement and routing for high-speed digital, mixed-signal, and power electronics designs.
Define board stackups, impedance-controlled trace geometries, and via structures in coordination with PCB fabricators.
Create and maintain component libraries, footprints, and schematic symbols in Altium Designer.
Generate complete manufacturing output packages including Gerbers, drill files, assembly drawings, pick-and-place files, and bills of materials (BOMs).
Conduct Design Rule Checks (DRC) and Design for Manufacturability (DFM) reviews prior to release.
Work with mechanical engineering to ensure board form factors, connector placements, and mounting features meet enclosure and system-level constraints.
Support board bring-up, debugging, and rework activities alongside the engineering team.
Manage design revisions, ECOs (Engineering Change Orders), and version control within design data management systems.

Required Qualifications

Education:
Technical degree or equivalent certification in drafting, design, electronics technology, or a related field.

Experience:
Minimum of 5 years of professional PCB layout experience, including at least 3 continuous years of experience utilizing Altium Designer.

Technical Skills:
Expert-level proficiency in Altium Designer for schematic capture, layout, library management, and output generation. Strong understanding of PCB fabrication and assembly processes such as surface-mount technology (SMT), through-hole, reflow, and wave solder. Solid comprehension of high-speed digital design (DDR, USB, Ethernet, HDMI), power electronics layout (DC-DC converters, motor drivers, battery management systems), and EMC/EMI design principles.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with flex and rigid-flex PCB design.
Proficiency with signal integrity and power integrity simulation tools.
Experience with controlled-impedance and high-current PCB design.
Experience with version control and PLM integration.

jobs.description:
About The Team

OpenAI’s Partnerships team develops external relationships that advance our research and products and expand how organizations can benefit from AI. Within life sciences, we work across pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, AI-native discovery platforms, research institutions, and experimental labs. We partner closely with Research, Product, Engineering, Safety, GTM, Legal, and Finance to turn complex scientific, technical, and commercial opportunities into durable partnerships.

About The Role

We are hiring a Life Sciences Partnerships Lead to shape and execute OpenAI’s global life sciences partnership strategy. You will lead high-impact research, product, and platform partnerships across the life sciences ecosystem.

You will help determine where OpenAI should invest deeply with strategic partners, where we should enable a broader ecosystem, and how research, product, safety, and commercial considerations should shape our decisions. You will bring the voice of life sciences partners into OpenAI while helping internal teams turn ambiguous opportunities into clear decisions and executable plans.

This role requires scientific and commercial fluency, strong judgment, and the ability to move complex partnerships from strategy through execution and measurable impact.

In This Role, You Will

Lead full-lifecycle strategic partnerships, from partner strategy and executive alignment through scoping, commercial negotiation, execution, and ongoing operating reviews.
Identify and prioritize opportunities across pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, AI-native discovery platforms, research institutions, and experimental labs.
Work closely with Research, Product, and Engineering to translate partner needs, scientific workflows, technical constraints, and market dynamics into product and program recommendations.
Partner with Legal, Finance, Safety, Research, and other cross-functional teams to structure partnerships with the appropriate data, deployment, governance, and commercial models.
Coordinate with Health, GTM, GSI/MSSP enablement, and cloud service provider partnership teams to turn strategic relationships into broader ecosystem adoption and measurable impact.
Build trusted relationships with senior executives, scientific leaders, and technical counterparts across the life sciences ecosystem.
Bring structure to ambiguous opportunities, clear blockers across internal and external teams, and communicate decisions and tradeoffs clearly to senior leaders.

You Might Thrive In This Role If You

Have 12+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, product partnerships, business development, or general management across the life sciences and technology industries.
Bring a deep understanding of the life sciences ecosystem, including its scientific workflows, business models, incentives, and key industry dynamics.
Have led complex strategic partnerships spanning research or scientific collaboration, technical execution, commercial terms, go-to-market strategy, and long-term platform alignment.
Can engage credibly with scientific, technical, product, and business leaders and translate between their priorities.
Are an effective cross-functional leader who can drive progress through influence rather than formal authority.
Communicate clearly, think structurally, and make sound prioritization decisions in fast-moving and ambiguous environments.
Exercise exceptional judgment and integrity.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

About Us

California Medical Innovations Institute (CalMI) is a non-profit medical research organization dedicated to translational research and medical device innovation across multiple biological systems, including cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, lymphatic, and endocrine systems. We are seeking a motivated Medical Assistant / Veterinary Research Technician to join our research team.
Key Responsibilities

1. Surgical & Interventional Procedure Support

Assist medical doctors, veterinarians, and principal investigators during acute and chronic surgical, interventional, and catheterization procedures on large and small animal models, including pigs, dogs, rabbits, rats, and mice.
Prepare operating rooms, organize surgical trays, and ensure sterile fields and appropriate instrumentation for cardiovascular, GI, lymphatic, and endocrine studies.
Assist in animal positioning, physiological monitoring (ECG, blood pressure, airway dynamics), and anesthesia logging under veterinary oversight.

2. Pre- and Post-Operative Care

Manage pre-procedure preparation, including fasting schedules, pre-medication administration, and surgical site clipping/cleansing.
Monitor animals during post-operative recovery, including vital sign tracking, pain assessment, and administration of prescribed medications/treatments.
Maintain clear and accurate surgical logs, recovery records, and medical progress notes.

3. Daily Animal Care & Husbandry

Perform daily animal husbandry, feeding, health checks, and behavioral observation for research models in compliance with facility standards.
Collect blood, tissue, and biological fluid samples following study protocols and Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) principles.
Support animal acclimation, handling, and habituation to minimize stress and ensure study compliance.

4. Technical Support & Laboratory Maintenance

Maintain, clean, sterilize, and inventory surgical tools, anesthesia machines, monitoring equipment, and lab consumables.
Ensure procedure rooms and holding facilities are sanitized and prepared in accordance with institutional guidelines.
Assist with specimen processing, tissue harvesting, and preliminary lab testing/storage.

5. Compliance & Teamwork

Strictly adhere to IACUC protocols, Institutional Safety Guidelines, USDA regulations, and GLP standards.
Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams including scientists, surgeons, veterinarians, and laboratory personnel.
Demonstrate flexibility in adopting new experimental procedures, handling various species, and fulfilling additional operational duties as assigned.

·        Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Animal Science, Health Sciences, or a related field.
Availability & Schedule:
Available for an immediate start. Weekend and holiday work is required.
Experience:
Open to recent graduates as well as experienced candidates. Prior hands-on lab or animal care experience is a plus, but comprehensive training will be provided.
Key Traits:
Adaptable, eager to learn new technical skills, strong work ethic, and attention to detail.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

Exposure to animal allergens and repetitive motion.
Ability to stand, walk, bend, lift up to 50 lbs individually, and team-lift up to 250 lbs.
Required immunizations/screenings based on species exposure (e.g., Tetanus, Rabies, TB, MMR, Hepatitis B).

Extensive hands-on professional training provided.

jobs.title: Lab Technician
jobs.description:
An exciting career awaits you

At MPC, we’re committed to being a great place to work – one that welcomes new ideas, encourages diverse perspectives, develops our people, and fosters a collaborative team environment.

The Galveston Bay Refinery (GBR) has an opening for a Laboratory Technician located in Texas City, TX.

Position Summary

The Laboratory Instrument Maintenance Technician (IMT) is a Lab Technician position responsible for ensuring the reliability, accuracy, and availability of analytical instrumentation supporting refinery laboratory operations. The position performs preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, calibration, equipment evaluation, and technical support for laboratory instruments and associated systems. The IMT works closely with laboratory technicians, chemists, supervision, maintenance personnel, and equipment vendors to maintain safe, accurate, and efficient laboratory operations.

Key Responsibilities

Perform preventive maintenance in accordance with established maintenance schedules, safety requirements, corporate standards, laboratory SOPs, and applicable analytical methods.
Troubleshoot and repair laboratory instrumentation and associated support equipment as requested or required.
Calibrate and verify analytical equipment, including gas chromatographs (GCs), titrators, distillation units, flash point analyzers, and other laboratory instrumentation.
Track instrument performance, reliability, downtime, and recurring problems using statistical quality control and statistical process control (SQC/SPC) charts and other performance indicators.
Identify critical instruments and maintain an appropriate inventory of spare parts and maintenance materials to minimize equipment downtime.
Prepare troubleshooting guidelines that enable laboratory technicians to perform appropriate initial troubleshooting of equipment problems.
Provide technical information to chemists for incorporation into analytical methods and related laboratory documentation.

Responsible Conduct of Research

Stays informed of and adheres to institutional policies and federal regulations (e.g. Titles 21 and 45 of the Code of Federal Regulations) and guidance (International Counsel on Harmonization) regarding human subjects research and use of protected health information.
Uses research funds and resources appropriately.
Maintains confidentiality of data as required.

Anticipates study needs and subject caseload in order to meet organizational objectives and deadlines in a timely manner.

Employer-paid life, AD&D, and long-term disability coverage, with optional supplemental plans.
Additional perks, including tuition assistance, fitness resources, employee assistance, commuter benefits, and more.

Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, Real Estate Development, Urban Planning, or a related field

At Nautilus, we have a big and important mission: positively impact the health and lives of people around the world by unleashing the potential of the proteome. We are developing a single-molecule protein analysis platform of unprecedented sensitivity, scale, and ease of use that we believe will democratize access to the proteome – one of the most dynamic and valuable sources of biological insight. To accomplish this, we are pursuing hard scientific problems with an entrepreneurial mindset and creating a world-class team of builders, innovators, and dreamers across a wide range of disciplines.

We are actively seeking a talented **Senior Bioinformatics Scientist** to join our growing team. We are building a new assay modality on our platform, and its success depends on tight iteration between the bench and the data. In this role, you will own the analysis side of this effort end to end: partnering daily with experimentalists to troubleshoot and optimize protocols, analyzing every type of data the platform produces, explaining what the results mean, and recommending what to try next. You will also build the pipeline for this new data type and work with R&D leadership to frame findings. We are looking for an applied, hands-on scientist who gets things done – someone who values progress over perfection, isn't afraid to dive into unfamiliar territory, knocks down barriers without waiting to be asked, and is a partner the experimental team looks forward to working with.

This position will report to a Bioinformatics Fellow. This position is based in San Carlos, CA. A minimum of three days in the office is required.

* Partner side by side with experimentalists to develop and optimize a new assay format, including designing experiments, selecting which conditions to vary, defining the metrics that determine success, and recommending a path forward based on the results.

* Troubleshoot protocols by forming and testing hypotheses that span sample preparation, reagents, fluidics, imaging, and data processing.

* Analyze and integrate data across every modality the platform produces, including images, fluidics readouts, fluorescence signals, and decoded single-molecule outputs.

* Own the interpretation of results – what the data mean, how confident we should be, and what to do next – and work with R&D leadership to frame findings, communicate progress & risks, and inform project direction.

* Design and build a durable analysis pipeline, quality control metrics, and dashboards for this new data type, balancing rapid one-off analyses with tested, reusable tools the broader team can run.

* Work with the bioinformatics team to develop new analytical and statistical approaches for interpreting stochastic single-molecule measurements.

* Quickly learn to locate and access assay data wherever it lives, including cloud databases, object storage, on-premises file servers, and raw instrument output, writing code to parse instrument metadata and managing cloud access as needed.

* A PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Biophysics, Biochemistry, Biostatistics, or a related quantitative field.

* A minimum of 4 years of experience in industry.

* A track record as an applied, hands-on scientist who gets things done: comfortable making progress with imperfect information, diving into unfamiliar territory, and removing obstacles.

* Hands-on experience analyzing data from wet-lab experiments, with a demonstrated record of assay development or optimization in close partnership with experimental teams.

* Demonstrated ability to own a project end to end, from experimental design and analysis through interpretation and recommendations.

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Research Associate
jobs.description:
Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq ARWR) is a commercial stage biopharmaceutical company that develops medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead's RNAi-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing.

Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates.

Arrowhead's corporate headquarters is in Pasadena, CA with research and development teams in Madison, WI & San Diego, CA, and a state of the art manufacturing facility in Verona, WI. Our employees are nimble, science-driven innovators who are collaborating to bring new therapies to patients in need.

**The Position**

The Sr. Clinical Research Associate (Sr. CRA) provides support to Study Lead(s) in clinical study planning, execution and management. The primary purpose of the position is to support the COM/Study Lead in study set-up, execution, oversight, and closeout activities in compliance with the clinical protocol, regulatory requirements, ICH GCP guidelines and governing policies & procedures.

*Responsibilities*

* Support assigned study teams with TMF set-up, maintenance, ongoing quality control reviews, and final reconciliation of study documents
* Routinely monitor TMF inspection readiness for assigned studies
* Assist Study Lead with investigational product and ancillary supplies management, accountability and reconciliation activities
* Collect and/or review Essential Documents from investigational sites
* Review informed consent documents for accuracy and completeness
* Support investigator identification, feasibility, and activation activities
* Review monitoring visit reports for accuracy and completeness
* Support Study Lead in preparing materials for study-wide meetings (eg investigator meetings, interim update meetings, data safety committee meetings, etc.)
* Perform QC (formatting, spelling and grammar, accuracy, consistency) of study-level documents (master ICFs, study plans, manuals, CRFs/CRF completion instructions, etc.) in alignment with study protocols
* Contribute to the development of study-level documents ( study templates, manuals, guides, newsletters, etc.)
* Provide updates on study/site status as needed to ensure timely study entry and updates are reflected on ClinicalTrials.gov or equivalent
* Perform periodic data reviews as requested by Study Lead
* Prepare and present updates at team meetings as assigned by Study Lead
* Support central/referral laboratory set-up and on-time activation (eg specifications, user manual) as delegated by the Study Lead
* Work closely with CRO to plan for execution of study start-up and ongoing study execution activities as assigned by the Study Lead.
* Provide guidance and training to junior level team members as assigned by management
* Recommend modifications to SOPs/work instructions (WIs) when necessary to improve compliance or efficiency
* Participate in process improvement projects including SOP/WI development
* Maintain compliance with assigned procedures, guidelines, study plans and applicable regulatory requirements.

**Requirements:**

* 5 years in clinical research and development
* 3 years onsite monitoring/site management experience
* Experience managing/supervising vendors
* Highly proficient knowledge and understanding of ICH-GCP

**Preferred:**

* 4-year college degree
* CRA certification

Arrowhead provides competitive salaries and an excellent benefit package.

Candidates must have current, valid authorization to work in the country where this role is located.

jobs.title: AI Trainer - Biology
jobs.description:
Experts author hard, realistic STEM and Data Science tasks that frontier AI models currently fail, then grade what the models produce against a professional standard. Tasks are drawn from the expert's own practice, grounded in real day-to-day workflows, and checked against frontier models so that only genuinely hard tasks make it through. The goal is a task that represents what an AI agent would need to do if a working scientist or engineer handed it a real project end to end. The work is long-form and self-directed, spans many disciplines, and is fully remote, with no shift work.
A task is drawn from the author's own practice, built from files a practitioner actually handles, and run through frontier models so the deliverable can be graded. Authors move through a set workflow:
Propose a task: the scenario, the prompt, the files you will build, and where you expect the model to fail.
Early check-in with an expert reviewer before you invest in the full build.
Build the task in full, assemble the supporting files, and run it against frontier models.
Review and revision (R&R): every completed task goes through expert review, and experienced authors review and refine other experts' tasks.

Help Shape the Future of AI in Healthcare

What if the medical knowledge and clinical skills you're developing could help improve how artificial intelligence understands complex healthcare information, evaluates medical scenarios, and delivers more accurate, reliable responses?

At Volga Partners, we're connecting medical students, residents, and advanced healthcare trainees with opportunities to contribute to the evaluation and improvement of advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) models.

.

This opportunity is designed for candidates who can apply their academic knowledge, clinical training, and evidence-based reasoning to evaluate AI-generated medical information.

This is not a traditional clinical position.
You will not provide direct patient care, diagnose actual patients, or make treatment decisions for real patients. Instead, you'll assess medical scenarios, evaluate clinical reasoning, identify inaccuracies, and provide structured feedback to help improve AI model performance.

Previous AI experience is not required. We're looking for candidates with a strong foundation in medical knowledge, analytical thinking, and an interest in applying their education to emerging healthcare technology.

Areas of Medical Education & Clinical Training

Medical students in their third or fourth year, medical interns, or residents pursuing a broad foundation in general medical practice.

As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

The Systems Engineering Division (SED)
provides unmatched experience in systems engineering to the U.S. government and to numerous public and private agencies, universities, nonprofit organizations, consortia, and commercial companies involved in the advanced application of space technology. From systems architecture development to system analysis and optimization, astrodynamics, orbital debris, navigation, failure analysis, mission assurance, cost and schedule assessment, and economic market analysis, SED exploits an incredibly broad array of engineering and business disciplines against a diverse and dynamic portfolio of programs and national challenges. 

The Digital Systems Engineering Department (DSED
), part of SED, is charged with helping our customers successfully adopt, integrate, and utilize digital system models, methods, tools, and best practices as part of their systems realization lifecycle processes through DE and MBSE research & development, prototyping, technical studies, independent assessments, training, and advisory functions.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Systems Engineer
with a focu on Digital & Systems Engineering.
The ideal candidate for this position will plan, execute, and lead project teams tasked with researching, identifying, and implementing innovative DE and MBSE approaches for new and existing space and defense systems and advise internal Aerospace and external government customers on the effective use of DE and MBSE methodologies, tools, and practices to achieve their desired system realization and optimization outcomes.  

What You'll Be Doing

Research, develop and analyze systems CONOPs, architecture and design models using various modeling languages including SysML, UAFML, BPMN, RAAML, OWL, and others to support customers that acquire, develop, integrate, and operate space and ground, launch, and de systems at all levels of abstraction including the enterprise, mission, functional, logical levels, physical levels.
Develop model patterns, libraries, templates, and patterns for reuse across projects and programs.
Advise customers on the selection and MBSE methods, languages, and toolsets that meet their systems engineering lifecycle use cases.  
Develop Aerospace ETG, program office, and government customers on DE and MBSE concepts, principles and practices.
Develop training material, papers, and presentations on DE/MBSE topics of interest to Aerospace, its customers, and professional societies (INCOSE, AIAA, IEEE, etc.)
Participate and represent aerospace interests in professional DE/MBSE standards working groups and committees.
Provide technical and project level leadership, mentoring, and tasking oversight to early and mid-career staff.  

What Corporate Skills You’ll Bring

Strong written and oral communication skills
Must work well in a team environment
Possess organizational, time management and project management skills
Demonstrate flexibility and ability to adapt to changing organizational need
Interpersonal skills to coordinate efforts and work with other internal and external organizations

What You Need To Be Successful

B.S. degree in a relevant engineering discipline (Aerospace, Systems, Electrical, Mechanical, etc.), Computer Science, or related technical field.
12+ years’ experience in systems engineering in two or more technical areas, including CONOPs development, requirements definition, architecture & design, system analysis, and system integration & test.
Proficient with one or more MBSE modeling languages (SysML, UAFML, LML, etc.), methodologies (OOSEM, SysMOD, MagicGrid, etc.), and tools (Cameo, Sparx, Rhapsody, GENESYS, etc.). 
Experience in all aspects of space systems engineering, including architecture, engineering design, and engineering analysis. Familiarity with architecture frameworks (DoDAF, UAF, TOGAF).
Knowledge of core space system segments (space, ground, transport, launch, etc.) at the enterprise, SoS, system, and subsystem levels. 
Ability to clearly explain complex concepts to customers and fellow employees. 
A self-starter who can lead the technical work of DE/MBSE project teams and spearhead new efforts.  
Excellent written and oral communication skills. 
Possess strong organizational, time management and project management skills.
Ability to coordinate efforts and work with other internal and external organizations. 
Ability to work well in a team environment.
Demonstrate flexibility and ability to adapt to changing program office sponsor and customer needs.
Problem-solving, analytical, and innovation mindset.
This position requires the ability to obtain a TS/SCI security clearance issued by the U.S. Government. U.S. citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance.

How You Can Stand Out

M.S. or Ph.D. degree in a relevant engineering discipline (Aerospace, Systems Electrical, Mechanical, etc.), Computer Science, or related technical discipline.  
Some experience with developing ontology or semantic data models
Knowledge of graph theory and graph database, analysis, and visualization tools
Possess knowledge of digital engineering concepts and practical experience developing digital engineering strategies and execution plans.
Familiar with digital thread tools such as Syndeia or eCube.
Teaching experience, especially in technical subjects.
Relevant INCOSE CSEP/ESEP or OMG SysML/UAFML certification.

Job Description

The Opportunity

The department of Mathematics, Science and Technology of the Embry-Riddle Worldwide | College of Arts & Sciences seeks an experienced professor or working professional with a passion for research and education in addition to prior university experience who has a scholarship record commensurable with a tenured associate professor rank, to support our recently established and growing data science program. The primary initial need will be to develop and then first teach several courses within our growing data science program. Then, as various programs continue to grow, opportunities for additional more advanced courses are to be expected. The department offers a range of higher enrollment courses in domains throughout mathematics, in addition to the sciences, and an ideal candidate would also be able to teach some of these courses, such as mathematics or statistics; this would require a candidate having completed 18 graduate credit hours within one of those domains. In addition, a successful candidate will have an existing research agenda connects to Embry-Riddle's research focus areas and could benefit from collaboration with existing department faculty.

This is a fully remote online position within the U.S. with no relocation required;
some
faculty travel
is required to attend mandatory college meetings and events as well as for scholastic activities, such as presenting at conferences .

About The College Of Arts & Sciences

The Embry‑Riddle Worldwide College of Arts & Sciences develops and supports career-ready graduates and advances all students to be lifelong learners and leaders in their professional disciplines in digitally enabled, globally distributed learning environments.

Through the general education program, the college emphasizes academic rigor in critical thinking, global perspectives, creative problem solving, communication skills, scientific and cultural literacy, responsible engagement with emerging technologies and ethical interaction with the contemporary world. In its academic degree programs, the college focuses on applied studies that implement state-of-the-art curriculum to educate students for long-term success in their profession.

Our vision is to be a destination college for multidisciplinary studies and impactful collaborative research as well as continue to be a national leader in general education, developing opportunities for our diverse student population to fulfill their educational goals and become responsive, responsible global citizens.

The Department of Mathematics, Science and Technology in the College of Arts & Sciences designs and delivers a wide range of curricula at both the undergraduate and graduate level, with the primary focus being to contribute in line with Embry‑Riddle Aeronautical University's broader mission (e.g., applied mathematics and sciences). Many of the courses offered by the department are courses that are at the core of ERAU's most in-demand majors, such as aviation and engineering. Additionally, the department has a strong research interest, and growing faculty expertise, in the extremely high-demand field of data science, with the current initiatives focusing on applied data science and engineering-driven machine learning.

Embry-Riddle: A Global Leader in Aviation and Aerospace

With vibrant campuses in Daytona Beach, FL, and Prescott, AZ—along with a Worldwide network spanning roughly 120 global locations as well as a global online environment—Embry-Riddle proudly stands as the world’s largest aviation and aerospace university. Now celebrating our 100th year, we continue to lead innovation in STEM education, serving more than 30,000 students worldwide. Our cutting-edge programs in Applied Science, Aviation, Business, Technology, Engineering, Safety, Security, Space, and more prepare the current and emerging new leaders shaping the future of flight and beyond.

Perks Await You at Embry-Riddle!

Generous Time Off: Enjoy 9+ paid holidays, including the day after Thanksgiving and the week between Christmas Eve and New Year’s Day.
Tuition Coverage: Get 100% tuition coverage for yourself for one undergraduate and one graduate degree, and discounted rates for your spouse and dependent children up to age 26.
Retirement Contributions: ERAU contributes 6% of your base salary to your retirement plan and offers a 4% matching contribution – with no vesting period.

Candidates with a PhD in fields such as Physical Sciences or Engineering maybe considered if they have either a Masters degree in Data or Computer Science, or are otherwise credentialed to teach Data or Computer Science at the university level
