jobs.title: Multi-Factor Analysis (Genomics, 'Omics and Computational Biology) SETA
jobs.description:
Strategic Analysis, Inc. (SA) is actively seeking an Multi-Factor Analysis SETA with subject matter expertise in Genomics, 'Omics and Computational Biology
. This is a Science and Engineering and Technical Advisor (SETA) role, focused on providing technical guidance and oversight.

Specific Duties Required:

• Provide internal subject matter expertise on how to characterize the factors behind different autism trajectories. These include genetics and epigenetics, metabolomics, immune profiling, the microbiome, environmental exposures, family factors, and developmental history. The program's starting idea is that nonlinear interactions among these factors shape different developmental, health, communication, and functional outcomes (ARPA-H).
• Give insight on whether proposed approaches are conceptually and technically sound:
• Study design: cohort design, sample size, and statistical power
• Measurement: assay and measurement choices, and batch effects
• Data handling: combining data from different sources, and quality control
• Analysis: reproducibility, and statistical methods for gene-environment and other multi-factor interactions
• Scope: any justifiable way of measuring a person's biological state is in scope, including neuroimaging and electrophysiology. Characterization is focused on humans, not model systems such as organoids (ARPA-H, n.d.-b).
• Help set goals, expectations, and budgets for TA1 projects, including milestones for generating, harmonizing, and sharing data.
• Help review and oversee funded TA1 projects, including:
• coordinating with TA2 so TA1 data and features can feed the federated, privacy-preserving modeling platforms (ARPA-H)
• coordinating with TA3 so TA1 findings point to targets that interventions can act on

Experience/Expertise Required:

• Experience in human genetics/genomics or other 'omics research (e.g., sequencing, epigenomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, microbiome), covering both how the data are generated and how they're analyzed
• Experience with computational methods for high-dimensional biological data: bioinformatics, statistical genetics, data science, computational modeling, and/or machine learning
• Experience working with large human cohort or long-term datasets that combine several data types
• Experience with budgeting and program or project management
Experience/Expertise Preferred:
• Minimum five years of experience post-doc.
• Genetics or biology research on autism or other neurodevelopmental conditions
• Familiarity with large autism and population datasets (e.g., SPARK, Simons Simplex Collection, MSSNG, ABCD, All of Us)
• Environmental epidemiology or exposome science; immunology; metabolism; gut-brain or microbiome research
• Methods for causal inference and interactions (e.g., Mendelian randomization, gene-by-environment modeling, polygenic scores, multi-omic integration, subtyping or clustering patients by trajectory)
• Neuroimaging or EEG analysis
• Data standards, governance, and privacy for genomic data, including FAIR principles, GA4GH standards, consent, and assent for minors, and returning results to participants
• Engaging communities in genetic research, and awareness of autistic community perspectives on it
• Lived experience of autism is a plus. Disclosure is voluntary and not required.
Minimum Degree Requirement:
• PhD (or MD/PhD) in human genetics, genomics, bioinformatics, computational biology, biostatistics, epidemiology, systems biology, or a related field. A master’s degree with substantial relevant research experience may be considered.
Location: Position is remote.
Travel: Periodic travel may be required
Clearance: Ability to obtain HHS Public Trust.

Movement Defense Strategies (MDS) is a research and legal education project exploring how legal knowledge and community organizing can work better together.
During our 2026–27 research and design period, we're learning from organizers, legal professionals, and community members to understand gaps in legal knowledge and support, how those gaps affect their work, and what might make legal information more accessible, useful, and responsive.
We're also testing ideas through small educational and program pilots. What we learn will shape MDS's future partnerships, programs, and organizational direction.
We're a small, curious team based in Connecticut, and we believe the people closest to a problem often have knowledge that can't be found in a textbook.
ABOUT THE POSITIONS
We're hiring two Research Assistants
for Spring 2027. Both contribute to the same project but approach our questions differently.
One focuses on learning directly from people through interviews, workshops, and pilots. The other investigates organizations, resources, and systems at the intersection of law and organizing.
Both involve asking good questions, working carefully with evidence, and helping us figure out what comes next.

POSITION 1: FIELDWORK & PILOT PROGRAMMING

Supervisor:
Amber Moye, J.D., M.A.
Co-Lead, Research & Program Development

For the curious listeners, thoughtful observers, and people who want to understand what makes information useful in the real world.

As our Fieldwork & Pilot Programming Research Assistant
, you'll investigate how people experience, access, understand, and use legal knowledge and support.

You'll help prepare interviews, workshops, and pilot sessions; develop research materials and feedback tools; document participant experiences; and organize and analyze qualitative information.

You'll identify patterns, assess whether educational approaches are accessible, relevant, culturally responsive, and useful, and help determine what we should try next.

Our pilots test research questions and emerging ideas. Some things will work. Others won't. Both outcomes teach us something.

You'll help shape how we ask questions, learn from participants, and turn findings into meaningful recommendations.

POSITION 2: LEGAL ECOSYSTEMS & ORGANIZATIONAL ANALYSIS
Supervisor:
Grace Brunner, J.D.
Co-Lead, Legal Ecosystems & Partnerships

For the investigators, big-picture thinkers, chit-chatters, and people who appreciate a well-organized spreadsheet.

As our Legal Ecosystems & Organizational Analysis Research Assistant
, you'll investigate the organizations, relationships, and systems connecting legal knowledge with people working toward community and systemic change.

Some organizations provide legal services; others offer education, research, training, or organizing support. We want to understand who's doing what, how their approaches differ, and what we can learn from them.

You'll research organizations and legal-support models, evaluate sources, maintain our research database, and compare how organizations structure their work, serve communities, and use available resources.

A big part of this role involves following the evidence and keeping track of what you find
. You'll verify information, document sources, and identify patterns, gaps, promising approaches, and questions worth exploring.

Rather than simply building a directory, we're trying to understand how the ecosystem works and where there may be opportunities to do things differently.

ABOUT YOU
We're looking for people who are curious, thoughtful, organized, and comfortable asking questions without straightforward answers.

You don't need to know everything coming in (we certainly don't!), but you should enjoy learning, collaborating, and making sense of complicated information.

You might be a great fit if you...

Are naturally curious.
You enjoy digging into questions, following unexpected leads, and seeing what the evidence reveals.
Know how to listen.
You ask thoughtful questions and understand that good research starts with listening rather than assuming.
Have an eye for detail.
You take careful notes, stay organized, and notice things others might overlook.
Enjoy connecting the dots.
You identify patterns while appreciating the differences between people's experiences and organizations.
Make complicated things understandable.
You communicate clearly and enjoy turning information into something useful.
Are comfortable with uncertainty.
You consider different perspectives and change your mind when evidence calls for it.
Take people's trust seriously.
You value accuracy, confidentiality, research ethics, and responsible information handling.
Work well with others.
You communicate, follow through, welcome feedback, and believe collaboration improves the work.
Care about the bigger picture.
You're interested in community organizing, movement lawyering, legal education, access to justice, or public-interest research.

A little about your background
We're primarily looking for law students and graduate students
, particularly those studying sociology, political science, public policy, legal studies, social work, education, public health, nonprofit management, or related fields. But meaningful experience doesn't always come with a particular degree, job title, or academic trajectory.

Maybe you've developed research skills through organizing, helped people navigate complicated systems, evaluated programs, or worked to make information more accessible.

Please don't count yourself out just because you don't check every box.
We're interested in what you know, how you think, and what you're excited to learn.

Experience with interviews, literature reviews, qualitative research, policy analysis, data management, or community-engaged research is a plus, but not a prerequisite.

We value curiosity over having all the answers, thoughtful questions over impressive jargon, and a willingness to learn from others.

THE DETAILS
We believe in being upfront about what you're signing up for.
Your time is valuable, and you deserve to know what to expect. No guessing games, mysterious compensation packages, or unpaid internships. If you're doing meaningful work, you should be paid for it.

Here's the breakdown:

Positions:
Two, one for each research area.
Pay:
$20/hour. Because experience doesn't pay the bills.
Hours:
Approximately 10/week, including meetings and training. Yes, we pay you for those, too.
Duration:
15 paid weeks in Spring 2027, plus one spring-break week with no work expected.
Total compensation:
Approximately $3,000 per position.
Work arrangement:
Approximately 80% remote. We're headquartered in Waterbury, CT.
Start date:
January 19, 2027 (tentative; end date to be confirmed).
Scheduling:
Regular check-ins and occasional in-person collaboration in Connecticut, including interviews, workshops, or pilot sessions. We'll coordinate in advance!
Supervision:
Each assistant works with their respective supervisor and the broader MDS team.

Thinking about sticking around?
A summer extension may be possible depending on project needs and funding. We can't promise one yet, and we'd rather tell you now.

We're a small, evolving project, so some responsibilities will change as research progresses. Our commitment to transparency, respecting your time, and making the experience worthwhile won't.

HOW TO APPLY
We'd love to learn about you, your experiences, and what draws you to this work.

Use LinkedIn Easy Apply
or send the following to hello@movementdefense.org:
Your résumé/CV.

A short interest statement.
Why MDS? Which position interests you, and what would you bring? Interested in both? Let us know!
An existing work sample.
A research paper, memo, policy analysis, evaluation, or anything showing how you think and communicate. No need to create something new.
Your availability
, including potential summer interest.
Any academic-credit requirements
, if applicable.

Application deadline: November 13, 2026.

One last thing... Job descriptions can make it seem like we're looking for someone who already knows how to do everything. We're not
.

We're looking for people ready to learn, contribute, and figure things out together.

If you've made it this far and you're excited about either position, we'd love to hear from you.

Perform routine and advanced protein characterization and maintain standardized QC criteria across protein batches

Support in vitro protein interaction, condensation, aggregation, and binder-characterization experiments

Demonstrated ability to independently execute established protocols and troubleshoot technically challenging experiments

The successful candidate will join a team led by Co-Directors Dr. Newman, MD, PhD, a practicing geriatrician, and Dr. Brianna Stubbs, PhD, who has more than 10 years of clinical research experience. The broader team includes experienced Clinical Project Managers, Clinical Scientists, Study Nurses with more than 30 years of clinical practice experience, and other clinical research staff.

Our clinical team is small and highly collaborative. Candidates should expect hands-on experience across the full lifecycle of clinical study execution. We work together to ensure study activities are completed accurately and on time. This is a rewarding and challenging opportunity for a highly motivated individual who can independently execute assigned tasks after training but also recognizes when to ask for help.

Conduct protocol-specified study procedures under appropriate supervision and clearly explain study activities to participants
Build strong rapport with study participants to support engagement, retention, and a positive research experience
Support protocol compliance through thorough review and documentation at each participant study visit
Extract and digitize data from written case report forms while carefully preserving data integrity
Process, label, track, store, and ship biospecimens according to study procedures and laboratory requirements
Support maintenance of regulatory documentation and study files and assist with protocol deviations, adverse-event documentation, and other study documentation as appropriate to the role
Participate in data analysis, interpretation, write-up, and dissemination
Recognize and promptly escalate participant safety concerns or protocol-related issues to the appropriate study team member
Communicate regularly with the Principal Investigator about study-related issues
Maintain confidentiality of all participant-related records and written and verbal communications

QUALIFICATIONS

BA/BS or equivalent experience in a biological, health, behavioral, or related field
Previous experience in a clinical setting (research, elder care, health care, or similar is acceptable). This role is intended for candidates with early career experience in a related setting
Experience with, or strong interest in, clinical trial conduct and operations

Proficient with email, calendar scheduling, Microsoft Excel, and Google Drive, along with the ability to quickly learn platforms such as the Fitbit app, ASA24 diet log, and REDCap
Wet lab experience with basic analytical techniques and assays
Phlebotomy experience, or willingness to learn

Position Summary

The Stubbs Lab at The Buck Institute is seeking an organized, detail-oriented, articulate, and motivated Clinical Research Associate/Coordinator II
to join our clinical research team. This position supports the day-to-day logistics and communications required to successfully conduct clinical studies, performs elements of study visits at the Buck and community locations, and assists with processing biospecimens and study data.

Candidates should have 2-5 years of experience in clinical research or a similar role and be comfortable managing assigned study activities with limited supervision.

The successful candidate will join a team led by Co-Directors Dr. Newman, MD, PhD, a practicing geriatrician, and Dr. Brianna Stubbs, PhD, who has more than 10 years of clinical research experience. The broader team includes experienced Clinical Project Managers, Clinical Scientists, Study Nurses with more than 30 years of clinical practice experience, and other clinical research staff.

Our clinical team is small and highly collaborative. Candidates should expect hands-on experience across the full lifecycle of clinical study execution. We work together to ensure study activities are completed accurately and on time.

The CRA II is expected to work with greater independence than the CRA I, manage assigned study activities with limited supervision, troubleshoot routine problems, proactively identify process improvements, provide guidance and training to junior research staff, and appropriately escalate issues when needed.

Key Responsibilities

Maintain participant tracking and scheduling records; conduct telephone prescreening; coordinate study visits and manage participant communications
Prepare and maintain source documents, study logs, questionnaires, and study supplies in accordance with study protocols and procedures
Conduct protocol-specified study procedures independently when trained and within scope, with an appropriate level of supervision, and provide clear explanations of study activities to participants
Build strong rapport with study participants to support engagement, retention, and a positive research experience
Support protocol compliance through thorough review and documentation at each participant study visit
Extract and digitize data from written case report forms while carefully preserving data integrity
Process, label, track, store, and ship biospecimens according to study procedures and laboratory requirements
Support maintenance of regulatory documentation and study files and assist with protocol deviations, adverse-event documentation, and other study documentation as appropriate to the role
Participate in data analysis, interpretation, write-up, and dissemination
Recognize and promptly escalate participant safety concerns or protocol-related issues to the appropriate study team member
Independently troubleshoot routine operational or study-visit issues, escalate concerns promptly, and proactively identify potential problems or process improvements
Provide training, guidance, and support to CRA I staff as appropriate
Assist with the preparation and review of study SOPs and study-specific procedures
Communicate regularly with the Principal Investigator about study-related issues
Maintain confidentiality of all participant-related records and written and verbal communications

QUALIFICATIONS

Education & Experience

BA/BS or equivalent experience in a biological, health, behavioral, or related field
2-5 years of experience in clinical research, clinical trial conduct/operations, healthcare research, or a similar role
Demonstrated experience coordinating clinical study activities and resolving routine operational issues with limited supervision
Strong interest in the science of healthy aging and translating basic science research into clinical interventions.

Skills

Detail-oriented and meticulous in all aspects of work
Strong follow-through and ability to proactively identify and solve problems; demonstrated initiative is imperative
Professional demeanor and strong interpersonal and communication skills when working with the public, providers, and colleagues
Demonstrated ability to work both independently with limited supervision and as part of a team
Ability to provide light supervision, guidance, and training to junior research staff

Desired skills but not required

Proficient with email, calendar scheduling, Microsoft Excel, Google Drive, along with the ability to quickly learn platforms such as the Fitbit app, ASA24 diet log, and REDCap
Wet lab experience with basic analytical techniques and assays
Phlebotomy experience, or willingness to learn

COMPENSATION, SCHEDULE & WORK LOCATION

Starting pay: $30-$38.50/hour, commensurate with experience, plus benefits
Schedules vary based on study needs and may include morning (7:30 am – 4:00 pm), daytime (9:00 am – 5:30 pm), and evening (1:30 – 10:00 pm) shifts
Fully in-person position, with some clinical visits at community locations up to approx. 1 hour from campus

ABOUT US

Our success will ultimately change healthcare. At the Buck, we aim to end the threat of age-related diseases for this and future generations by bringing together the most capable and passionate scientists from a broad range of disciplines to identify and impede the ways in which we age.

We are an independent, non-profit institution located in Marin County, CA, focused on increasing human healthspan, or the healthy years of life. Globally recognized as the pioneer and leader in efforts to target aging, the number one risk factor for diseases including Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, cancer, macular degeneration, heart disease, and diabetes, the Buck seeks to help people live better longer.

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa currently. We are an equal opportunity employer and strive to create an atmosphere where diversity of identity, experience, and background is welcomed, valued, and supported. Candidates who contribute to this diversity are strongly encouraged to apply.

TO APPLY

Please click APPLY to submit your Resume and a Cover Letter indicating why you are a good candidate for this position.

jobs.description:
Description

The Product Development Engineer will play a key role in advancing innovative medical technologies within Mount Sinai BioDesign. This entry-level position offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of engineering, medicine, and entrepreneurship. The engineer will contribute to device design, prototyping, and testing while also engaging directly with clinicians to identify unmet needs through the Biodesign process. This role is ideal for a motivated early-career engineer seeking hands-on experience in translational research and medical device innovation.

Responsibilities

Participate in surgeon and clinician interviews to identify clinical pain points and translate insights into engineering requirements.
Assist in the design and development of medical device prototypes using CAD tools, 3D printing, machining, and other prototyping methods.
Conduct bench testing and validation studies to characterize device performance.
Support needs-finding, concept generation, and iterative design within the structured Biodesign process.
Document design iterations, testing protocols, and results for regulatory, intellectual property, and grant purposes.
Collaborate with clinicians, researchers, and industry partners to refine concepts and ensure clinical relevance.
Maintain lab resources, ensure compliance with safety standards, and contribute to efficient prototyping workflows.
Engage with external vendors and fabrication shops for materials, components, and device manufacturing.
Provide cross-functional support on BioDesign projects spanning medical, engineering, and business disciplines.

Qualifications

Minimum of Associates Degree (higher preferred). Applicable work experience may be considered in lieu of educational requirements. Basic knowledge of anatomy and physiology, knowledge of medical electronic technology and instrumentation acquired through completion of appropriate training, with a highly preferred certification from AAMI or other similar organizations
3 to 5 years of diversified experience in the medical electronics field with exposure to Heart/Lung and/or Balloon Pump technology or closely related training

Preferred Experience

Hands on experience with CAD(SolidWorks, AutoCAD, prototyping tools and mechanical testing methods.
Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering or related discipline.

Mount Sinai Health System is one of the largest academic medical systems in the New York metro area, with more than 48,000 employees working across eight hospitals, more than 400 outpatient practices, more than 300 labs, a school of nursing, and a leading school of medicine and graduate education. The Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai is ranked No. 11 nationwide in National Institutes of Health funding and in the 99th percentile in research dollars per investigator according to the Association of American Medical Colleges. Newsweek’s “The World’s Best Smart Hospitals” ranks The Mount Sinai Hospital as No. 1 in New York and in the top five globally, and Mount Sinai Morningside in the top 20 globally.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Specialist - Digital and Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

The Systems Engineering Division (SED) offers unparalleled expertise in systems engineering to the U.S. government and various public and private agencies, universities, nonprofit organizations, consortia, and commercial companies involved in the advanced development and application of space systems. From systems CONOPs and architecture development to system design and analysis, mission assurance, cost and schedule assessment, and economic market analysis, SED leverages a vast array of engineering and business disciplines across a diverse and dynamic portfolio of space programs and national challenges spanning the total space system lifecycle.

The Digital Systems Engineering Department (DSED)
, part of SED, serves as a strategic partner to government and commercial organizations navigating the digital transformation of systems engineering. Through applied research and development, agile rapid prototyping, objective independent assessments, and expert advisory services, DSED enables customers to successfully institutionalize Digital Systems Engineering (DSE) concepts, methods, practices, and tools throughout their systems acquisition and realization lifecycle. Our comprehensive approach- integrating the three functional pillars of Digital Engineering (DE), Model-Based Engineering (MBE), and Systems Engineering (SE), empowers customers to accelerate innovation, reduce risk, and achieve mission success in increasingly complex space and defense system environments.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Engineering Specialist with
a focus Digital and Systems Engineering
to drive the development and execution and management of complex MBSE and DE project portfolios. This role requires a deep understanding of MBSE concepts, methodologies, frameworks, tools, and best practices to enhance the acquisition and realization of space and defense systems encompassing systems architecture, design, analysis, and lifecycle management. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in systems engineering, project portfolio management, and cross-functional collaboration with Aerospace program offices and ETG organizations within a dynamic and innovative environment. 

What You'll Be Doing

Plan, execute, and lead MBSE and DE R&D initiatives and projects, ensuring integration of systems engineering best practices.
Provide oversight of project teams developing descriptive models using open-standard modeling languages (SysML, UAFML, BPMN) and industry-recognized tools (e.g., Cameo, Sparx EA, Rhapsody).
Guide project teams through the full system development lifecycle, from concept to deployment.
Drive innovation and best practices in MBSE, ensuring alignment with industry trends and organizational, and customer goals.
Collaborate with multi-disciplinary teams, including software, hardware, and domain experts, to develop and analyze system models in the systems acquisition and realization lifecycle.
Author, publish, and present papers, presentations, and training material on MBSE topics of mutual interest to Aerospace and customers.
Participate in MBSE and DE related standards organizations and profession society working groups (e.g., OMG, INCOSE, Digital Twin Consortium, AIAA, IEEE) representing Aerospace interests.
Mentor and train junior and mid-level engineers on MBSE principles, practices, and tools.

Minimum Requirements

What You Need to Be Successful

B.S. degree in a relevant Engineering discipline (Aerospace, Systems, Electrical, Mechanical, etc.), Computer Science, or related technical field.
12+ years of experience in three or more systems engineering functional areas (e.g. requirements, architecture, design) with at least 5 years in MBSE and DE.
Proficiency in MBSE tools such as Cameo Systems Modeler, Sparx EA, or IBM Rhapsody.
Strong knowledge of descriptive modeling languages (e.g., SysML, UAFML, BPMN), architecture frameworks (e.g., DoDAF, UAF, TOGAF), and methodologies (e.g., OOSEM, SysMOD, ISE&PPOOA).
Must be a self-starter with excellent problem-solving, communication (verbal and written), and project portfolio and technical leadership skills.
Comfortable working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment with cross-functional government, SETA, and other FFRDC teams.
Ability to clearly explain project outcomes and deliverables to stakeholders not versed in MBSE.
Excellent written and oral communication skills. 
Possess strong organizational, time management and project management skills.
Ability to coordinate efforts and work with other internal and external organizations. 
Ability to work well in a team environment.
Demonstrate flexibility and ability to adapt to changing program office sponsor and customer needs.
Problem-solving, analytical, and innovation mindset.
Willing to travel to customer or contractor site, domestical or internationally
This position requires the ability to obtain a TS/SCI security clearance issued by the U.S. Government. U.S. citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance.

How You Can Stand Out

It would be impressive if you have one or more of these:

M.S. or Ph.D. degree in a relevant engineering discipline (Aerospace, Systems, Electrical, Mechanical, etc.), Computer Science, or related technical field.
Practical systems engineering work experience in the space, defense, or nuclear security domains.
Familiarity with agile project management using JIRA.
Knowledge of Digital Engineering (DE) concepts, including digital engineering ecosystems, digital threads, and digital twins.
INCOSE CSEP/ESEP certification.
PMI PMP certification.

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. Individual salaries within that range are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge and skills.

Our leadership philosophy is simple: every employee, regardless of level and role, can demonstrate leadership. At Aerospace, our commitment is our people. To cultivate our talent and ensure that we have a strong pipeline of future leaders, we want individuals who:

Operate Strategically

jobs.description:
Company Overview

Flock Freight
is the largest Shared Truckload (STL) freight brokerage in the U.S., transforming underutilized truckload capacity into tangible value: cost savings for shippers, increased earnings for carriers, and a smaller carbon footprint.

Their AI-powered, patented pooling technology optimizes across Flock’s entire customer network, combining shipments from thousands of businesses into efficient Shared Truckloads. With STL, shippers enjoy truckload-level service while only paying for the space they need. Trusted by thousands of customers, from some of the largest enterprises to growing brands, Flock Freight delivers an unmatched combination of cost efficiency, exceptional service, and a streamlined shipping experience.

Flock Freight
has been a Certified B Corp since 2020, meeting high social, environmental, transparency, and accountability standards to all of our stakeholders.

Team/Department Overview:
Business Analytics Team – Reporting to the Manager of Business Analytics.

Flock Freight is hiring a Data Analyst
to help turn complex business questions into meaningful insights that improve decision-making across the organization. You’ll partner closely with teams across Sales, Account Management, Carrier Sales, and Operations to understand their challenges, identify opportunities, and deliver reporting and analysis that supports smarter, more effective business decisions.

This is a hands-on, business-facing analytics role with a strong emphasis on SQL, stakeholder collaboration, and practical problem-solving. You’ll build and maintain reporting models, develop dashboards, manage ad hoc analysis requests, and translate business processes into reliable, actionable data. You’ll work closely with experienced analysts and engineers while taking ownership of analytical work that directly supports the teams driving Flock’s business.

As you grow in the role, you’ll have opportunities to deepen your technical expertise, develop specialized business knowledge, and contribute to increasingly complex analytical projects.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with stakeholders across Sales, Account Management, Carrier Sales, and other business teams to understand their reporting needs, investigate challenges, and translate business questions into actionable analysis.
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources, supporting accurate reporting and informed decision-making.
Build, maintain, and improve reporting models, dashboards, and analytical tools that provide visibility into business performance and operational workflows.
Own and prioritize incoming analytics requests, balancing immediate business needs with accuracy, efficiency, and longer-term analytical priorities.
Translate business processes and requirements into structured reporting logic that helps teams categorize information, monitor performance, and improve workflows.
Present findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, helping teams understand the data and make confident decisions.
Collaborate with analysts, engineers, and cross-functional partners to improve reporting consistency, data quality, and analytical processes.
Identify opportunities to streamline recurring reports, automate manual workflows, and make data more accessible and useful across the organization.

What You'll Bring

Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, analytical, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Approximately 2–4 years of professional experience in data analytics, business analytics, or a related analytical role.
Strong SQL proficiency, including experience independently writing complex queries using joins, common table expressions (CTEs), window functions, and other advanced SQL techniques.
Experience building and maintaining dashboards, reporting models, and analytical solutions using tools such as Sigma, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret business requirements, investigate data, and translate findings into practical recommendations.
Experience partnering directly with business stakeholders to gather requirements, manage reporting requests, and communicate analytical findings.
Proficiency with Excel, Google Sheets, or similar spreadsheet tools for data analysis and reporting.
Strong organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize competing requests, manage multiple deliverables, and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced environment.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice to Have

Experience using Python for data manipulation, reporting automation, or workflow improvements.
Exposure to statistical analysis, data science libraries, or machine learning concepts.

What Sets You Up For Success

Enjoy solving practical business problems and using data to help teams make better decisions.
Take ownership of your work, from understanding the initial request to delivering accurate, actionable insights.
Are naturally curious, ask thoughtful questions, and look beyond the immediate request to understand the underlying business challenge.
Build strong relationships with stakeholders and communicate confidently with colleagues across different functions and levels of technical expertise.
Can balance competing priorities, adapt to changing business needs, and deliver quality work without losing sight of the bigger picture.
Bring strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and a commitment to producing reliable analysis.
Are eager to expand your technical capabilities, develop deeper business knowledge, and grow alongside an experienced analytics team.

Compensation

The expected range for this position is $75,000 - $105,000 per year
. This reflects typical earning potential in this role based on market data and individual factors including skill sets, experience, and geographic location. In addition to salary, full-time employees are eligible for an equity package and competitive benefits that support you and your family as part of your total rewards package at Flock Freight. We target candidates local or willing to relocate to Flock Freight’s San Diego headquarters.

Life & Benefits Of The Flock

Hybrid Work Model: As an organization we value in-office collaboration, working cross-functionally, and winning together. Through scheduled in-office and work from home days, we are able to work more efficiently and collaboratively. (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday in-Office)
401(k): We know Flock may just be a stepping stone in your epic journey, but we want to be sure you’re setting your future self up for success!
Medical, Dental & Vision: Generous coverage for employees and dependents. Both HMO and PPO options provided.

Our Promise To You

Flock Freight is committed to creating an environment that’s fair and inclusive. We fill our open positions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We value the skills of people from all backgrounds and are proud to hire, promote, and retain talent from a diverse candidate pool. Diverse perspectives are central to innovation at Flock Freight and make our team better. We're interested in your inherent abilities, not just the skills you bring from your last role - if you think you have what it takes to succeed in the role but don't check every box, please still get in touch. We'd love to start a conversation with you.

Flock Freight has zero tolerance for behavior that negatively impacts marginalized groups, including women, people of color, veterans, immigrants, people with disabilities, and members of the LGBTQIA+ community. We invite people of all identities to join the Flock!

We are targeting talent in the San Diego/Encinitas and Los Angeles area.

jobs.title: Database/Python Generalist
jobs.description:
Why Castelion, Why Now

Castelion is moving incredibly fast to develop and deliver advanced defense systems at a time when execution matters more than ever. We believe focus, ownership, and excellence are decisive advantages - and we're building a world-class team to turn bold ideas into real capability.

This is a rare opportunity to join at an early stage, where you'll have significant ownership, collaborate with exceptional teammates, and make a direct, measurable impact on our mission and the future of the company - regardless of your function.

Database/Python Generalist

Castelion is seeking a Database / Python Generalist to build and improve the Seeker Team’s calibration automation tooling, PostgreSQL infrastructure, and Python backend services. This role will make far-field calibration faster, more reliable, and easier to execute while enabling engineering teams to access the correct calibration data automatically.

You will work across database architecture, query optimization, data pipelines, and hardware-facing test systems, partnering with algorithm, ML, and test teams to improve existing systems and build scalable solutions. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on practical improvements that directly accelerate seeker development and testing.

Responsibilities

Own calibration automation: Develop far-field calibration tooling that combines individual tests into an end-to-end suite runner with resume-from-failure capabilities.
Build calibration data infrastructure: Develop Golden Calibration data systems and a Calibration Dependency Graph to support reliable, automated calibration workflows.
Optimize PostgreSQL performance: Improve schemas, queries, indexes, partitioning, and data access patterns to accelerate calibration data products and visualization.
Evolve database architecture: Design schemas, ORM models, and shared data types to support new requirements from algorithm and ML teams.
Build reliable data pipelines: Develop ingestion and synchronization workflows with appropriate retry, idempotency, consistency, and conflict-handling strategies.
Maintain production databases safely: Implement schema migrations, backfills, indexing changes, and data-retention, archival, and deletion policies.
Develop Python services: Build and maintain production backend services, APIs, database utilities, and reusable data-access components.
Support hardware-facing testing: Contribute to Python-based test systems and chamber-testing workflows to expand testing capacity and reduce calibration runtime.
Improve existing systems pragmatically: Identify bottlenecks, implement targeted improvements, and avoid unnecessary redesigns.

Basic Qualifications

Strong Python software engineering skills, including experience building production services and APIs.
Demonstrated experience architecting PostgreSQL schemas for real-world applications and safely modifying production databases.
Deep PostgreSQL expertise, including indexing, query planning, transactions, locking, and performance analysis.
Experience using EXPLAIN and EXPLAIN ANALYZE to optimize real-world query patterns.
Experience designing safe schema migrations, backfills, and concurrent index changes.
Experience building reliable data-ingestion pipelines and multi-database synchronization systems.
Experience with ORMs and direct SQL, with sound judgment about when to use each.
Understanding of partitioning, batching, pagination, and efficient bulk reads and writes.
Experience developing shared Python types, database models, and reusable data-access tools.

Preferred Skills And Experience

Experience automating data-retention, archival, and deletion policies.
Experience building calibration, test automation, or engineering data-management systems.
Familiarity with hardware-facing Python test systems and chamber testing.
Experience supporting algorithm development, machine learning, or other data-intensive engineering workflows.
Experience designing dependency-aware data pipelines and systems that select the correct data products automatically.
Ability to improve existing systems through targeted, measurable changes while maintaining reliability.

The Global Servicing Decision Science (GSDS) team is the Decision Science engine for Global Servicing, bringing together advanced analytics, data science, AI/GenAI, and decisioning to transform servicing experiences, empower colleagues, and enable intelligent operations. GSDS serves as a centralized Decision Science Center of Excellence, partnering across Product/Capabilities, Control Management, Strategy, Operations, Technology, and enterprise analytics and data science teams.

GSDS builds and scales servicing intelligence across Global Servicing—from predictive and proactive servicing, personalization, next-best-action and journey orchestration to conversational AI, agent assist, AI-powered coaching, conduct and quality monitoring, and complaint and dispute intelligence. As a Manager, you will contribute to and increasingly own end-to-end Decision Science work that helps build the next generation of servicing intelligence at American Express. You will translate customer, colleague, and operational challenges into analytical approaches, models, experiments, and scalable AI-driven solutions, working with business and Technology partners to move capabilities from concept through implementation and optimization.

This role combines hands-on technical depth with strong business problem solving. You will work on modern capabilities—including Agentic AI, transformer-based recommendation systems, and Conversational AI—while building your ability to lead workstreams, influence partners, and connect technical solutions to measurable customer and business outcomes.

Responsibilities

Decision Science and Business Problem Solving:

Own defined Decision Science problems and workstreams—from problem framing and analysis through solution development, experimentation, measurement, and ongoing optimization—with guidance only on the most complex or ambiguous challenges.

AI/GENAI & Advanced Modeling

Design and develop AI/ML and GenAI solutions spanning prediction, recommendation, optimization, experimentation, and intelligent orchestration.
Apply and evaluate modern AI approaches—including Agentic AI and agentic workflows, transformer-based recommenders and representation learning, Conversational AI/LLM systems, and advanced personalization or next-best-action methods—to servicing use cases.

Scalable Solutions & Execution

Build and enhance reusable data science products and decisioning capabilities, working with Technology and platform teams to support productionization and measure impact.
Apply robust experimentation, monitoring, and continuous-learning approaches that improve model/AI quality and business outcomes over time.

Leadership & Cross Functional Influence

Lead defined workstreams and contribute to the development of other colleagues through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and technical support, while demonstrating strong ownership and problem solving.
Synthesize analysis into clear recommendations and narratives; communicate effectively with partners and contribute to decisions on solution choices, priorities, and execution.

Experience applying AI/GenAI techniques, with a strong technical foundation in solution development, experimentation, and model/AI evaluation.
Experience owning analytical workstreams and collaborating across cross-functional teams to move solutions from analysis and development toward implementation and measurable impact.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical work into clear business recommendations and collaborate effectively with stakeholders.

Experience with Agentic AI/agentic workflows, transformer architectures or transformer-based recommendation systems, Conversational AI, LLMs, or related modern AI capabilities.
Experience with personalization, recommendation systems, next-best-action, optimization, customer decisioning, or intelligent automation.
Understanding of the end-to-end Decision Science lifecycle, including experimentation, productionization, monitoring, governance, and continuous optimization.
Experience working with large-scale customer, behavioral, interaction, or operational datasets and developing reusable data science products.
Developing commercial acumen and storytelling skills, with the ability to connect analytical and technical choices to customer and business value.

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst
with at least 4 years of professional experience
to transform complex business data into meaningful insights that support strategic decision-making, operational efficiency, and business performance.
This position offers an opportunity to work within a large enterprise environment, collaborating with Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Finance, Product, Operations, Marketing, and Technology teams
to develop analytical solutions that improve organizational performance.
The Data Analyst will be responsible for collecting, analyzing, validating, and interpreting structured datasets, developing interactive dashboards, monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs), and delivering actionable business recommendations.
The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in SQL, Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Python, data visualization, statistical analysis, and business intelligence reporting
with excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
We are looking for an analytical professional who can go beyond producing reports to identify trends, explain performance drivers, uncover business opportunities, and support measurable improvements.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Collect, clean, validate, and analyze data from multiple enterprise systems and business sources.
Write and optimize complex SQL queries
to extract, transform, and analyze datasets.
Develop interactive dashboards, automated reports, and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau
, or comparable business intelligence platforms.
Analyze business performance, customer behavior, operational efficiency, and emerging trends.
Establish and monitor KPIs, performance metrics, and reporting frameworks
.
Perform exploratory data analysis, trend analysis, variance analysis, and statistical assessments.
Use Python, Excel, and analytical tools
to streamline reporting and automate repetitive data tasks.
Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into analytical solutions.
Identify data inconsistencies, investigate root causes, and support improvements in data quality.
Develop clear reports and presentations that communicate analytical findings to business leadership.
Support forecasting, business planning, and performance improvement through data-driven insights.
Maintain documentation for data definitions, analytical methodologies, and reporting processes.

Job Qualifications and Requirements

Minimum 4 years of professional experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Reporting Analytics, or a closely related analytical role required.

Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, Business Analytics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong proficiency in SQL
, including joins, aggregations, subqueries, common table expressions, and analytical functions.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel
, including PivotTables, complex formulas, data modeling, and reporting.
Hands-on experience with Power BI, Tableau
, or comparable data visualization and business intelligence tools.
Experience using Python, including pandas and NumPy
, for data analysis or automation is highly valued.
Strong understanding of data cleaning, validation, transformation, and exploratory data analysis.
Experience with data warehouses, relational databases, and enterprise reporting environments
.
Familiarity with Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift
, or comparable cloud data platforms is advantageous.
Knowledge of statistical analysis, KPI development, dashboard design, and business performance measurement.
Experience working with cross-functional business stakeholders.
Excellent written, verbal, and data presentation skills.

Strong analytical reasoning and attention to detail.
Ability to translate complex datasets into understandable business insights.
Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
Strong organizational and time-management skills.
Ability to independently investigate data issues and validate findings.
Business-oriented mindset with an understanding of how analytics supports decision-making.
Strong communication skills with technical and nontechnical audiences.
Comfortable managing multiple analytical priorities and reporting deadlines.
Effective collaboration within distributed and remote teams.
Commitment to data accuracy, confidentiality, and continuous professional learning.

Strategic Support

Provide analytical insights supporting enterprise business strategy and operational planning.
Help identify opportunities for revenue growth, cost optimization, and process improvement.
Support development of standardized KPI frameworks and business intelligence capabilities.
Contribute to data-driven decision-making across business functions.
Identify opportunities to improve reporting automation and analytical efficiency.
Support data governance, data quality, and consistent metric definitions.
Provide analytical perspectives for digital transformation and business improvement initiatives.

Remote position within the United States.

Full-time position within a large enterprise business and technology environment.

Job Purpose:

The Senior Clinical Research Associate (Sr. CRA) is responsible for the site management, site monitoring and close-out of assigned clinical trials investigator sites to ensure patient safety and quality study execution in accordance with applicable prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices (GCP), and sponsor standards. The Sr. CRA is accountable for site management and monitoring, managing investigator site relationships to ensure effective delivery of clinical trials (e.g. enrollment, database release), to safeguard the quality of investigator sites (e.g. patient safety, site quality and compliance with GCP), to maintain investigator and site staff engagement and satisfaction, and to enhance the company’s image with its external stakeholders. The Sr. CRA is responsible for the resolution of all protocol-related issues for assigned investigator sites and will work closely with the Site Care Partner (SCP), and other members of the study team, as required, in activities associated with the set-up, running and close-out of sites in a clinical trial.

Manage assigned operational aspects for implementation of clinical trial activities at assigned investigator sites from site activation through to database lock, ensuring relevant timelines and quality deliverables are met

jobs.title: Senior Bioinformatics Scientist
jobs.description:
At Nautilus, we have a big and important mission: positively impact the health and lives of people around the world by unleashing the potential of the proteome. We are developing a single-molecule protein analysis platform of unprecedented sensitivity, scale, and ease of use that we believe will democratize access to the proteome – one of the most dynamic and valuable sources of biological insight. To accomplish this, we are pursuing hard scientific problems with an entrepreneurial mindset and creating a world-class team of builders, innovators, and dreamers across a wide range of disciplines.

We are actively seeking a talented Senior Bioinformatics Scientist
to join our growing team. We are building a new assay modality on our platform, and its success depends on tight iteration between the bench and the data. In this role, you will own the analysis side of this effort end to end: partnering daily with experimentalists to troubleshoot and optimize protocols, analyzing every type of data the platform produces, explaining what the results mean, and recommending what to try next. You will also build the pipeline for this new data type and work with R&D leadership to frame findings. We are looking for an applied, hands-on scientist who gets things done – someone who values progress over perfection, isn't afraid to dive into unfamiliar territory, knocks down barriers without waiting to be asked, and is a partner the experimental team looks forward to working with.

This position will report to a Bioinformatics Fellow. This position is based in San Carlos, CA. A minimum of three days in the office is required.

Responsibilities

Partner side by side with experimentalists to develop and optimize a new assay format, including designing experiments, selecting which conditions to vary, defining the metrics that determine success, and recommending a path forward based on the results.
Troubleshoot protocols by forming and testing hypotheses that span sample preparation, reagents, fluidics, imaging, and data processing.
Analyze and integrate data across every modality the platform produces, including images, fluidics readouts, fluorescence signals, and decoded single-molecule outputs.
Own the interpretation of results – what the data mean, how confident we should be, and what to do next – and work with R&D leadership to frame findings, communicate progress & risks, and inform project direction.
Design and build a durable analysis pipeline, quality control metrics, and dashboards for this new data type, balancing rapid one-off analyses with tested, reusable tools the broader team can run.
Work with the bioinformatics team to develop new analytical and statistical approaches for interpreting stochastic single-molecule measurements.
Quickly learn to locate and access assay data wherever it lives, including cloud databases, object storage, on-premises file servers, and raw instrument output, writing code to parse instrument metadata and managing cloud access as needed.

Requirements

A PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Biophysics, Biochemistry, Biostatistics, or a related quantitative field.
A minimum of 4 years of experience in industry.
A track record as an applied, hands-on scientist who gets things done: comfortable making progress with imperfect information, diving into unfamiliar territory, and removing obstacles.
Hands-on experience analyzing data from wet-lab experiments, with a demonstrated record of assay development or optimization in close partnership with experimental teams.
Demonstrated ability to own a project end to end, from experimental design and analysis through interpretation and recommendations.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to frame results for leadership and explain technical findings to non-computational audiences.
Solid foundation in applied statistics, including distributions & variability, hypothesis testing, and experimental design.
Proficient in Python (e.g., pandas, NumPy, SciPy) and SQL, with experience building both durable pipelines & dashboards and rapid one-off analyses.
Comfortable working across local machines, shared servers, and cloud environments (e.g., AWS), including Linux, Git, and managing access credentials.
Ability to contribute on an organized and dynamic team in a fast-paced environment.
Hands-on wet-lab experience strongly preferred.
Experience with proteomics, fluorescence imaging, single-molecule methods, instrument development, or affinity reagents preferred.
Experience with probabilistic modeling of stochastic data or protein structural modeling preferred.

Nautilus Team Culture

We are curious go-getters: this is a team of life-long learners who aren’t afraid to tackle the big challenges and we embrace the journey.
We are detail-oriented: we do great science by working smart & with diligence where we learn from our trials and mistakes.
We are easy to work with: we want our workplace to be one where everyone can share their perspective and be treated with respect and kindness.

Compensation Range: $126K - $182K

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **About the Team**

The Engineering Systems and Tools team designs, builds, and maintains the internal systems, applications, and infrastructure that power engineering across Anduril. We own the CAD, PLM, and engineering data ecosystem that every mechanical and electrical engineer at the company depends on to design, iterate, and deliver defense technology at speed. Our team sits at the intersection of engineering, IT, and product development — we don't just keep the lights on, we build the tools and architecture that make Anduril's engineering org faster, more consistent, and more capable. If you want your work to directly multiply the output of hundreds of engineers building autonomous systems, this is the team to be on.

### **About the Role**

The CAD Systems Architect is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the enterprise CAD (Computer-Aided Design) ecosystem. This role bridges engineering, IT, and business operations to ensure CAD platforms, tools, and workflows align with organizational goals and support efficient product development. The architect serves as the technical authority for CAD strategy, governance, and integration across the organization, partnering with cross-functional teams to drive innovation, standardization, and operational excellence.

#### **What You'll Do**

* Evaluate emerging CAD technologies
* Develop long-term strategies for CAD infrastructure and integrations
* Support the establishment of CAD standards, best practices, and governance policies
* Design scalable CAD system architectures supporting multi-site collaboration
* Architect integrations between other CAD applications (MCAD, ECAD) and PLM
* Ensure interoperability across CAD platforms and file formats (STEP, IGES, JT, etc.)
* Partner with engineering teams to understand design workflow needs
* Work with IT to ensure infrastructure supports CAD performance requirements
* Provide technical leadership to CAD administrators and support staff
* Support CAD documentation, standards, and templates

#### **Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience with CAD systems in engineering environments
* 3+ years in a CAD administration, architecture, or leadership role
* Proven experience with PLM/PDM platforms (preferably Teamcenter)
* High proficiency in one or more major CAD platforms (preferably NX)
* Strong knowledge of CAD file formats, translators, and data exchange standards
* Programming/scripting experience (Python, C#, VBA, Lisp, or CAD-specific APIs)
* Experience with version control and system configuration management
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
* Demonstrated leadership, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration abilities

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
* Experience in regulated industries (aerospace, automotive, medical devices)
* Knowledge of MBD (Model-Based Definition) and MBSE (Model-Based Systems Engineering)
* Familiarity with AI/ML applications in CAD and generative design
* Experience leading enterprise-wide CAD transformations or migrations

Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. jobs.title: AI Biologist - Microscopy
jobs.description:
**AI Biologist - Microscopy**

Latch builds rigorous scientific benchmarks (benchmarks.bio) for AI agents across biology. We work with frontier labs and pharma to measure whether agents can handle real biological workflows: the messy, multi-layer reasoning that matters in the field.

We’re seeking an AI Biologist to join our Microscopy team, pushing what AI can achieve in biological imaging.

**About the Role.** You will be the scientific authority on ground truth, testing whether agents can reason like an expert microscopist. AI agents today struggle to interrogate raw images, separate real biology from artifacts in acquisition, staining, and segmentation, and reach conclusions an expert would stand behind. Experts themselves disagree on roughly 1 in 6 images, so knowing where the evidence ends is part of the work. You will work with software engineers and scientists to build the tasks and datasets behind our benchmarks across cell biology, tissue, and disease. Your judgment will set the standard agent outputs are held to, including:

**Build the task**

* Define what expert reasoning looks like for an imaging question, and write gold-standard answers with the rationale an experienced microscopist or pathologist would defend
* Design realistic scenarios across the imaging workflow: sample prep, staining, acquisition, preprocessing, segmentation, quantification, and interpretation
* Curate image datasets across modalities: immunofluorescence, confocal and live-cell, electron microscopy, histology and histopathology, and high-content screening
* Build analysis pipelines in Python, including deep-learning segmentation, that produce verifiable ground truth
* Partner with software engineers to turn your judgment into new workflows

**Set the hard calls**

* Test whether agents distinguish true signal from artifact, such as bleed-through, uneven illumination, fixation damage, out-of-focus planes, or segmentation failure
* Adjudicate ambiguous images: decide what the data supports, where reasonable experts would disagree, and which additional stain, image, or experiment would settle the call
* Test whether agents choose the right imaging modality, resolution, and unit of analysis for the question

**Judge the agent**

* Interrogate agent reasoning step by step, and challenge conclusions that sound right but would not survive pathologist review or lab meeting
* Pinpoint where agents go wrong: why a step fails, what an expert would do instead, and what evidence would change the call
* Score agent confidence, rewarding explicit uncertainty over overconfident calls on ambiguous images

**Requirements**

* PhD in cell biology, bioimage analysis, pathology, or a related field; or an MD with pathology training
* Senior, hands-on imaging experience: you have looked at thousands of samples and know what normal and abnormal look like
* Direct experience with image segmentation tools such as CellProfiler, Cellpose, StarDist, QuPath, ilastik, napari, or Fiji
* Deep expertise in at least one area (bioimage analysis, cell biology, or histopathology) and working fluency across the others
* Strong command of experimental design, image quantification, and statistics
* AI-ready from day one: daily use of Claude, Cursor, or similar agents, with the judgment to spot where model reasoning is technically correct but scientifically unsound
* Confidence to overrule an AI agent when the evidence demands it, and the openness to update when shown wrong
* Ability to calibrate confidence and communicate uncertainty rather than defaulting to binary calls
* Bonus: electron microscopy, pathology, or pharmacology experience (e.g., pharmacodynamic or drug-uptake imaging assays)
* Bonus: familiarity with public resources such as the Image Data Resource (IDR), BioImage Archive, Human Protein Atlas, Cell Painting Gallery, or TCGA whole-slide images

**Culture.** We practice radical transparency: you’ll know how the company is doing, what’s working, and what isn’t. It’ll always be us against the problem, never each other. We’re opinionated but respectful, and we bring solutions with our problems. You decide how you work; we judge the output. We use AI constantly, so what we reward is original expert judgment, not AI output passed off as your own. You’ll start on the bench that fits your expertise and can move across teams as you build a track record. People who do well here and bring leadership experience can move quickly into senior roles. Outside of work, we have company outings most months, team off-sites, a Latch run club, cycling, boxing, ice skating, and soccer. Feel free to add to the list.

**Compensation & Logistics**

* **Contract:** 1099 (or W-8BEN internationally), no end date
* **Pay:** guaranteed for weeks 1-4 while you ramp, then paid per certified task. Most people in this position earn $120K–$180K+ (uncapped upside); certify twice the tasks/week, earn twice the pay that week.
* **Commitment:** full-time, on your own schedule. Most of the team works 40+ hours a week.
* **Meetings:** a few pod check-ins a week. The rest of your time is yours.
* **Location:** remote (anywhere), hybrid, or onsite in SF. We prefer onsite.
* **Onsite perks:** catered lunch and dinner daily, a waterfront office in Mission Bay, and monthly parking when available
* **Work authorization:** US citizens, permanent residents, and OPT holders. We can’t support STEM OPT extensions or sponsorship.

**Interview Process**

We move fast: about 2–3 weeks from your first call, to offer.

* Intro Screen - Latch Talent Team
* Take-Home Project - HackerRank
* Technical Interview - Member of Technical Staff
* Culture Interview - C-Suite
* Offer

jobs.title: Quality Control Technician
jobs.description:
**JOB OVERVIEW:**  
The Quality Control Technician will be responsible for all aspects of the quality programs and functions. These include maintaining all HACCP, food safety records, plant audits, mock recall programs and training the plant on these issues and procedures. Performs testing to validate the microbiological quality of current and new ingredients, suppliers, and packages. Provides test data to assure the production of high quality products. Tests current and new concentrate ingredients in process and finished concentrates, and beverages products in development and finished products. The QC Technician will also work with the R&D Team on new product launches.
  
  
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

* Knowledge of all cleaning agents and applications, external, internal, cleaners, and sanitizers.
* Properly document and follow all procedures set forth in the frequency guide and standards.
* Ability to properly fill out batch reports, calculate variations in batch sizes, proper attributes, standards, and other data required on batch report documented per formula.
* Ability to properly measure and follow proper mixing procedures.
* Ability to evaluate and troubleshoot batch and make corrections.
* Ability to perform all testing, evaluations, and documentation of results while following procedures.
* Ability to troubleshoot and take corrective action on the line.
* Ability to properly prepare batch tanks for batching, tank rinsing, tank sanitation, odor, and tasting.
* Full knowledge and capabilities to perform internal pest control program, location of stations, checking and cleaning of stations, and proper documentation on hand of pest control program.
* Assist supervisors in resolving Quality Control issues, tracking quality trends, recommending and implementing plans to improve quality and production efficiency.
* Responsible for compliance with Federal and State legislation by establishing and enforcing quality standards; testing materials and product.
* Ability to collect, analyze and summarize process quality information and trends.
* Computer literacy required with proficiency in Microsoft Office products including Excel and Word.
* Typically faces situations that have a variety of interpretations and require careful evaluation.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS:**  
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret common information, reports and other documents. Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies, or company representatives. Ability to effectively present information to management.
  
  
**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**  
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable
  
accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to walk, stand for long periods of time, sit and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands and fingers, to handle, or feel, sit for long periods of time, stand frequently, bend, squat, reach and turn to access files and office equipment. Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.
  
  
**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**  
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Field positions will be exposed to various unfamiliar conditions where Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) must be worn and which may include, but are not limited to manufacturing and warehouse plants, and other locations as directed by supervisor. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate, but increases significantly in warehouse and manufacturing plants.
  
  
**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**  
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.
  

* High School Diploma or GED preferred or equivalent experience.
* 2-3 years hands-on work experience in the carbonated soft drink industry preferred.
* Experience in quality control testing procedures and internal and external sanitation of beverage equipment with a clear understanding of all aspects of blending, product attributes recordkeeping, yields, etc.
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft business applications and various reporting software.
* Exceptional interpersonal and verbal communication skills
* Understands and can follow all OSHA required training.
* Must be 18 years or older
* Favorable background and drug exam.
* Ability and willingness to work a flexible Full Time schedule that may include weekends and holidays.
* Must be able to provide own transportation to various locations in organizational service areas, as required by duties.
