jobs.title: Senior Healthcare Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

The Senior Healthcare Data Analyst is a full-time, senior individual contributor responsible for clinical, outcomes, and program analytics across the organization. Based in the United States, this role partners with clinical, operational, and executive leaders to turn complex questions into clear, meaningful insights.

The position requires an understanding of behavioral health care delivery across the patient journey, including referral, intake, admission, treatment, utilization, outcomes, and discharge. Additionally, this role helps advance AI-enabled analytical methods within the data analysis function, utilizing AI to enhance analytical speed, depth, and efficiency while establishing repeatable processes, independently validating outputs, and ensuring clinical and human oversight.

Key Responsibilities

Analyze access, conversion, census, capacity, utilization, length of stay, patient engagement, clinical outcomes, and program performance.
Develop an understanding of behavioral health care delivery, including intake, treatment planning, group, individual, and family therapy, psychiatry, documentation, authorization, outcomes, and discharge.
Partner with clinical and operational leaders to translate clinical workflows and complex operational questions into meaningful analyses, recommendations, and actionable insights.
Ensure analytical findings reflect actual care delivery workflows and are interpreted within appropriate clinical and operational contexts.
Identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities to improve care delivery, patient experience, and program performance.
Partner with clinical and research leaders to define research questions, outcome measures, analytical approaches, and data requirements for clinical studies and program evaluations.
Build accurate, well-documented, and reproducible datasets and analyses for outcomes research, program evaluations, presentations, abstracts, and publications.
Conduct and interpret analyses evaluating patient outcomes, treatment and program effectiveness, and differences across populations, programs, or levels of care.
Translate findings into publication-ready tables, visualizations, summaries, and presentation materials, supporting analytical review through final publication.
Ensure research and publication data and analyses comply with organizational privacy, governance, compliance, and data-use standards.
Serve as an analytics partner to clinical, operational, and executive leadership, establishing and maintaining trusted metric definitions, documentation, analytical standards, and best practices.
Partner with Data Engineering and other analysts to maintain consistent definitions, reliable data, scalable solutions, and standardized dashboards or reporting workflows.
Identify opportunities to improve analytical methods, tools, workflows, and organizational data use while mentoring other analysts.
Apply and advance AI-enabled analytical methods to improve the speed, depth, quality, and efficiency of analytical workflows.
Use AI tools to accelerate data exploration, analytical development, synthesis, and quality review, establishing repeatable prompts, workflows, and standards.
Independently validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, relevance, bias, and context, maintaining human accountability for all final analytical conclusions.
Collaborate with clinical subject matter experts and technology teams to evaluate AI capabilities and integrate them into governed analytical workflows.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Statistics, Information Systems, Healthcare Administration, Health Informatics, Public Health, or a relevant clinical discipline (such as Psychology, Social Work, Counseling, or Nursing), or equivalent relevant experience.
5+ years of experience in analytics, healthcare analytics, business intelligence, or related analytical work. Candidates with a clinical background must also have demonstrated experience using data to evaluate care delivery, patient outcomes, program performance, or other complex healthcare questions.
Experience working with healthcare clinical operations and translating clinical workflows and business questions into meaningful analysis.
Experience analyzing healthcare performance metrics, including access, utilization, quality, outcomes, or program effectiveness.
Experience with modern analytics and business intelligence platforms, such as Power BI.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to independently investigate complex clinical and operational questions.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into clear insights for clinical, operational, and executive audiences.
Experience using AI or generative AI to support analytical work, with an understanding of how to validate outputs and manage the risks and limitations of AI-generated analysis.
Strong communication, prioritization, facilitation, and stakeholder partnership skills.
Understanding of healthcare privacy, security, compliance, and the proper handling of protected health information (PHI).

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in behavioral health, intensive outpatient programs (IOP), partial hospitalization programs (PHP), outpatient mental health, substance use treatment, or similar clinical environments.
Familiarity with behavioral health workflows, including intake, treatment planning, therapy, psychiatry, documentation, utilization management, outcomes measurement, and discharge.
Experience with clinical outcomes, program evaluation, or research-related analytics.
Experience working with electronic health records (EHR/EMR) and healthcare operational systems.
Experience incorporating AI-assisted methods into analytical workflows or working with modern cloud data and analytics platforms, such as Microsoft Fabric.

Compensation and Benefits

The expected salary range for this role is $95,000—$112,000 USD
per year. Individual compensation within this range is determined by factors including years of experience, type of experience, work location, education, and relevant certifications.
Eligible positions have access to a competitive benefits package, including:
Health coverage, including medical, dental, and vision plans
Retirement savings plan with company match
Paid time off
Parental leave
Professional development and continuous training opportunities

Eurofins Scientific is a network of independent companies providing a unique range of analytical testing

services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. jobs.title: Clinical Laboratory Scientist-Senior Andrologist
jobs.description:
Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS) – Senior Andrologist

RMA Northern California soon to be Everleap Fertility is seeking a full-time Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS) – Senior Andrologist to join our growing Andrology Department located in San Francisco, California.
The Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS) – Senior Andrologist is responsible for performing and overseeing advanced andrology and reproductive laboratory procedures within a fertility clinic setting. This role supports male fertility evaluation, endocrine testing, and assisted reproductive technologies (ART) by performing semen analyses, sperm preparation, hormone testing, and laboratory quality management while ensuring compliance with California laboratory regulations.

Join a highly specialized fertility team where your expertise directly impacts patients on their family-building journey. Unlike traditional hospital laboratory settings, this role offers a more predictable schedule, limited overnight coverage, and a supportive, collaborative environment focused on reproductive medicine.

What We Offer

Predictable and stable scheduling
Limited or no overnight coverage requirements
Predictable weekend and holiday rotations
Smaller team environment with greater visibility and collaboration
Specialized reproductive medicine and fertility testing
Opportunity to work alongside expert embryologists and fertility specialists
Improved work-life balance and reduced burnout compared to hospital laboratories
Comprehensive benefits package, retirement plan, and generous paid time off

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Clinical Laboratory Scientist to grow their career with a global leader in reproductive medicine while making a meaningful difference in patients' lives.

Purpose

The Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS) – Senior Andrologist serves as the technical and operational leader for the Andrology and Endocrinology Laboratory. This position is responsible for performing advanced diagnostic testing, maintaining regulatory compliance, ensuring laboratory quality standards, supervising laboratory personnel, and supporting fertility treatment through andrology and hormone testing services.

All laboratory testing and procedures must be conducted in accordance with laboratory policies, CAP, CLIA, FDA, OSHA, HIPAA, and California Department of Public Health (CDPH) regulations. Attention to detail, technical expertise, leadership, and commitment to quality patient care are essential to success in this role.

Responsibilities
Andrology Laboratory Testing

Perform diagnostic semen analysis according to WHO guidelines and laboratory protocols.
Conduct advanced sperm function testing, including:
Morphology assessment
Motility and vitality analysis
Sperm concentration and total motile count
DNA fragmentation testing, when applicable

Prepare sperm samples for Assisted Reproductive Technologies (ART), including:
Intrauterine Insemination (IUI)
In Vitro Fertilization (IVF)
Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection (ICSI)

Process surgical sperm retrieval specimens, including:
TESA
PESA
Micro-TESE

Review, validate, and accurately report andrology laboratory testing results.

Endocrinology & Hormone Testing

Perform and oversee reproductive endocrinology testing related to fertility diagnostics.
Operate immunoassay analyzers, including Roche Cobas e411, for hormone testing such as:
FSH
LH
Estradiol
Progesterone
AMH
Testosterone
hCG
Prolactin

Perform linearity verification and calibration verification (CALVER) according to laboratory validation protocols.
Conduct and document CAP Proficiency Testing (PT) in compliance with CLIA and CDPH requirements.
Troubleshoot analyzer performance issues and implement corrective actions as needed.
Perform routine preventive maintenance, calibration checks, and functional verification of instrumentation.
Monitor assay performance and maintain quality documentation for regulatory inspections.

Sperm Banking & Cryopreservation

Perform sperm cryopreservation and thawing procedures for fertility preservation and donor banking.
Maintain specimen tracking and chain-of-custody documentation.
Ensure compliance with CAP, CLIA, FDA tissue regulations, and CDPH requirements.
Monitor cryostorage systems and maintain accurate inventory records.

Laboratory Operations & Quality Management

Maintain compliance with California Clinical Laboratory licensing regulations.
Implement and maintain laboratory quality assurance and quality control programs.
Perform method validation, verification studies, and instrument performance evaluations.
Assist with preparation for CAP, CLIA, FDA, and CDPH laboratory inspections.
Maintain laboratory documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and quality records.
Remain current on laboratory operating procedures, quality systems, regulatory standards, and industry best practices.
Maintain compliance with OSHA safety requirements and infection control procedures.
Support laboratory inventory management and cost-control efforts while maintaining high-quality laboratory services.

Leadership & Training

Supervise, mentor, and train andrology laboratory personnel.
Ensure staff competency assessments and continuing education compliance.
Participate in hiring, onboarding, and performance management activities.
Assist in the development, implementation, and revision of laboratory SOPs.
Participate in internal audits, regulatory inspections, and laboratory readiness activities.
Promote a culture of quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Clinical Collaboration

Work closely with reproductive endocrinologists, urologists, embryologists, and nursing staff.
Provide technical consultation regarding male fertility testing, sperm preparation methods, and endocrine testing results.
Participate in multidisciplinary patient case discussions and treatment planning.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to support excellent patient outcomes and achieve laboratory objectives.

General Responsibilities

Maintain patient confidence and protect operations by keeping all patient and proprietary information confidential in accordance with HIPAA requirements.
Adhere to all company policies and procedures.
Perform other duties as assigned to support laboratory and patient care needs.

Academic Training

Bachelor's Degree or higher in Clinical Laboratory Science, Biology, Biochemistry, Medical Technology, or a related scientific field – required
Master's Degree in a related scientific discipline – preferred

Licensure

Active California Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS) License issued by the California Department of Public Health (CDPH) – required

Requirements

Minimum five (5) years of laboratory experience in fertility, andrology, reproductive medicine, or related clinical laboratory environments – required
Experience performing semen analysis and sperm preparation for ART procedures – required
Experience performing reproductive endocrinology testing and hormone immunoassay testing – required
Experience operating and troubleshooting Roche Cobas e411 or similar immunoassay analyzers – required
Ability to work in a high-volume, fast-paced laboratory environment.
Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with patients, physicians, and team members.
Ability to work weekends, early mornings, overtime, and on-call schedules as needed.
Ability to travel and provide support to satellite laboratory locations when required.
Excellent organizational, analytical, interpersonal, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in IVF or Assisted Reproductive Technology laboratories.
Familiarity with CAP accreditation standards, CLIA requirements, FDA regulations, and CDPH laboratory regulations.
Experience with instrument validation, proficiency testing programs, and laboratory inspections.
Previous supervisory or team leadership experience within a clinical laboratory setting.

Technical Skills

Electronic Medical Records (EMR) experience – required
Laboratory Information System (LIS) experience preferred
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
Advanced knowledge of male fertility diagnostics and semen analysis methodologies
Expertise in ART sperm preparation techniques
Strong understanding of endocrinology testing and immunoassay instrumentation
Ability to troubleshoot laboratory equipment and perform technical maintenance
Thorough knowledge of CAP, CLIA, FDA, and CDPH regulatory compliance requirements
Strong documentation and quality management skills

Physical Requirements

Ability to sit at a microscope for extended periods while performing semen analyses and sperm preparation procedures.
Some standing, stooping, bending, and reaching above shoulder level.
Moderate lifting of up to 35 pounds.
Manual dexterity and finger coordination required for pipetting and laboratory procedures.
Ability to perform repetitive laboratory tasks with precision and accuracy.
Visual acuity and eye-hand coordination necessary for microscopic evaluations.
Sensory requirements of speech, touch, vision, and hearing within normal range, with or without correction.
Must be able to drive and travel between clinical sites as needed.

Environmental Conditions

Work performed primarily in a temperature-controlled fertility clinic laboratory environment.
Frequent handling of human reproductive specimens and biological materials.
Occupational exposure to bloodborne pathogens and potentially infectious materials.
Exposure to laboratory reagents, liquid nitrogen, cryostorage systems, and electrical laboratory equipment.
Potential physical hazards including burns, cuts, needle sticks, and equipment-related injuries.
May require early morning, weekend, holiday, or on-call work depending on clinical schedules.
Work routines and schedules may occasionally change with limited notice based on patient care needs.

About This Opportunity

As a Senior Bioinformatics Research Engineer, you will work on Freenome’s computational platform for R&D, developing and deploying bioinformatics research software and tooling. As part of an interdisciplinary R&D team, you will work in close collaboration with computational biologists, machine learning scientists and software engineers. You will develop cutting edge solutions at the intersection of machine learning, genetic sequencing technology, biological data, and distributed systems. These contributions will drive our mission to diagnose cancer at its most actionable and early stages.

The role reports to the Director of Bioinformatics Research Engineering. This role can be a Hybrid role based in our Brisbane, California headquarters (2-3 days per week in office), or remote.

What You’ll Do

Work at the intersection of computational biology, machine learning research, software engineering and biological data.
Lead the development of Freenome’s bioinformatics research engineering framework and internal tools.
Build for significant growth and scaling challenges as we transition from research to product development.
Engineer robust and reproducible data pipelines that enable cutting edge liquid biopsy research.
Manage and integrate data sources across the company (laboratory, bioinformatics, clinical) to enable advanced multiomic analysis.
Improve the reliability and scalability of our science platform as it grows.
Develop software and workflows that support a long term vision for bioinformatics research and production.
Enable data driven science discoveries in biology and healthcare.

Must Haves

PhD in a quantitative field such as computational biology, cancer biology, statistics, bioinformatics, computer science, or B.S./M.S. and equivalent experience.
4+ years of experience with bioinformatics infrastructure, automation, and software engineering.
Robust history of delivering major technical projects or analyses.

jobs.description:
About The Role

Hippocratic AI is looking for a Lead Product Data Analyst to drive company-wide product strategy and quantify the clinical, operational, and financial impact of our healthcare AI platform. This isn't a dashboarding role — you will establish the foundational measurement and evaluation strategy for AI clinical agents at scale, including critic frameworks, safety baselines, and quality criteria across all product lines.

You'll partner directly with Executive Leadership, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and clinical leads to solve highly ambiguous strategic challenges: What major product investments should we prioritize? What structural levers drive or limit customer adoption? How do we quantify long-term outcomes for health systems and patients — and prove them with decision-grade data?

The ideal candidate navigates complex, high-stakes ambiguity with ease, translates high-level strategic directives into rigorous analytical programs, and possesses executive-level business judgment to influence product roadmaps and customer partnerships.

What You'll Do

Define how we measure success

Partner across executive, clinical, and product leadership to establish company-wide AI agent evaluation frameworks, critic architectures, and quality baselines.
Define company-level North Star metrics and multi-tier measurement strategies that proactively shape long-term product vision rather than tracking existing adoption.
Design analytical approaches to evaluate product changes and program impact, including in real-world settings where randomized experiments aren't possible.
Conduct pre- and post-launch analysis to determine whether initiatives achieved their intended outcomes.

Turn data into decisions and dollars

Architect end-to-end analytical solutions for complex, unstructured strategic questions, providing high-conviction recommendations to executive decision-makers.
Develop comprehensive financial and business models linking product adoption to health system ROI, clinical outcomes, cost reduction, and value-based care performance.
Partner with technical teams to improve instrumentation so the data behind these decisions is reliable.

Represent the work — internally and with customers

Synthesize complex analytical findings into compelling executive narratives for C-suite leaders and external healthcare partners.
Represent product data strategy and ROI models directly in high-stakes C-suite customer and partner engagements.
Serve as a principal analytics partner across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and GTM, mentoring team members and establishing product analytics standards as the organization scales.

Location Requirement

We believe the best ideas happen together. To support fast collaboration and a strong team culture, this role is expected to be in our Menlo Park office five days a week, unless otherwise specified.

What You Bring

Must-have

6–8+ years of progressive experience in product analytics, product strategy, data analytics, business strategy, or management consulting within high-growth tech or healthcare environments.
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or analytical discipline (Business, Economics, Finance, Statistics, Data Science, CS, Engineering, or related).
Advanced SQL and demonstrated ability to independently analyze large, complex datasets; working Python proficiency preferred.
Track record of driving executive consensus and directly influencing company-wide product strategy, roadmaps, and capital allocation using data.
Experience with product analytics/BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Metabase, or similar).
Design analytical approaches to evaluate product changes and program impact — including in real-world settings where randomized experiments aren't possible.
Proven experience building sophisticated ROI models, business cases, or economic evaluations, presenting directly to VP and C-suite stakeholders.

Nice-to-Have

Experience in product analytics or strategy at a technology, healthcare technology, SaaS, or AI company.
Experience working with healthcare data, products, clinical workflows, or healthcare organizations.
Fluency in healthcare financial and value-based care concepts (e.g., HRRP/readmission economics, value-based care arrangements, risk-based contracting).
Experience designing causal, cohort, funnel, retention, or behavioral analyses, especially where RCTs aren't feasible.
Experience presenting to Director/VP/C-suite or senior customer stakeholders.
Experience with AI, machine learning, or LLM-powered products.
Startup or high-growth experience where responsibilities extend beyond a narrowly defined analytics function.

What Success Looks Like

Success here isn't how many dashboards you build — it's whether your analysis changes a decision. You'll help us understand which product investments matter most, which capabilities create measurable value, and how to prove it with data.

Why Join Hippocratic AI

Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first.
We’re building the world’s first healthcare‑only, safety‑focused LLM — a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation.

Work with the people shaping the future.
Hippocratic AI was co‑founded by CEO Munjal Shah and a team of physicians, hospital leaders, AI pioneers, and researchers from institutions like El Camino Health, Johns Hopkins, Washington University in St. Louis, Stanford, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and NVIDIA.

Backed by the world’s leading healthcare and AI investors.

Build alongside the best in healthcare and AI.
Join experts who’ve spent their careers improving care, advancing science, and building world‑changing technologies — ensuring our platform is powerful, trusted, and truly transformative.

An Overview Of This Role

As a Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll be the deepest technical voice in the field for one product group, helping customers make technical decisions on GitLab's most important opportunities, roughly the top 10% by size or complexity.

Account Solutions Architects (Account SAs) will bring you into prioritized opportunities. The Account SA owns the opportunity; you own your product group's success within it. You'll work directly with Product and Engineering, bringing customer needs and field insights into roadmap discussions. You'll also help the wider Solutions Architecture team build expertise through reusable assets, enablement, and coaching.

You'll specialize in one product group, not all four. In Security & Compliance, you'll focus on GitLab Ultimate, application security, Dependency Firewall, software supply chain security, compliance, and artificial intelligence (AI) governance. In Platform, you'll focus on GitLab Dedicated, self-managed deployments, bring your own model, and cloud and hybrid architecture. In Core DevSecOps, you'll focus on GitLab Premium, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), source code management, Orbit, Artifact Central, and migrations. DevSecOps brings development, security, and operations together across software delivery. In AI & Competitive, you'll focus on GitLab Duo Agent Platform, agentic workflows, AI-native development, competitive displacement including GitHub, and migrations.

Your success will be measured by technical win rate and bookings on SME-engaged opportunities, product-category commit attainment and consumption growth in your region, and Proof of Value (PoV) conversion rate, evaluation cycle time, and time from technical win to production use. Stay involved until the customer's first production workload uses the product, and support complex accounts when Post-Sales SAs bring you in to drive adoption and consumption.
Bring structured field feedback, competitive insights, and customer requirements to Product Management and Engineering with the wider SME team. Help manage early-access and design-partner programs, and represent GitLab through customer events, conferences, industry working groups, and published content.
Build reference architectures, demo environments, competitive battlecards, PoV playbooks, and enablement content so account teams can handle more opportunities without your direct involvement. Mentor Account SAs and contribute to GitLab's global SME community of practice.

What You’ll Bring

Substantial experience in technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, consulting, or software engineering, with deep, hands-on expertise in one domain: application security testing, supply chain security, and compliance; scalable cloud and hybrid platforms; large CI/CD environments and source code migrations; or production AI-assisted development, working prototypes, and competitive evaluations.

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.

LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.

Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual
Russian
-English Video-Phone Interpreter

Job Title:
Russian
Interpreter

Location:
Work at Home position in United States

Position:
Video-Phone Interpreter

Pay:
$23 - $25 per hour.

Compensation will not be less than any applicable state or local minimum wage.

We Offer

Paid professional interpreter training and continuous development.
Incentives for meeting attendance targets.
Benefits include: Paid Sick Leave in accordance with applicable law, Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Accident, Critical Illness & Life, AD&D, Insurance Package, Inpatient Hospital, Short Term Disability, and 401K Retirement.
Employee Referral Program.
Advancement opportunities within the organization.
Interpreter support.
An inclusive and diverse work environment.

Position Overview

The Russian
Video-Telephone- Interpreter
is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Russian
and English
speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment**

Essential Job Functions

Respond to video and audio interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
Participate in online, video and audio training sessions.
Deliver interpretation services via video and expediently type data on a dedicated device, such as a laptop, desktop computer, mobile phone, or tablet, in order to perform the essential functions of the job.
Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the video and audio interpreting sessions at all times.
Remain calm during video and audio interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
Maintain punctuality and availability during scheduled work hours.
Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
**Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

Fluency in Russian and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.

High school diploma or equivalent.

Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.

Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.

jobs.title: Impact & Evaluation Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Location:
Downtown Oakland, in-person/hybrid (currently required in the office three days a week), and you must reside in Oakland/Bay Area.
About Oakland Promise

Oakland Promise’s (“OP”) mission: mobilize Oakland to expand economic mobility through cradle-to-career achievement. OP is both a direct service organization and a backbone organization: providing direct services, convening across local and national partners, and regranting funds to community organizations.
OP direct services are available to young learners (from newborns to college graduates) and their families who reside in Oakland. We offer financial assets, financial education, and college and career readiness to help students and families navigate the path to higher education and pursue careers of their choosing. OP achieves its work across three domains: Early Learning, Kindergarten to 12th Grade, and College & Career. OP applies a three-tiered approach to delivering and coordinating domain services – Citywide (Tier 1), Income-eligible (Tier 2), and Place-based work (Tier 3) – to ensure resources are concentrated on those furthest from opportunity.
Beyond direct service, OP funds community-based organizations doing critical work for Oakland's kids and families, builds Oakland nonprofit capacity through technical assistance, and drives systems change by collaborating with partners positioned to move at scale. OP serves as the lead agency of place-based collective impact work in an East Oakland Promise Neighborhood. OP is also one of two implementation partners for Oakland Children’s Initiative (OCI) Fund, a voter-approved 2018 charter amendment that generates funds through a parcel tax for early childhood education and college access programs in Oakland.
Position Summary

The Data Analyst position reports to the Senior Data Analyst. Under the supervision of the Director of Impact & Evaluation, this role will support the Senior Data Analyst in data gathering, research design, data analysis, and reporting for collective impact evaluation projects, including city and federal grant reporting within a Results-Based Accountability Framework. The Data Analyst will be engaged in monitoring and evaluation learning with other Oakland Promise
teams, working toward efficient, accurate, and impactful data collection, storytelling, and reporting. The Data Analyst should be ready to do hands-on data analysis work with quantitative and qualitative data, including data cleaning and documentation.
Who You Are

You are a detail-oriented, analytical, and collaborative professional passionate about data-driven decision-making and community-based research. You have experience in program evaluation support; survey and research design and implementation; mixed-methods data analysis, analysis using R; coding system management; data visualization and translation for diverse audiences; and engaging with stakeholders. Experience working with or within community-based organizations is a plus.

What You Will Do (Duties and Responsibilities)

1. Support evaluation research and data analysis

Support data collection and data analysis for evaluation projects, including city and federal grant reporting aligned with the Director of Impact & Evaluation’s evaluation strategy.
Utilize state, school district, community partner service data, and OP direct service data for Results-Based Accountability reporting.
Support the Senior Data Analyst on data analysis tasks as needed.

2. Community and Partner Engagement

Engage with community organization partners and schools for evaluation-related activities, coordinating and executing deliverables under supervisory guidance.
Collect and analyze data from partner organizations.
Provide onboarding training and technical assistance to partners and subcontractors as needed.
Prepare data for presentations with schools, partners, and other stakeholders.
Collaborate with the Oakland Unified School District to gather student and caregiver data needed for external reporting.

3. Reporting and deliverables

Prepare and maintain data quality checks for biannual RBA reporting cycles, and assist in preparing analyses for key deliverables including the annual Results-Based Accountability Metrics Report, Annual Report, and federal grant reporting.
Support the Senior Data Analyst with data visualization activities using R, Tableau, and other tools.
Prepare materials for organizational leadership (“Data Step-backs” and “Lunch and Learns”) to support organizational data-informed decision-making.

4. Coding System Management and Data Stewardship

Document and maintain data analysis processes and code for clean, reproducible analyses.
Document recurring processes and procedures in the Data Policies and Procedures Handbook and continuously maintain the handbook as a data operations manual.

5. Event participation

Attend and participate in Oakland Promise meetings.
Participate in 4-6 community events per year, including required events such as the Oakland Promise Awards Ceremony.
These events may fall on weekday nights or weekends.

Professional Characteristics

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Committed to educational equity.
Highly organized and detail-oriented.
Self-motivated and able to work independently.
Curious, eager to learn, and willing to ask questions.
A stickler for ethics and data accuracy.
Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
Comfort with and interest in the real-world complexity of non-profit data.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work collaboratively with different teams with competing priorities.
The ability to stay current with the latest data analytics techniques, tools, and industry trends to keep practices fresh and effective.

Required Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field.
Proficiency in data analysis in R/R Studio/Stata/Python/SAAS strongly preferred, or demonstrated willingness to use R.
At least 2 years of demonstrated experience in data analysis, survey research, and/or evaluation research design for community-based evaluations from a social science lens.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM systems.
Familiarity with federal grant reporting.
2+ years of professional experience with:
Data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, R)
Research design
Program evaluation
Nonprofit or community-based organizations

Compensation and Benefits

Full-time exempt position.
Salary range for this position is $75-85k, commensurate with experience and qualifications.
Oakland Promise currently has a hybrid work policy. Employees work in the downtown Oakland office 3 days/week.
The opportunity to learn and grow within a supportive team environment.
An opportunity to network and interact with education leaders in the community.
Some evening and weekend hours may be required.

To Apply:

Send a single PDF (NOT a Microsoft Word document) of a resume and thoughtful cover letter
to apply@oaklandpromise.org with “Job Name – [Your Name]” in the subject line. Please use your last name and first initial (ex: Doe_J) as the filename of your PDF containing your resume and cover letter. Failure to follow these instructions may delay the review of your application. Applications will be reviewed immediately and candidates with the best fit will be contacted for interviews. Unfortunately, the volume of applications will prevent us from responding to all applications received.
Oakland Promise is a place-based organization located in Oakland, California. Oakland Promise requires that employees work in person at various engagements. It is a requirement that all staff reside within commuting distance to the main office, located at 484 9th Street, Oakland, CA 94607. Please note that at any time, a full in-person work plan may be required, and it is of utmost importance that all staff are able to meet this requirement.

Qualifications

Applicants must hold a Ph.D. in statistics, biostatistics, sports analytics, or a closely related field by August 16, 2027 and have demonstrated excellence in research and a strong commitment to teaching. Outstanding applicants whose research is grounded in statistical science and motivated by sports or human-performance applications will be considered. Areas of interest include, but are not limited to, statistical learning and machine learning, Bayesian methods, causal inference, functional data analysis, longitudinal and spatiotemporal data analysis, high-dimensional data, statistical computing, and other modern methods for complex sports data. Candidates should demonstrate the potential to contribute to core areas of statistics while developing impactful applications in sports analytics.

Principal Duties

Successful candidates will be expected to develop an independent research program in statistical science with strong connections to sports analytics, teach undergraduate and graduate courses in statistics and sports analytics, develop an external funding portfolio, build interdisciplinary connections with researchers and partners in sports and related data-intensive fields, and participate in department, college, and broader university activities.

The Department and College

Purdue’s Department of Statistics is consistently recognized as one of the top statistics programs in the country. The department advances statistical sciences and data science in both theory and applications, with strengths spanning statistical methodology, computation, machine learning, and interdisciplinary data science. The Sports Analytics position will add a distinctive application area in which modern statistical methods can be developed, evaluated, and translated to complex real-world data. The department also plays a central role in Purdue’s statistical science education and connects with broader data-intensive initiatives across the university.

The Department of Statistics is part of the College of Science, which encompasses the mathematical, computational, physical, and life sciences at Purdue. The College is the second-largest at Purdue with over 350 faculty members and more than 7,000 students. The College is pursuing significant new initiatives that align with campus-wide plans. Opportunities for collaboration span statistics, mathematics, computer science, data science, the physical and life sciences, the newly reimagined School of Business, and Purdue’s growing campus presence in the center of Indianapolis. For more information about Purdue’s Department of Statistics, see https://www.stat.purdue.edu/.

Application Procedure

Applications should be submitted online through https://www.mathjobs.org/jobs/PurdueStatistics/PSSA ,and should include (1) a cover letter, (2) a curriculum vitae, (3) a research statement, (4) a teaching statement, and (5) four letters of recommendation, one of which should address the candidate’s teaching qualifications. Reference letter writers should submit their letters online through www.mathjobs.org. Inquiries may be directed to Dr. Kiseop Lee at kiseop@purdue.edu. Applications will be considered on a continuing basis, but candidates are encouraged to apply by Nov 6, 2026 for full consideration. A background check will be required for employment in this position.

The Substation Civil Engineer – Foundation Focus is responsible for advanced engineering analysis and design of substation foundations, including equipment foundations, structure foundations, deep and shallow systems, and ground-supported structural elements. What You’ll Do

Prepare scopes of work, estimates, and technical documentation for foundation engineering on substation projects

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering from an ABET-accredited university
3+ years of foundation or structural engineering experience; 2 additional years accepted in lieu of FE certification.
Proficiency in foundation and structural analysis software (L‑Pile, RISA, Autodesk Inventor, etc.)
Strong understanding of geotechnical engineering principles and interpretation of soil boring data
Experience designing foundations for utility, industrial, or infrastructure projects
Knowledge of industry standards including ASCE, ACI, AISC, and AASHTO
Ability to develop detailed foundation plans and calculation packages with minimal oversight
Proficiency in AutoCAD or Civil 3D; Bentley MicroStation or Bentley Substation experience is a plus
Strong skills in Microsoft Office and PDF markup tools (e.g., Bluebeam)

Additional Skills

Engineer-in-Training (EIT / FE Certification) preferred
Engineer-in-Training (EIT / FE Certification) required, or additional 2 years of civil design experience in lieu of FE certification

Help Build the Future of Healthcare AI

Infinitus is AI communications in service of patients.

Healthcare is inherently complex and siloed. We’re pioneering agentic communications to connect the entire system — any stakeholder, any channel, inbound and out. The result is intelligent care that reduces patient anxiety, increases speed to treatment, and enables teams to scale impact without stretching resources.

Our system combines industry-leading safety guardrails with the largest dynamic knowledge graph built on millions of real-world interactions. It’s why 44% of the healthcare Fortune 50 trusts Infinitus to turn fragmented touchpoints into seamless care for better patient outcomes.

The Mission

At Infinitus, our mission is simple: create time for healthcare by making access, adherence, and affordability easier than ever. We’ve automated over 7 million calls and 100M+ minutes of conversation
— saving millions of hours for patients and providers.

Backed by over $100M from top investors including Google Ventures, Kleiner Perkins, Andreessen Horowitz, and Coatue, we’re a team that challenges the status quo and moves fast at the intersection of AI and healthcare. Infinitus was recently named to Fast Company's World's Most Innovative Companies and Business Insider’s top startups in healthcare .

Your Role

We’re looking for a Data Analyst to help guide the evolution of our analytical ecosystem, ensuring our data isn’t just accessible, but deeply insightful and actionable across the company.

In this role, you’ll be hands-on with complex data exploration, advanced modeling, and the translation of messy healthcare data into clear strategic narratives. You’ll partner closely with our product pods and business leaders to solve high-stakes problems, while also helping define the standards for how we model metrics and validate insights. You’ll bring modern practices to how we conduct deep-dive analyses and build scalable reporting, while helping other analysts and stakeholders level up their ability to work with data.

There are also opportunities to develop skills in AI-assisted analytics, analytics engineering (dbt), advanced experimentation design, and in-depth healthcare data governance, should these areas interest you.

Our team’s mission is to deliver high-fidelity insights and intuitive data assets that empower our internal teams to make faster, more confident decisions when identifying product opportunities, troubleshooting operational bottlenecks, and measuring our impact

Build Analytical Capacity:
Create the frameworks, metric standards, and shared methodologies that empower partner teams to self-serve and unlock new, scalable use cases for insights.

Shape our Analytical Rigor:
Help define our standards for hypothesis testing, experimentation design, and statistical validation. You’ll own the best practices for how we interpret data and ensure "truth" remains consistent as we grow.

Drive Strategic Decisions:
Partner with leaders to turn complex data into a clear path forward, providing the insights that help us decide what to build next and where to invest our resources.

Uplift the Craft:
Help partner teams design better experiments, interpret data more accurately, and ship better insights through technical guidance, documentation, and training.

Scale the Insight Loop:
Expand and maintain automated reporting, alerting, and validation processes that ensure we can monitor performance and identify trends with total confidence.

Ensure Governance by Design:
Integrate rigorous data integrity, privacy, and compliance standards into the analytical workflow, ensuring our insights are as secure as they are actionable.

Your Skillset

5+ years of professional experience in data analytics,
with a track record of tackling complex problems and delivering high-stakes insights.

Deep fluency in SQL,
with the ability to write sophisticated, maintainable queries that serve as a foundation for reliable analysis.

Strong proficiency in Python or R
for advanced data manipulation, statistical modeling, and hypothesis testing.

Comfortable exploring ambiguity
and translating open-ended business questions into well-defined analytical solutions.

Expertise in analytical methodology,
including statistical validation, optimization models, and the ability to interpret trends within messy, multi-source data.

Hands-on with modern visualization and dashboarding tools
(e.g., Sigma, Hex, Tableau, or Looker) to build intuitive data assets and clear narratives.

Mastery of communication,
specifically the ability to translate technical findings into a clear path forward for product teams and executive leadership.

Excited to help others grow
in their use of data and level up the team's collective analytical rigor.

Why You’ll Love It Here

What You’ll Be Part Of

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Circle has made its reputation on being compliant and transparent. You will also work to make sure that the most important financial information we track is well organized and understandable. You’ll also have the opportunity to draw insights from our rich data and help make sure that our teams are looking at these important problems in the right ways. Partner with teams across the company to understand how their products will affect our reporting duties and partner with these teams, accounting, treasury, finance, and data engineering to design data requirements, data models, business logic, and a reporting layer that helps us track and verify that we are meeting our regulatory requirements.

Build scalable automated solutions utilizing SQL, Superset, other reporting tools, scripting languages, and AI.
Occasionally share your results with larger audiences to educate them on the inner workings of our engineering and financial systems.

Multistakeholder - you have dedication and commitment to our customers, shareholders, employees and families and local communities.

Driven by Excellence - you are driven by our mission and our passion for customer success which means you relentlessly pursue excellence, that you do not tolerate mediocrity and you work intensely to achieve your goals.
High Integrity - you seek open and honest communication, and you hold yourself to very high moral and ethical standards. You reject manipulation, dishonesty and intolerance.

Bachelor’s Degree in a quantitative major (Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering)

Strong communication skills and the ability to clearly explain to non-technical audiences and potentially regulators about how the systems you own and design work.
Strong collaboration skills that allow you to make sure that product, product engineering, data engineering, finance, accounting, and treasury are all on the same page regarding reporting and requirements.
A strong sense of ownership and accountability: when a number looks wrong or a report breaks, you take the lead in triaging it, investigating the root cause, and driving it to resolution, and you keep cross functional partners informed until it is fixed.

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Millions of people rely on digital maps every day to navigate, to discover, to find their way. But maps are only as accurate as the data behind them, and data is only as trustworthy as the people who verify it. Your knowledge of USA's geography, local landmarks, and how people actually navigate your region is something no algorithm can fully replicate. Provide structured feedback that helps refine mapping algorithms and improve geographic intelligence

Accurately verified mapping data prevents real-world navigation errors. **Research Assistant**
======================

**About Latent Labs**
---------------------

At Latent Labs, we are building frontier models that learn the fundamentals of biology. We pursue ambitious goals with curiosity and are committed to scientific excellence. Before building Latent Labs, our team co-developed DeepMind’s Nobel-prize winning AlphaFold, invented latent diffusion, and built pioneering lab data management systems as well as high throughput protein screening platforms. At Latent Labs you will be working with some of the brightest minds in generative AI and biology.

Our team is committed to interdisciplinary exchange, continuous learning and collaboration. Team offsites help us foster a culture of trust across our London and San Francisco sites.

We’re looking for innovators passionate about tackling complex challenges and maximizing positive global impact. Join us on our moonshot mission.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We are seeking a curious and engaged Research Associate to join our team working at the interface of generative AI and biology. Working closely with a team of lead scientists, you will help execute and optimize assays to functionally test and characterize novel proteins designed using our proprietary models. This hands-on laboratory role emphasizes mammalian cell culture, cell-based assays, and high-throughput screening (HTS).

This is an opportunity to contribute to an organization applying artificial intelligence to longstanding scientific challenges while developing your experimental skills. You will receive scientific guidance and mentorship, take ownership of routine laboratory workflows, and collaborate with teammates to generate reliable, reproducible data.

* **Use laboratory automation.** Operate liquid handlers, plate readers, and other screening equipment following training and established procedures.
* **Document and summarize results.** Maintain accurate experimental records in Benchling or a similar electronic lab notebook, track samples, and share results with the team.

Academic research and substantive internship experience are both welcome.

* **Experience with HTS or high-throughput assay workflows.** Familiarity with multiwell plate assays, multichannel pipetting, plate layouts, controls, and consistent sample handling. Experience with automated liquid handling.
* **A foundation in experimental biology.** Experience with cell-based assays and one or more complementary techniques, such as flow cytometry, ELISA, fluorescence or luminescence assays, or molecular cloning. Expertise in every technique is not expected.

Job Summary:

The Laboratory Technician performs tests and analyses in the renewable refinery laboratory. This position prepares samples and utilizes instruments to analyze the samples, ensuring the testing devices are operating correctly. Troubleshoots when instruments are not operating correctly. Maintains knowledge of the use of 20+ instruments to ensure coverage of all laboratory tasks.

Essential Functions:

* Generate and/or evaluate lab-scale samples and testing for Operations
* Assist other business units with evaluation of feedstocks
* Support Engineering in problem solving and optimizing facility, and provide relevant information for further decisions
* Interface with other functions such as Operations, research personnel and Engineering, Environmental, and provide timely results to assure the quality of products shipped to customers
* Assist with processing samples to ensure efficient and safe operation of the facility
* Troubleshoot and maintain the equipment needed for analyzing and routine processing of gaseous, chemical, and environmental samples
* Maintain appropriate logs, notebooks, and other records including computer documents
* Understand and follow EHS, SOPs, regulations, and guidelines to maintain a safe work environment
* Clean and maintain lab equipment, including recalibration of equipment
* Stay current on technical and scientific advances in field
* Perform general wet chemistry- including but not limited to titration (Acid-Base, Karl Fischer, etc.), pH Measurement, Density/Specific Gravity Measurement, Viscosity Measurement, Flash Point/Cloud Point Analysis (ASTM D93, D7683), Distillation (ASTM D86), Carbon residue/Ash Content Analysis, Water & Sediment (BS&W) Analysis.

* Capable of managing multiple tasks and effectively working across multiple teams
* Comfortable performing physical and analytical testing

jobs.description:

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Deal-Breaker Requirements**

Candidates must meet all of the following:

WE ARE LOOKING FOR BIOMED ENGINEERS. NOT RESEARCH TECH. Please don't apply of your looking for research job. We are seeking a dynamic and innovative Biomedical Engineer to join our cutting-edge research and development team. In this role, you will leverage your expertise in biotechnology, mechanical engineering, and molecular biology to design, develop, and optimize medical devices and diagnostic tools. Your work will contribute to advancing healthcare solutions that improve patient outcomes worldwide. This position offers an exciting opportunity to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams, manage complex projects, and bring innovative biomedical products from concept to manufacturing readiness.

* Lead the design and development of biomedical devices, ensuring compliance with FDA regulations, ISO standards, and design controls.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams on project management tasks, including risk assessment and documentation for regulatory submissions.
* Support clinical trials by preparing protocols, analyzing results, and ensuring adherence to GLP (Good Laboratory Practice) and CGMP (Current Good Manufacturing Practice) standards.

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Biotechnology, or a related field.
* Proven experience with laboratory techniques such as assays, cell culture, and biochemistry methods.
* Strong knowledge of CAD software (SolidWorks or equivalent), GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing), and mechanical design principles.
* Familiarity with molecular biology techniques and statistical analysis tools for research validation.
* Experience managing projects using project scheduling tools and methodologies in a biomedical context.

Imoyase Community Support Services (ICSS) is seeking a Research Assistant to provide research support for a program evaluation study to examine outcomes for families receiving community-based services and supports, including those involved with the child welfare and criminal justice systems. ICSS is a nonprofit (501c3) organization with over 30 years of experience conducting program evaluation and action research that is participatory, culturally relevant, collaborative, and flexible, resulting in meaningful individual, community, organizational, and systems policy change throughout Los Angeles, California, and the nation. You'll lead deep technical engagements, partnering directly with startup engineering and scientific teams to help them build their products on Claude and run their own research with it, advising on implementation and agent design as they build what is newly possible with AI in the life sciences. You will bridge the gap between what Claude can do and what the life sciences need, working alongside some of the strongest teams in the field on problems that matter and pushing the boundaries of AI in science as you go.

Working closely with Applied AI Architects, Account Executives, and Anthropic's Product, Engineering, and Research teams, you'll help startups build at the edge of what is possible with Claude. You'll leverage your AI engineering expertise and your scientific domain knowledge to develop custom evaluation frameworks, design scalable architectures, and create the technical resources that enable life sciences startups to succeed with Claude.

Responsibilities

Serve as a deep technical advisor to high-potential life sciences and biotech startups, whether Claude sits inside the product they sell or inside the way they make discoveries, working alongside them to build innovative use cases that push the boundaries of AI in scientific research and development
Work hands-on with startup engineering teams and their scientists through pair programming and architecture reviews that accelerate their development, and understand their scientific workflows end to end so that your guidance fits into real research pipelines
Develop prototypes and technical documentation, including evaluation suites, scientifically grounded benchmarks, AI engineering techniques, and architecture diagrams, that enable startups to build, operate, and scale with Claude
Create reference implementations and sample code that many companies can adopt without starting from scratch, such as example MCP servers for domain-specific data sources like genomics platforms, literature databases, and experimental repositories, along with agent skills for common scientific workflows
Collaborate closely with Applied AI Architects to maintain context and continuity across customer engagements
Identify patterns across engagements, including what is hard about deploying AI in the life sciences such as heterogeneous data, auditability requirements, and the gap between a working prototype and a system that scientists trust, and contribute insights back to Product, Engineering, Research, and the broader Applied AI team, including feedback on the model capabilities and product features that would most accelerate discovery work
Create technical content for startup audiences including documentation, tutorials, and sample code
Represent Anthropic across the life sciences startup ecosystem and foster community engagement through hackathons, webinars, technical office hours, in-person founder events, and research show and tells
Travel to customer sites for workshops, implementation guidance, and relationship building

You may be a good fit if you have

Deep experience in the life sciences or biotech, gained through research or industry work in areas such as genomics, drug discovery, molecular design, lab automation, or clinical development, along with strong opinions of your own about how to bridge the gap between what AI can do today and what the life sciences need
4+ years of technical experience as a software engineer, ML or research engineer, computational biologist, research scientist, or technical founder, with either production experience building LLM-powered applications, including prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale, or a track record of successfully applying AI to real scientific work in the lab or in research
Experience with startups or high-growth companies and a love of working with founders and small teams that move quickly
Strong technical communication skills, with the ability to translate complex AI concepts into architectural decisions and actionable implementation plans for both engineering and scientific audiences and to run technical workshops, hackathons, or developer-focused events
A collaborative approach to working across teams, the ability to context-switch across scientific domains and use cases, and a passion for making powerful technology safe and beneficial

A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. About Us

Grow was born to tackle a critical challenge: making mental health care more effective and accessible for everyone. Since launching in 2020, 15 million sessions have started on Grow, and we've barely scratched the surface. We do it through a three-sided marketplace that empowers providers, augments insurance payors, and serves patients. We've backed that ambition with more than $328M in funding, including our Series D at a $3B valuation from Sequoia Capital, Transformation Capital, TCV, SignalFire, Menlo Ventures, Goldman Sachs Alternatives, and others.

Spatial Front, Inc. (SFI) is seeking an Sr. Cloud and Python Developer
to support our growing modernization team. SFI was recently awarded the 2025 USA Today National Top Places to Work award and the 2025 Washington Post Top Workplaces.

The initiative will also involve converting legacy SAS code to Python, replacing Java-based services with AWS serverless solutions developed in Python, and leveraging PostgreSQL as the primary database platform.

jobs.description:
Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week

Check out this Loom video for more details:
https://www.loom.com/share/b0d1b0bf24c44ae8b95dca84b9db60e5

We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What this role actually is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

Whether the response makes sense
Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful
Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment
Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.

What you'll be doing

Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end
Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think
Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code
Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)
Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading
Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"

We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?
Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?
Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?
Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.

Who you are

Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)
Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python
Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor
Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows
Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line
Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement
Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback
High bar for what good engineering looks like

Nice to have

Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows
Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement details

Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location
Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible
Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well
Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat
Process: one take-home evaluation exercise with a recorded Loom walkthrough. No interview

In this role, you'll apply your scientific, technical, or operational expertise to red-team advanced AI models, identify potential safety vulnerabilities, and evaluate their ability to generate harmful or high-risk information. You'll develop adversarial prompts to test AI safeguards and assess model outputs for accuracy, specificity, actionability, and whether they provide meaningful information beyond what is already available through published literature and other public sources.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on scientific or operational experience, strong analytical judgment, and an interest in addressing emerging challenges at the intersection of AI, biosecurity, and public safety.

As a Biosecurity & CBRNE Subject Matter Expert, You'll

Develop adversarial prompts to test AI model safeguards and identify potential safety vulnerabilities.
Evaluate AI-generated outputs for scientific accuracy, specificity, actionability, and the degree of meaningful uplift they provide beyond publicly available information.
Apply specialized biological or CBRNE expertise to assess complex technical information and identify concerning AI model capabilities related to chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear, or explosive hazards.
Determine whether AI-generated information lowers practical barriers related to knowledge, materials, equipment, or skills, or simply restates publicly available information.
Contribute to AI safety benchmarks, risk thresholds, severity rubrics, and evaluation frameworks while calibrating assessments with other subject matter experts.
Document findings and provide clear rationales for severity assessments to support actionable improvements by AI developers.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams across AI safety, research, security, and policy.

Requirements

Deep technical expertise in at least one CBRNE domain (biological, chemical, radiological/nuclear, or explosives), demonstrated through a graduate degree with hands-on laboratory or field experience in a relevant discipline, or equivalent operational experience (e.g., CBRN specialist, EOD technician, HAZMAT, biodefense, or national laboratory work)
Strong scientific and analytical judgment, including the ability to distinguish widely available information from information that could materially lower barriers to causing harm
Excellent attention to detail and ability to identify errors, inconsistencies, and potential safety concerns
Strong written communication skills and ability to clearly document technical findings
Familiarity with prompting or interacting with large language models (LLMs); prior AI red-team experience is not required
Interest in AI safety and the potential risks associated with advanced AI capabilities

Must be a U.S. citizen

Strongly Preferred Qualifications

Experience in HAZMAT, emergency response, biodefense, biosafety, biosecurity, national laboratories, defense, or government environments

Experience with AI safety evaluations, red teaming, adversarial testing, or large language models
