jobs.title: Staff Geospatial Data Science Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

RV Tech is seeking a Geospatial Data Science Engineer to pioneer the data layer powering our next-generation software-defined electric vehicles. In this senior role, you will be responsible for transforming massive, high-frequency streams of vehicle sensor observations into highly accurate, dynamic map features that the vehicle can use for localization, routing, and advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS).

You will apply advanced computational statistics, machine learning, and spatial analysis to process and model large datasets, drawing actionable insights that translate raw fleet telemetry into live, high-definition maps. We value proactive problem-solvers who thrive in autonomous roles and are passionate about building performant, scalable systems at the intersection of data science and robotics.

Responsibilities

Geospatial Pipeline Engineering: Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines that ingest, clean, and segment billions of daily vehicle sensor observations into consumable map features and geometries.
Statistical Modeling & Insights: Apply advanced data mining and analytic methods to detect real-world changes (e.g., road closures, new lanes, construction) and design rigorous statistical tests to validate map accuracy.
Map Generation & Map Matching: Develop robust algorithms for map matching, trajectory smoothing, and sensor fusion to convert noisy probe data into high-fidelity road geometry and attributes.
System Design & Architecture: Lead the technical design of spatial data systems, ensuring low-latency query performance, efficient spatial indexing (e.g., H3, S2), and scalable storage of vector/raster map data.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with embedded software engineers, perception teams, and cloud architects to align onboard vehicle capabilities with cloud-based mapping platforms.
Staying Ahead of the Curve: Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in big data technologies, computational statistics, machine learning, and automated mapping practices.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Geoinformatics, Robotics, or a related quantitative field with an emphasis or thesis work on computational statistics, data mining, machine learning, or spatial optimization.
Experience: 8+ years of related professional experience building and maintaining large-scale data processing and predictive systems.
Advanced Analytics & Data Mining: Expert-level knowledge in data mining and analytic methods such as regression, classifiers, clustering, association rules, decision trees, and Bayesian network analysis.
Geospatial Expertise: Proven experience working with geospatial data, handling noisy time-series datasets, writing advanced spatial queries in PostGIS, and utilizing spatial libraries/indexing systems (e.g., H3, S2, GeoPandas).
Programming & Scripting: Proficiency with statistical analysis packages and programming languages, including Python, SQL, and shell scripting (or familiarity with R/MATLAB).
Statistical Testing: Strong statistical foundation with proven expertise in designing, executing, and analyzing complex data tests and validation methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications

Crowdsourced Mapping: Experience with fleet-based, crowdsourced map generation methodologies, including probe-data aggregation, change detection, and incremental map updates.
Cloud Ecosystems: Experience deploying large-scale geospatial pipelines and machine learning workloads within cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Databricks).
Open-Source Infrastructure: Experience with standard open-source vector tile formats, tools like Martin, QGIS, and geospatial processing engines (GDAL/OGR, GEOS).
Automotive Map Formats: Familiarity with automotive map standards, routing schemas, and data structures such as NDS (Navigation Data Standard), OpenStreetMap (OSM), and Lanelet2/HD Maps.
Robotics Algorithms: Familiarity with core robotics concepts, including SLAM (Simultaneous Localization & Mapping), Sensor Fusion, and Point Cloud / Sensor Processing (LiDAR, radar, vision).

Total Rewards

We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.

In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs
.

jobs.description:
Position/Program Information

Type of Recruitment

Open Competitive - Emergency

Filing Dates

Applications will be accepted from Thursday, October 15, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. (PT) until Thursday, October 22, 2026, 5:00 p.m. (PT). All applications must be received before
5:00 p.m. (PT) on Thursday, October 22, 2026, to be accepted.

Exam Number

HH1762B-EA

The LA County Board of Supervisors recently declared a local state of emergency for homelessness , and the County is working to revise and expand our response to help all who are affected. We are looking for qualified and passionate individuals to help us in the mission of addressing issues like housing, mental health, and substance use. If you are looking for a new career that will directly benefit the population of LA County, this may be the opportunity for you.

The Department of Homeless Services and Housing (HSH) is seeking qualified candidates to fill emergency Health Program Analyst III vacancies related to the homelessness crisis.

Under the emergency order, applicants who meet the requirements may be hired for an initial period of up to 90 days, with an opportunity for permanent County employment.

During your initial work period, you will be assessed on your work performance. This assessment will be weighted 100%.

Those who successfully pass the assessment will be considered for permanent appointment to Predictive Data Analyst.

Essential Job Functions

Assists department stakeholders to define data needs and requirements to ensure data science projects meet business needs at the community, regional, divisional, departmental, or county-wide level.
Collaborates with other department subject matter experts to understand, identify, and select available and relevant sources of data for use cases, including internal and external data sources.
Collaborates with data administrators and other IT staff to develop data pipelines and ensure the availability of quality data.
Uses statistical programming languages and packages, computer scripting languages, and/or domain-specific languages to digest, manipulate, prepare, augment, evaluate, analyze, summarize, and visualize data.
Conducts end-to-end predictive data modeling projects that include basic exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, model selection, deployment of models into production environments, and visualization of findings.
Uses advanced data visualization techniques to create data dashboards and reports to be used by varying levels of the enterprise and business managers.
Uses supervised machine learning techniques on less complex business problems, with an understanding of algorithms, feature selection, variable importance, hyper parameter tuning, and optimization.
Performs data management and manipulation, including the writing of data queries of departmental databases and data marts, data cleaning, and joining of multiple and disparate data sets.
Extracts and organizes data and applies quality-control techniques to ensure the accuracy and completeness of all data; researches source documents and coordinates with others to resolve missing or conflicting data and other anomalies.
Assists in planning, designing, and managing experiments, consumer surveys, and other data collection projects to augment existing sources of data as necessary to solve business problems.
Works with program staff to understand the implications of analyses and to ensure that findings are actionable and support data-driven program, policy, and operational decision-making.
Assists in coordinating with various functional teams to develop and implement products, services, tools, or business process changes resulting from the analysis.
Accesses ongoing training and professional development to maintain familiarity with current industry and academic research to apply the latest and most useful statistical learning techniques to help extract patterns and trends from data.

Requirements

Requirements to Qualify

Option I:
A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university* in a field of applied research such as Data Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Statistics, Business Analytics, Psychology, or Public Health that included 12 semester or 18 quarter units of coursework in data science, predictive analytics, quantitative research methods, or statistical analysis -AND- Two (2) years of experience in the application of techniques of machine learning, predictive analytics, data management, and hypothesis-driven data analysis to complex experimental designs leading to actionable findings and recommendations -OR- A Master’s or Doctoral degree from an accredited college or university in a field of applied research such as Data Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Statistics, Business Analytics, Psychology, or Public Health.

Option II:
Four (4) years of experience with responsibility for planning, designing, conducting, and evaluating research projects involving the application of techniques of machine learning, predictive analytics, data management, and/or hypothesis-driven data analysis to complex experimental designs leading to actionable findings and recommendations.

You MUST meet the above requirement(s) in order to be appointed to fill any vacancies related to this recruitment.

Special Requirement Information

To receive credit for your education, include a copy of your official diploma or letter/certificate -AND- official transcript from an accredited institution within seven (7) calendar days of the end of the filing period. Please submit documentation to SAtajanyan@hsh.lacounty.gov and indicate your name, the exam name, and the exam number. The document should show the date the degree was conferred and be in English; if it is in a foreign language, it must be translated and evaluated for equivalency to U.S. standards. For more information on our standards for educational documents, please visit:

https://file.lacounty.gov/SDSInter/dhr/070812_PPG123.pdf and https://file.lacounty.gov/SDSInter/dhr/205105_PPG_123_ACE_Resource_Guide.pdf ;

We do not accept password-protected documents. Ensure documents are unlocked before attaching to your application or sending to the exam analyst.

License

A valid California Class C Driver License or the ability to utilize an alternative method of transportation when needed to carry out job-related essential functions.

Physical Class

II - Light: This class includes administrative and clerical positions requiring light physical effort that may include occasional light lifting to a 10-pound limit and some bending, stooping, or squatting. Considerable ambulation may be involved.

Desirable Qualifications

Six (6) months of experience within the last two (2) years in one or more of the following:
Working with real-world administrative datasets, including identifying and resolving common data quality issues such as missing values, duplicate records, and inconsistent coding across sources.
Producing recurring reports or dashboards from administrative data systems using tools such as Tableau, Looker, Power BI, Databricks Dashboards, Sparks, Azure Synapse, or equivalent platforms.
Communicating analytic findings clearly in writing and in presentations to non-technical audiences such as program managers or executive staff.
Using version control or collaborative coding tools (e.g., Git, shared notebooks) in a team analytic environment.
Working with Stata, SQL, Python, R, or other code-based analytics languages.
Conducting quality assurance (QA) on reports, projects, or coding logic to ensure data accuracy.
Working on an Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) process using data input tools to clean and combine datasets.

Additional Information

Exam Content

During your initial work period, the appointing department will evaluate your performance. Those who achieve a passing score on this evaluation will be considered for permanent appointment.

Applications must be filed online only and will be reviewed for interview consideration on an ongoing basis. This will allow you to reaffirm your interest and update any relevant information. AI Technical Scrum Master with Python Development

We are seeking an AI Technical Scrum Master with Python Development to lead Agile delivery for mission-focused, AI-enabled software products in a SAFe Agile environment while providing targeted, part-time Python development support.

This is an intentionally hybrid position, not two full-time roles combined into one. The primary responsibility is serving as the Scrum Master and Agile delivery lead for a cross-functional team. The secondary responsibility is contributing hands-on Python development for automation, APIs, integrations, data-processing utilities, testing, and selected technical backlog items based on sprint priorities and available capacity.

The successful candidate will facilitate Agile ceremonies, remove delivery impediments, strengthen team execution, coordinate dependencies, and foster continuous improvement across teams building trusted, secure, and scalable AI-enabled information systems. The candidate will also apply practical Python development skills to support delivery when additional technical capacity is needed, without compromising Scrum Master responsibilities, team coaching, or Agile leadership.

You will work closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, Release Train Engineers, architects, software engineers, data scientists, testers, security teams, and operations teams to plan, coordinate, and deliver AI solutions that improve operational workflows, decision-making, and mission outcomes. The role requires strong Scrum Master leadership, experience with SAFe Agile delivery, an understanding of modern software engineering practices, and the ability to contribute maintainable Python code within an enterprise delivery environment.

We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

Scope Of The Role

At Innodata, we’re partnering with the world’s leading technology companies to build the future of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re on the lookout for smart, savvy, and curious Generative AI Specialist to join our global contributor community as part of our Subject Matter Expert (SME) on Demand program.

This is not a traditional full-time role. It’s a part-time, remote, flexible, project-specific opportunity designed for those who want to make a real impact—on their schedule. Whether you're a writer, linguist, educator, researcher, or just deeply passionate about language and logic, this role lets you contribute to cutting-edge AI development while maintaining control over your time.

You’ll be helping LLMs learn the intricacies of language and reasoning—not just how to write, but how to think. If you’ve ever dreamed of shaping the intelligence behind tomorrow’s technology, this is your chance.

This is more than just a gig—it’s a rare chance to help shape the future of AI from anywhere in the world, on your own terms.

What You’ll Own

Rating/assessing the performance of AI models or algorithms based on their output or behavior through a set of evaluative questions.
Labeling elements of a piece of content rather than the content as a whole.
Assigning predefined categories or labels to items.
Evaluating the perceived quality and/or appropriateness of content
Generating labels to advance understanding of a concept, trend etc.
Creation of additional training data for machine learning models by applying transformations to the original data, such as modifying images (rotation, flipping, cropping), generating new text (paraphrasing, summarization), or altering audio/video signals (speed modification, pitch shifting) to reduce overfitting and increase dataset diversity.

Ordering or ranking items based on a set of preferences or criteria.
Creating prompts or questions that will be used to generate responses from a language model or other AI system.
Projects that evaluate the relevance of content based on a relevancy scale (1-3, 1-5, etc.).
Generating responses to prompts or questions using a language model or other AI system.
Rewriting existing text while preserving the original meaning, often to improve clarity or style and adherence to guidelines.
Producing concise summaries of longer pieces of text or data.
Converting spoken language or audio content into written text.
Converting text or spoken language from one language to another.
Gathering and compiling various forms of data to be used for training, evaluating, or fine-tuning the AI models. This may include text, images, videos, audio files, or other types of digital content.

You’ll Thrive In This Role If You Have

Professional or Expert level proficiency (C1/C2) in English and Russian

About Us

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.

What You'll Do

As a member of our Advanced Concepts and Technology team within Government Services and Solutions, you'll be our data explorer and rapid prototyper — the person who takes a rough idea and a messy dataset and comes back with something that works. Our team serves U.S. Government customers and mission partners, and the solutions you build matter in the real world: operational environments, national security applications, and defense programs where better data means better decisions. You'll dig into internal and external data streams to surface insights, identify emerging opportunities, and build proof-of-concept solutions that shape what we can engineer with data for government customers and beyond. This isn't a role for someone who needs a perfectly scoped ticket; it's for someone who gets energized by an open question and a blank canvas.

Investigate internal and external data streams to surface patterns, anomalies, and opportunities that inform new engineering and business solutions
Rapidly prototype data-driven tools and analytical systems, translating loosely defined ideas into working proof-of-concept solutions with speed and creativity
Design and implement data pipelines to ingest, process, and analyze structured and unstructured data from diverse sources — both batch and streaming
Partner closely with engineers, program managers, and subject matter experts to understand data needs and co-develop novel solutions
Evaluate emerging data technologies, AI tools, and analytical frameworks for potential adoption — and bring your findings back to the team with a clear recommendation
Communicate technical insights and prototype results clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Engage across teams and data sources to discover what's possible, then build it — working hand-in-hand with engineers and business leaders to move quickly from insight to working prototype

What You'll Need

Additional:
Proficiency in Python; working knowledge of SQL

Strong analytical instincts: you know how to interrogate data and push past surface-level findings
Hands-on experience with exploratory data analysis (EDA) — turning raw data into questions, and questions into findings
Clear communicator — able to translate technical findings into plain language for mixed audiences
Self-motivated learner with the drive to independently research and build
Eager to pick up new tools, languages, and problem domains on the fly — comfortable diving into the unfamiliar and treating "I've never done this before" as a starting point, not a blocker
Ability to travel up to 25%

What Will Help You On The Job

Working knowledge/experience with AI tools and agents for development, document creation, research, etc.

Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) or distributed data platforms (Databricks, Hadoop)

Linux/Bash experience

What You'll Do

As a member of our Advanced Concepts and Technology team within Government Services and Solutions, you'll be our data explorer and rapid prototyper — the person who takes a rough idea and a messy dataset and comes back with something that works. Our team serves U.S. Government customers and mission partners, and the solutions you build matter in the real world: operational environments, national security applications, and defense programs where better data means better decisions. You'll dig into internal and external data streams to surface insights, identify emerging opportunities, and build proof-of-concept solutions that shape what we can engineer with data for government customers and beyond. This isn't a role for someone who needs a perfectly scoped ticket; it's for someone who gets energized by an open question and a blank canvas.

jobs.description:
Job Description

JOB SUMMARY:

The Research Data Analyst 3 will independently support data management and analysis for one or more domestic and international research projects. Responsibilities will include designing data collection instruments and REDCap databases; developing data dictionaries and standard operating procedures; overseeing data collection, validation, cleaning, integration, and documentation; training and supporting project staff; monitoring data quality and timeliness; and resolving data discrepancies with collaborating research sites. In collaboration with investigators and biostatisticians, the analyst will conduct statistical analyses using established methods, interpret findings, prepare tables, figures, and reports, and contribute to abstracts, manuscripts, and scientific presentations. The analyst will manage competing priorities across projects and communicate effectively with multidisciplinary collaborators while ensuring compliance with applicable research protocols and data privacy and security requirements.

The RDA 3 will support several projects, however the primary project will be Rapid Research in Diagnostics Development for TB Network (R2D2 TB Network):
This NIH-funded project has established a platform to identify promising early-stage TB diagnostics and conduct field evaluations to assess their accuracy, usability, acceptability, and cost-effectiveness. The project includes research sites in Uganda, Zambia, Vietnam, India, and the Philippines. The analyst will support multicountry data systems, collaborate with international research teams, monitor data quality, and prepare analysis-ready datasets. Depending on experience and project needs, the position may also contribute to human factors research, Bayesian analyses, and health economic studies.

Department Summary

The UCSF Center for Tuberculosis (CTB) unites a multidisciplinary community of TB experts working to accelerate global TB elimination and train the next generation of TB scientists. Since launching in 2019, CTB has grown to include more than 50 faculty investigators across UCSF and UC Berkeley, spanning immunology, data science, epidemiology, pharmacology, diagnostics, therapeutics, biostatistics, implementation science, and policy. As the operational hub of the NIH P30-funded UC Tuberculosis Research Advancement Center, CTB serves as the scientific home for the TB research enterprise at UCSF and beyond. Through cooperative scholarship, technical training, mentorship, clinical excellence, advocacy, and a collaborative spirit, CTB-affiliated faculty, fellows, and staff are advancing global health and improving the lives of TB-affected communities through transformative research and practice.

The Institute for Global Health Sciences (IGHS) is a UCSF campus wide interdisciplinary program that reports to the Chancellor. IGHS is structured as an Organized Research Unit (ORU) and control point that oversees a portfolio of $330M in sponsored programs (including $80-90M per year in grants and cooperative agreements expenses), two graduate groups that confer Masters and PhD degrees, and an administrative unit that provides communication, financial management, event planning, staffing support, operations, and program development support to faculty members working in global health across the campus.

IGHS's mission is to advance health and reduce health disparities worldwide, with a focus on vulnerable populations. IGHS is continuing to expand its programmatic activities into new regions (Latin America and Asia) and new themes (e.g., transdisciplinary research in infectious disease, maternal and child health, and non-communicable diseases, pandemic preparedness, digital health, climate change, and migrant health). It also is working to develop new educational program offerings (degree and certificate) and partnerships with academic institutions in the US and in low- and middle-income (LMIC) countries. It also has engagements domestically with public health programs, including the California Department of Public Health.

IGHS is committed to ensuring a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment as we work towards becoming an anti-racist organization. We strongly encourage applicants from diverse backgrounds. Please see our statement on anti-racism here: https://globalhealthsciences.ucsf.edu/about-us/diversity-equity-and-inclusion/statement-structural-racism

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree in epidemiology, public health, or related area and 3 years of directly relevant work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Human Subjects research training or ability to obtain in the first year of employment
Thorough knowledge of research function.
Thorough skills associated with statistical analysis and systems programming.
Thorough skills in analysis and consultation.
Skills to communicate complex information in a clear and concise manner both verbally and in writing.
Knowledge of several statistical programs including STATA or R and MS Excel, as well as the data management program REDCap, is required to ensure the accuracy of study data, produce relevant datasets for analysis, conduct data analysis, and prepare data for publication/presentation.

Preferred

Experience working on international collaborations including international field experience.
Experience working in global health research including in sub-Saharan Africa or Asia
Proficiency designing and analyzing choice experiments using Sawtooth and/or other statistical programs including STATA or R
Skills in project management.
Knowledge of medical terminology with a focus on tuberculosis is needed to work with the many study collaborators.
Research skills at a level to evaluate alternate solutions and develop recommendations.

The CLS assists in the operation of the hospital clinical laboratory by overseeing and performing routine and STAT tests in the lab Hematology, Chemistry, Blood Bank, Microbiology departments. Monitors section functions and assists in the development and revision of policies and procedures.

Always verifies the name and MR number of the patient before collecting the specimen or performing the test.

Always rejects unsuitable specimens and documents reasons.

Always perform and appropriately document calibration, quality control, and preventative maintenance procedures to validate the accuracy and precision of instruments or testing protocols.

Always reports instrument problems on the Action Taken form.

Always documents action taken to solve an instrument or reagent problem.

Always performs start up and shut down procedures at the beginning and end of the shift.

Always performs proficiency testing within the guidelines of the department.

Monitors responsible QC, trends, and action take issues.

Ensures testing is performed in a timely manner.

Always ensures that care and instructions given to pediatric, adolescent, adult, or geriatric patients and/or guardians is appropriate for the age and level of understanding of the patient.

Attends in-service programs and maintains the required hours of in-service. Provides verification of such attendance.

When requested is able to assist in the training of another employee.

jobs.title: Part-Time Data Analytics Subject Matter Expert (Remote)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Halluminate is an applied AI and data company working with frontier labs to train financial services and knowledge work superintelligence. We build high-quality computer-use and tool-use reinforcement learning (RL) environments that train AI agents to do real work across financial services verticals and adjacent domains.

Role Description

Halluminate is hiring part-time Data Analytics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).
Frontier AI models can already build a clean budget model, run a standard variance analysis, and reconcile a simple ledger. We need experts who can push them further. In this role you'll design work that would challenge a strong senior analyst or controller, with multi-step reasoning, messy inputs, and the correct judgment calls where the right answer isn't obvious, then use it to expose where today's best AI models still fail. Your work feeds directly into the training data and frontier evaluations that leading AI labs use to measure and improve their models.
Your day-to-day in this role is RL environment task development and writing (i.e., creating the complex problem and solution that the AI agents must attempt to solve), not data labeling AI outputs based on your preferences or something less challenging.

Responsibilities

Shape the future of knowledge work by identifying which financial workflows matter most and where today's AI models fall short, drawing on your real experience
Build training materials for AI systems, including KPI dashboards, cohort analyses, SQL-based reports and A/B test readouts, and other real-world deliverables
Create challenging tasks that expose weaknesses in state-of-the-art AI models on financial services work
Contribute to frontier evaluations that measure how leading AI models perform on real finance workflows
Work directly with research and engineering teams at frontier labs to evaluate model outputs and turn findings into better training data
Revise tasks quickly based on feedback from reviewers and model results, often across multiple rounds

What we're looking for

2-5+ years of experience working in data analytics (business intelligence, analytics consulting, data science, product analytics, etc.)
Exceptional command of core workflows in Excel, PowerPoint, and other professional software programs (modeling, valuation, deal materials, memos)
Curiosity about machine learning, AI, data, and engineering concepts. No technical background required.
Comfort with direct, frequent feedback and the ability to turn it around quickly without losing quality
Sharp attention to detail and the judgment to spot exactly where an output would fail a senior review
Strong organization and full ownership of deadlines

Location

Fully Remote

Time Commitment

Minimum of 20 hours per week
You choose when to work

Compensation

Training milestone payments between $500-$4000
Implied hourly rate: $100/hour - $200/hour
Bonuses paid out for above average performance or stellar contributors

If interested please apply here: https://www.halluminate.ai/experts

Why work with Halluminate

Halluminate builds the highest quality, most complex training environments and benchmarks that leading AI labs rely on to push their most capable models forward. Our expert researchers lead that work. They design the problems, set the standards models are measured against, and uncover where frontier AI still falls short. Where other competitors may focus on data labeling / annotation, our experts are challenged to identify weak points in frontier labs models to accelerate AI capabilities in finance.
Market leading compensation. Our experts earn among the highest rates in the industry, with median earnings of $3,800 in September and our top 25% averaging over $30,000 that month.
Consistent Demand for Work. Halluminate experts get a steady stream of new projects, not stop-start bursts. You choose how much to take on, based on your schedule and earning goals.
Fully remote, you set your schedule. All work on the platform is completed remotely. We support work from outside the US: if you're traveling abroad temporarily, flag it to your Team Lead (note that work is not permitted from certain countries), and if you'll be abroad for an extended period, we can set your start date for when you return. jobs.description:
Summary

Position Summary

WHO YOU ARE:

You are restless when a task shows up for the third time, curious about the story behind a number, and comfortable turning a vague question into something concrete, with AI as a trusted partner but your own judgment as the final check. You want your work to support the people who keep the food supply safe. If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

Who We Are

Leader in food safety solutions for both contract sanitation and chemistry in the food processing industry.
Over 10,000 dedicated team members across North America.
Corporate headquarters in Atlanta, GA with team members working in over 250 plants throughout North America.
Over 50+ years of experience in creating long-lasting partnerships.

Our Mission

We protect the food supply by eliminating risks so families everywhere can eat without fear.

Protect What Matters: We are in service of safety at every step, ensuring the health of everyone is central to all we do – from plant team members to consumers.
Deliver On Our Promises: We speak honestly and are dedicated to doing the right thing by upholding ethical standards and following through on our commitments to our teams, our customers, and our business.
Win as a Team: We believe in the power of collaboration, uniting our diverse strengths while working hand-in-hand with our team members and customers to unlock potential and achieve stronger results together.
Advance a Safer Future: We are committed to innovating more effective, sustainable, and cost-efficient food safety solutions to develop a safer world for all.

Job Description

This role goes beyond traditional HR reporting. You will build the data infrastructure and AI-assisted workflows that empower HR, Safety, and Compliance leaders ask better questions and get faster, more trustworthy answers. Job duties include but are not limited to:

AI-Augmented Analysis: Use Claude and other AI tools to accelerate exploratory, draft and refine SQL/queries, identify trends across HRIS and workforce datasets, and validate findings before they reach leadership. Treat AI as a thinking partner that extends your perspective and capabilities, not a shortcut that replaces sound judgment.
Workflow & Automation Design : Identify repetitive, manual reporting processes and redesign them as automated, sustainable workflows — reducing turnaround time and freeing capacity for higher-value analysis. Build with reusability in mind so workflows outlast any single request.
Insight Engines, Not Just Reports: Move past static reporting toward systems that surface trends, anomalies, and "why" behind the numbers — proactively flagging issues in employee engagement, turnover, safety compliance, and workforce planning before they're asked about.
Data Integrity and Management: Ensure accuracy, consistency, and completeness of HR data across HRIS, people management systems, and adjacent platforms. Conduct regular audits and build automated checks to catch discrepancies early.
Dashboards Built to Last: Design clear, visually compelling, and low-maintenance dashboards and reports (Power BI, Tableau, Excel, and AI-assisted tooling) that non-technical stakeholders can actually use — and that don't break the moment a data source shifts.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with HR, Compliance, Safety, Operations, Finance, and IT to understand reporting needs, align metrics to organizational goals, and translate ambiguous questions into concrete, buildable deliverables.
Continuous Improvement: Identify smarter ways to collect, model, and communicate data, and take ownership of implementing those improvements rather than just flagging them.
Special Projects : Contribute to experimental or exploratory initiatives — new metrics, predictive models, or AI tools — as assigned by leadership.

Your Must Haves

Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Analytics, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field.
Proficiency in HRIS platforms and reporting/BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Excel, SQL).
Demonstrated comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to support analysis, automate workflows, or accelerate reporting — and the judgment to know when to trust, verify, or override them.
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex, sometimes messy data sets and translate findings into actionable insights.
A builder's mindset: you'd rather design a repeatable workflow than repeat manual work.
Genuine curiosity — you dig into anomalies instead of smoothing them over — paired with the creativity to present insights in ways that land with non-technical audiences.
Excellent communication and presentation skills to convey insights effectively to HR, Safety, and Compliance leadership.
Knowledge of HR metrics, workforce analytics, and compliance reporting.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work collaboratively across cross-functional teams.
High attention to detail and an unwavering commitment to data accuracy.

What We Prefer You Have

Hands-on experience designing AI-assisted or automated reporting workflows (e.g., using Claude, Python, or low-code automation tools) in an HR or People Analytics context.
3 or more years of related experience.
Experience with predictive analytics and HR data modeling.
Familiarity with machine learning concepts and emerging HR technology trends.
A track record of turning a one-off analysis request into a durable, self-serve tool or dashboard.
Certification in HR analytics, data visualization, or AI/prompt engineering tools is a plus.

is a multidisciplinary team dedicated to transforming how Development leverages data, technology, and artificial intelligence to make faster, better-informed decisions. We bring together expertise in portfolio analytics, data management, AI/ML innovation, Planisware technology, and digital product delivery to create scalable solutions that improve portfolio visibility, streamline operations, and accelerate decision-making. As a member of the Portfolio Data & Digital Innovation (PDDI) team, you will help shape the future of data-driven decision making across Biogen's R&D portfolio. Working alongside data scientists, portfolio strategists, data engineers, and business leaders, you will develop AI-powered solutions that improve portfolio visibility, accelerate decision-making, enhance data quality, and streamline operational workflows. You will contribute across the full solution lifecycle, from data acquisition and engineering to model development, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities Include

Collaborate with data scientists, portfolio analysts, and subject matter experts to develop and deploy innovative AI and analytics solutions.
Design and implement machine learning, predictive analytics, and decision-support models that address real-world portfolio and operational challenges.
Develop interactive dashboards, reporting tools, and data products that translate complex data into actionable insights.
Research and evaluate emerging AI, machine learning, and agentic AI technologies and identify opportunities to apply them within pharmaceutical R&D.

Experience with Monte Carlo simulation, optimization, forecasting, or decision science methodologies.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Halluminate is an applied AI and data company working with frontier labs to train financial services and knowledge work superintelligence. We build high-quality computer-use and tool-use reinforcement learning (RL) environments that train AI agents to do real work across financial services verticals and adjacent domains.

Role Description

Halluminate is hiring part-time Product Management Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).
Frontier AI models can already build a clean budget model, run a standard variance analysis, and reconcile a simple ledger. We need experts who can push them further. In this role you'll design work that would challenge a strong senior analyst or controller, with multi-step reasoning, messy inputs, and the correct judgment calls where the right answer isn't obvious, then use it to expose where today's best AI models still fail. Your work feeds directly into the training data and frontier evaluations that leading AI labs use to measure and improve their models.

Your day-to-day in this role is RL environment task development and writing (i.e., creating the complex problem and solution that the AI agents must attempt to solve), not data labeling AI outputs based on your preferences or something less challenging.

Responsibilities

Shape the future of knowledge work by identifying which financial workflows matter most and where today's AI models fall short, drawing on your real experience
Build training materials for AI systems, including product requirements documents, feature prioritization analyses, go-to-market plans and product roadmaps, and other real-world deliverables
Create challenging tasks that expose weaknesses in state-of-the-art AI models on financial services work
Contribute to frontier evaluations that measure how leading AI models perform on real finance workflows
Work directly with research and engineering teams at frontier labs to evaluate model outputs and turn findings into better training data
Revise tasks quickly based on feedback from reviewers and model results, often across multiple rounds

What we're looking for

2-5+ years of experience working in product management (B2B or B2C software, fintech, platform or AI products, etc.)
Exceptional command of core workflows in Excel, PowerPoint, and other professional software programs (modeling, valuation, deal materials, memos)
Curiosity about machine learning, AI, data, and engineering concepts. No technical background required.
Comfort with direct, frequent feedback and the ability to turn it around quickly without losing quality
Sharp attention to detail and the judgment to spot exactly where an output would fail a senior review
Strong organization and full ownership of deadlines

Location

Fully Remote

Time Commitment

Minimum of 20 hours per week
You choose when to work

Compensation

Training milestone payments between $500-$4000
Implied hourly rate: $100/hour - $200/hour
Bonuses paid out for above average performance or stellar contributors

If interested please apply here: https://www.halluminate.ai/experts

Halluminate builds the highest quality, most complex training environments and benchmarks that leading AI labs rely on to push their most capable models forward. Our expert researchers lead that work. They design the problems, set the standards models are measured against, and uncover where frontier AI still falls short. Where other competitors may focus on data labeling / annotation, our experts are challenged to identify weak points in frontier labs models to accelerate AI capabilities in finance.
Market leading compensation. Our experts earn among the highest rates in the industry, with median earnings of $3,800 in September and our top 25% averaging over $30,000 that month.
Consistent Demand for Work. Halluminate experts get a steady stream of new projects, not stop-start bursts. You choose how much to take on, based on your schedule and earning goals.
Fully remote, you set your schedule. All work on the platform is completed remotely. We support work from outside the US: if you're traveling abroad temporarily, flag it to your Team Lead (note that work is not permitted from certain countries), and if you'll be abroad for an extended period, we can set your start date for when you return. Experts can work when they want and where they want as long as they hit their 20 hours per week minimum. There are no meetings, Zoom calls, or Slack huddles. All feedback from reviewers is left on our internal platform
Build the environments frontier models learn from. You design RL tasks grounded in real data rooms, define the expert-quality answers models are rewarded against, and find the failure modes that show where today's models fall short of professional judgment. Your work feeds directly into how leading AI labs train and evaluate their models.
Push the frontier of what AI can do. Our experts have contributed to industry benchmarks like Westworld Finance Diligence Bench, which tests AI agents on a complete acquisition due-diligence process.
A path into AI research. Top contributors have moved into team lead and full-time research roles at Halluminate.

jobs.title: Senior Product Integration Engineer (CAD)
jobs.description:
About Mainspring
Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more.

The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together:

Pragmatic Optimism

Excellence without Ego

Proactive Collaboration

Job Overview

Mainspring is seeking a Senior Product Integration Engineer (CAD) to own and maintain the integrated CAD definition of the Linear Generator as designs evolve. Design Engineers will continue to own the technical design and subsystem CAD; this role will make sure those designs are incorporated into authoritative POR and future-state reference assemblies and work together correctly in the context of the complete product.

This role combines product-definition ownership with hands-on whole-product CAD integration. The ideal candidate is exceptionally strong in 3D CAD, understands how complex mechanical systems fit together, and enjoys resolving packaging, interface, and configuration problems across multiple engineering teams. This role will be a key user of CATIA for full-product assemblies that exceed the practical limits of SolidWorks.

Core Responsibilities

• Build, maintain, and continuously improve authoritative POR and future-state reference assemblies for the Linear Generator

• Integrate subsystem CAD from multiple Design Engineering teams into full-product CATIA assemblies and keep those assemblies current as engineering changes progress

• Maintain clean full-product CAD structure, references, interfaces, metadata, and configuration logic across major assemblies

• Perform packaging studies, interference checks, clearance reviews, routing studies, service-access checks, and assembly-access evaluations

• Identify conflicting space claims and work with Design Engineers to negotiate interfaces and converge on practical whole-product solutions

• Create and maintain reference geometry, interface geometry, envelopes, simplified models, and other integration artifacts needed to support cross-team design work

• Support design reviews with clear visualizations of clashes, interfaces, access constraints, and product-level integration risks

• Identify and resolve inconsistencies among integrated CAD, drawings, EBOM structure, and the intended product configuration before release

• Support Product Release and Configuration Management by providing a clear, traceable digital definition of the product state being released

• Help establish scalable methods and standards for CATIA, large-assembly performance, imported geometry, simplification, reference assemblies, and cross-CAD workflows

Qualifications

• BS in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience

• 5+ years of experience in mechanical CAD, product design, packaging, product integration, or complex equipment design

• Advanced proficiency with CATIA, NX, Creo, SolidWorks, or another advanced 3D CAD platform; strong CATIA experience is highly preferred

• Demonstrated experience building and maintaining large, complex, multi-subsystem assemblies with disciplined reference and configuration practices

• Strong mechanical intuition and ability to identify packaging, clearance, routing, serviceability, assembly, and interface issues from 3D CAD

• Strong understanding of mechanical interfaces, drawings, GD&T, BOMs, revisions, and engineering change workflows

• Ability to communicate spatial and interface problems clearly and collaborate with engineers from multiple subsystem teams

• Detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable coordinating multiple design changes that affect interfacing hardware

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience integrating products containing structures, piping/tubing, electrical hardware, thermal systems, enclosures, and serviceable components

• Experience with SolidWorks-to-CATIA or other multi-CAD integration workflows

• Experience with ENOVIA, 3DEXPERIENCE, or another PLM/PDM system

• Experience in complex industrial equipment, aerospace, automotive, robotics, energy systems, or another highly integrated hardware product

At Mainspring, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, flexible, and collaborative environment, so if you want to help us transition the world to clean and affordable electricity, and don’t meet all posted requirements for a particular role, we’d still love to hear from you. Mainspring can sometimes be flexible enough to shift responsibilities for the right person, or otherwise identify open or upcoming roles that may better fit your professional background.

2. At least 1–2 years of practical experience with Generative AI, LLM-based applications, or RAG solutions.
3. Experience building REST APIs using FastAPI, Flask, or similar Python frameworks, preferably FastAPI.
4. Hands-on experience working with Google Cloud Platform, especially Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, Vertex AI, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, IAM, and Secret Manager.
5. Experience integrating AI/ML services into enterprise applications using APIs, authentication, asynchronous processing, and cloud-native services.
6. Experience processing structured and unstructured data formats such as JSON, JSONL, Excel, CSV, PDF, Word documents, and text.

3. Experience with Pub/Sub-based asynchronous processing and event-driven architectures.

About The Company

Oracle is a global technology leader renowned for its innovative software, hardware, and cloud solutions. With a rich history spanning several decades, Oracle serves a diverse range of industries including finance, healthcare, government, and retail. The company is committed to driving digital transformation and empowering organizations to achieve their business objectives through cutting-edge technology and comprehensive service offerings. Oracle’s culture emphasizes innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning, making it an ideal environment for professionals seeking growth and impactful work.

About The Role

Oracle is collaborating with Hackajob to connect with exceptional professionals for the role of Principal Data Analyst within Oracle Health’s Government Services team. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of healthcare data analytics. As a Principal Data Analyst, you will be responsible for analyzing, preparing, and processing complex data sets to generate actionable insights. Your work will support internal decision-making, statistical modeling, and client-facing analytics. You will compile data from multiple sources, audit data quality, and evaluate datasets for analytical potential while identifying trends and patterns. Additionally, you will transform data to meet specific functional needs, conduct statistical testing, and create visualizations that communicate insights effectively. The role also involves consulting with clients on data availability, key performance indicators, and reporting capabilities, providing essential support to end-users in accessing and utilizing reports. This position is ideal for a seasoned professional eager to leverage their expertise in data analytics within a dynamic healthcare environment.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field. A minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in data analytics, statistical analysis, data mining, predictive modeling, data management, and visualization is required. Demonstrated ability to gather requirements and translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical stakeholders is essential. Candidates must also hold the appropriate government security clearance and be U.S. citizens due to contractual obligations. Preferred qualifications include at least 3 years of consulting experience in communicating data insights, proficiency with analytical tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Oracle Analytics, and extensive experience using SQL. Strong communication skills, problem-solving abilities, and a proactive approach to collaboration are highly valued.

Responsibilities

Analyze and interpret complex data sets from diverse sources to support analytical and operational needs.
Audit data for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with data health standards.
Transform raw data into structured formats suitable for analysis and reporting.
Conduct statistical testing and exploratory data analysis to identify trends, correlations, and insights.
Create data visualizations and dashboards that effectively communicate findings to stakeholders.
Collaborate with internal teams and external clients to understand data requirements and key performance indicators.

About Berkeley

At the University of California, Berkeley, we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan, which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.

Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride.

Departmental Overview

QB3-Berkeley is where world-class scientists and engineers form interdisciplinary collaborations that solve complex health and environmental challenges. By blending biology with physics and engineering, our researchers create life-changing technologies, from the CRISPR gene-editing revolution and click chemistry to the development of malaria-fighting microbes.

Position Summary

Under general supervision, the Lab Assistant 3 provides skilled technical and operational support for research in the Doudna laboratory. This position performs standardized, recurring molecular biology, microbiology, protein, and nucleic acid procedures using established protocols; prepares reagents and samples; maintains laboratory materials and records; and operates routine laboratory equipment. The Lab Assistant 3 organizes technical data for review by research staff and may assist with basic computer-based sequence processing and data organization using established workflows. This position works closely with research personnel to support reliable and reproducible laboratory research activities. Additionally, this position provides technical research support for projects investigating the molecular mechanisms of novel CRISPR-Cas and related microbial defense systems, contributing to the characterization of candidate defense systems identified through genomic and bioinformatic analyses. Under the guidance of the postdoctoral scholar and the principal investigator, the Lab Assistant 3 may also assist with basic computational analysis, including genome mining, sequence analysis, data organization and visualization, and in silico protein structure prediction using tools such as AlphaFold2/ColabFold.

Application Review Date

The First Review Date for this job is: October 29, 2026. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.

Responsibilities

Molecular Biology and Reagent Preparation - 30%

Performs standardized and recurring molecular biology procedures in support of laboratory research, including PCR, DNA assembly using established methods, bacterial transformation, plasmid preparation, restriction digestion, agarose gel electrophoresis, and nucleic acid purification.
Prepares, labels, stores, and tracks DNA constructs, reagents, and samples according to established laboratory procedures.
Maintains accurate records of materials and procedures performed.

Recombinant Protein and Sample Preparation - 20%

Performs established procedures for bacterial culture, recombinant protein expression, cell harvesting and lysis, affinity purification, size-exclusion chromatography, and related sample-processing steps.
Prepares buffers and other materials, operates routine laboratory equipment, records purification outputs and protein concentration measurements, and prepares samples for use by research personnel.

RNA and Nucleic Acid Technical Procedures - 20%

Prepares RNA and DNA substrates and performs established procedures including in vitro transcription, nucleic acid purification, native and denaturing polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis, and standardized nucleic-acid assay procedures.
Records experimental conditions and organizes resulting data for review by supervising researchers.

Laboratory Operations, Materials, and Documentation - 20%

Prepares commonly used buffers, media, solutions, and reagents; organizes and maintains laboratory samples and shared materials; assists with inventory, ordering, receiving, labeling, and storage of laboratory supplies; maintains work areas and equipment; and follows established biological, chemical, and waste-disposal procedures.

Technical Data and Computational Support - 10%

Records, organizes, and performs routine processing of laboratory and sequence-based data using established software and workflows.
Prepares basic tables, graphs, sample records, and sequence files for review by research personnel.
May run established sequence-processing or computational workflows using inputs and parameters provided by supervising researchers.

Required Qualifications

Working knowledge of standard molecular biology and biochemical laboratory techniques sufficient to perform established procedures, including pipetting, solution preparation, bacterial culture, PCR, nucleic acid purification, and gel electrophoresis.
Working knowledge of laboratory procedures for preparation and handling of biological samples, reagents, buffers, and other research materials.
Ability to accurately follow detailed written and oral laboratory protocols and standard operating procedures.
Ability to maintain complete and accurate laboratory records, sample inventories, reagent records, and documentation of procedures performed.
Ability to recognize deviations from expected technical performance, verify routine procedural steps and controls, and communicate unresolved problems to supervising research personnel.
Ability to organize multiple samples and recurring laboratory tasks, manage priorities, and perform technical work accurately and reproducibly.
Ability to operate and maintain routine laboratory equipment according to established procedures and manufacturer instructions.
Ability to work independently on assigned standardized procedures and collaboratively with laboratory personnel.
Knowledge of laboratory safety practices and ability to follow institutional procedures for biological materials, chemicals, equipment, and waste disposal.
Familiarity with recombinant protein purification, RNA handling, polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis, or related laboratory procedures.

Preferred Qualifications

Previous experience working in a biological research laboratory.

Education / Training

High school diploma or equivalent and three years of laboratory experience; or two years of college including coursework in the natural, physical, or biological sciences and two years of laboratory experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Additional college coursework in biology, biochemistry, microbiology, molecular biology, chemistry, or a related discipline (Preferred).

Salary & Benefits

For information on the comprehensive benefits package offered by the University, please visit the University of California's Compensation & Benefits website.

Under California law, the University of California, Berkeley is required to provide a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role and should not offer a salary outside of the range posted in this job announcement. This range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to experience, skills, knowledge, abilities, education, licensure and certifications, analysis of internal equity, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be offered a salary at or near the top of the range for a position. Salary offers are determined based on final candidate qualifications and experience.

This is a full-time (40 hours/week) Career position eligible for UC benefits.

How To Apply

To apply, please submit your resume and cover letter.

Other Information

This is not a visa opportunity. This position does not include sponsorship of a new consular H-1B visa petition that would require payment of the $100,000 supplemental fee.
This position is governed by the terms and conditions in the agreement for the Technical Unit (TX) between the University of California and the University Professional and Technical Employees (UPTE). jobs.title: Surgical Lab Technician
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position
The Clinical Research Lab Technician supports the daily operations of the pre-clinical laboratory by performing hands-on laboratory activities, equipment reprocessing, tissue preparation, inventory management, and laboratory logistics. This position ensures laboratory spaces, surgical instruments, equipment, materials, and tissue models are properly prepared, maintained, and ready to support safe and efficient lab activities.
The Clinical Research Lab Technician works closely with the Lab Coordinator and cross-functional teams to support development programs, special events, and laboratory operations while maintaining compliance with established safety, quality, and regulatory requirements.
Essential Job Duties
1. Laboratory Setup, Cleanup & Reprocessing
Prepare laboratory spaces, equipment, instruments, and training materials for scheduled pre-clinical studies and special events.
Perform end-of-day laboratory cleanup, turnover, and room reset activities to ensure spaces are clean, organized, and ready for use.
Perform cleaning, decontamination, inspection, reprocessing, and sterilization of surgical instruments and laboratory equipment according to established procedures.
Assemble and prepare instrument trays, surgical instruments, equipment, and training materials prior to scheduled laboratory activities.
Organize and maintain decontamination, sterilization, storage, and laboratory work areas to support efficient and compliant operations.
Reprocess standard and non-standard laboratory equipment and devices according to established procedures.

2. Tissue Handling & Preparation
Handle, dissect, and prepare ex-vivo tissues, cadaveric specimens, and other biological or surgical training models according to established protocols.
Prepare, maintain, and properly handle tissue models in accordance with applicable safety, quality, and laboratory procedures.
Ensure appropriate labeling, storage, tracking, and disposal of biological materials.
Maintain specimen inventory and usage records as required.
Follow established PPE, biosafety, tissue-handling, and disposal requirements.

3. Equipment & Technical Support
Assist in managing * Robotic Platforms and supplemental equipment used for clinical programs, laboratory activities, and special events.

Set up, configure, and verify * Robotic Platforms and associated equipment to ensure readiness for laboratory activities.

Perform routine equipment inspections and basic operational checks.
Troubleshoot and provide basic operational support for laboratory equipment, including robotic platforms, video equipment, electrosurgical units, and other devices.
Escalate equipment issues, supply shortages, safety concerns, or other operational problems promptly to the appropriate team.
Support equipment movement, system placement, and bay assignments as required for laboratory readiness.

4. Logistics, Inventory & Materials Management
Maintain inventory of surgical instruments, equipment, accessories, tissue models, laboratory supplies, and training materials.
Monitor inventory levels and support replenishment to ensure materials are available for upcoming laboratory activities.
Order and track laboratory supplies as needed.
Coordinate shipping and receiving of instruments, equipment, accessories, tissue models, and other training materials for onsite and offsite activities.
Support laboratory logistics, including room readiness, system movements, and other pre-lab operational activities.

5. Laboratory Organization, Safety & Compliance
Maintain clean, organized, and safe laboratory spaces in accordance with established procedures.
Follow laboratory safety protocols, standard operating procedures, quality requirements, and applicable regulatory requirements.
Support compliance with applicable animal care and laboratory requirements, including IACUC, USDA, and other relevant standards.
Maintain accurate laboratory records, documentation, and filing systems in accordance with departmental procedures.
Identify and report safety concerns, equipment issues, process gaps, or other conditions that may affect laboratory readiness.
Follow required PPE practices when working with biological materials, cadaveric specimens, laboratory equipment, and cleaning or decontamination processes.

6. Team & Operational Support
Work closely with the Lab Coordinator and cross-functional teams to execute day-to-day laboratory activities and priorities.
Communicate task completion, equipment issues, inventory or supply gaps, and operational concerns in a timely manner.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams regarding laboratory logistics, equipment availability, inventory needs, and operational support.
Support multiple concurrent laboratory activities while maintaining laboratory readiness and established quality and safety standards.
Provide professional operational support to internal and external customers participating in laboratory and training activities.
Support general laboratory administration, documentation, and process improvements as needed.

Required Skills and Experience
Experience as a laboratory technician, sterile processing technician, veterinary technician, or in a comparable laboratory, medical device, animal research, or pre-clinical environment.
Experience working with biological materials, tissue models, surgical instruments, or laboratory equipment.
Knowledge of sterile processing, decontamination, or laboratory reprocessing practices.
Ability to follow established procedures, protocols, and safety requirements.
Strong attention to detail, reliability, and organizational skills.
Basic inventory and materials-management skills.
Ability to communicate issues, task status, and operational needs effectively.
Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
Working knowledge of common computer applications, including Microsoft Office and Outlook.
Consistent and reliable attendance.

Required Education and Training
High school diploma or equivalent required.
Associate degree or relevant technical education preferred.

Working Conditions
Work is performed primarily in laboratory and office environments with frequent exposure to biological tissues, cadaveric specimens, laboratory equipment, and cleaning or decontamination materials. The position requires adherence to established laboratory safety protocols, biosafety procedures, and use of appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE), including scrubs, gloves, gowns, masks, and eye protection.
Responsibilities include prolonged standing and walking, frequent bending, reaching, pushing and pulling, moving laboratory equipment, preparing training spaces, and lifting materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds. The position may require supporting multiple concurrent laboratory or research activities in a fast-paced environment.
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by individuals assigned to this position. They are not intended to represent an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required.
Preferred Skills and Experience
3–5 years of experience in an animal research, pre-clinical, surgical training, medical device, or comparable laboratory environment.
Familiarity with * Robotic Platforms and associated accessories.

Familiarity with surgical procedures, surgical terminology, and surgical training models.

Familiarity with regulated laboratory environments and applicable requirements, including IACUC, USDA, AAALAC, or similar standards.
Experience troubleshooting or supporting laboratory, surgical, video, or electrosurgical equipment.

About our Client:
Our client is focused on utilizing engineered cells as medicines for patients. The ability to modify genes and use cells as medicines will be one of the most important advances in healthcare over the next several decades. Our client is building differentiated capabilities across the spectrum of cell and gene therapy.

About the role:

The Cell Therapy Innovation team is seeking a hands-on contractor to support 3D human iPSC culture, bioreactor operations, and analytical characterization. The role combines execution of PBS/Ambr workflows with flow cytometry, ELISA, GSIS, protein extraction, and routine process analytics.

What you’ll do:

Execute iPSC/PSC thaw, expansion, passaging, cell counting, viability assessment, and preparation for 3D suspension culture.
Support PBS, Ambr250, or comparable bioreactor setup, inoculation, sampling, feeding or media exchange, monitoring, and harvest.
Monitor process parameters, cell performance, aggregate morphology, metabolites, and experimental observations.
Perform multicolor flow cytometry sample preparation, staining, acquisition, analysis, controls, and basic troubleshooting.
Execute ELISA and GSIS workflows, including standards, controls, sample processing, data review, and analysis.
Perform protein extraction, protein quantification, sample normalization, aliquoting, storage, and traceability.
Prepare media, reagents, vessels, and analytical samples while maintaining accurate experimental records and organized data.
Coordinate activities across parallel, time-sensitive studies and provide occasional weekend coverage when required.

Degree in Chemical, Biological, or Biomedical Engineering plus or 3 years of equivalent combination of education and work experience
>2 years of GMP manufacturing experience in cell therapy with knowledge of cleanroom operations
Detail-oriented with good problem-solving, technical writing and verbal communication skills

Well versed with cGMP requirements and working in a regulated environment, including experience as person-in-plan and/or GMP operator.

BS or MS in cell biology, bioengineering, biotechnology, biochemistry, or a related discipline.
Hands-on mammalian cell-culture experience with strong aseptic technique; iPSC/PSC experience strongly preferred.
Experience with 3D suspension culture or bioreactor systems; PBS, Ambr, DASbox, or comparable platforms is a plus.

Strong attention to detail, sample traceability, data quality, organization, and communication.
